prs.title: feat(cli): support exact-version updates without npm discovery
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds `qwen update --target-version <version>` for standalone installations. An explicit target skips npm version discovery and installs that exact release through the existing download and verification flow, including `QWEN_UPDATE_BASE_URL`. Omitting the option preserves normal update discovery.

Concrete stable and prerelease versions accept an optional leading `v`. Explicit requests allow same-version reinstalls and downgrades. Invalid targets are rejected before downloading, and a downloaded executable reporting a different version is rejected before activation. Unsupported installation methods return an actionable error instead of suggesting an unpinned upgrade. Help and error text are localized.

## Why it's needed

Operators may already have selected a release while npm registry access is unavailable. Configuring a reachable artifact source alone does not help because the current update command performs registry discovery first. Explicit selection makes that dependency unnecessary and prevents discovery from choosing a different release.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Run an explicit-version update with a custom HTTPS release root while npm registry access is unavailable. It should install exactly the selected version without invoking npm or contacting a registry.
- Try a concrete prerelease, a same-version reinstall and an explicit downgrade. Each should use the specified version and retain the previous installation for rollback.
- Try a mutable tag, malformed version, missing argument, unavailable archive, incorrect checksum or an archive whose executable reports a different version. Failures must preserve the original installation and clean up update locks and temporary files.
- For a non-standalone installation, expect a nonzero exit and instructions to install the selected version manually, without an unpinned package-manager command.
- Omit the target option and confirm that normal version discovery remains in use.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the installed CLI's update help has no target-version option; source always runs version discovery before downloading.

After: focused unit tests pass, and isolated CLI tests use a local HTTPS release source with registry access unavailable to verify exact installation and failure preservation. Detailed E2E evidence is posted separately.

Validation: full build, workspace typecheck, bundle, 170 focused tests, changed-file ESLint and Prettier checks passed. The npm lockfile was used for final validation; the optional pnpm layout exceeded an unrelated document-export asset budget, while the npm build passed that gate.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Tested: build, typecheck, unit tests and isolated CLI E2E |
| Windows | Not tested locally |
| Linux | Baseline update help only; new implementation not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 22.23.1. E2E runs use isolated home directories and disposable installations, a local HTTPS server with a temporary trusted CA, and network/subprocess guards. Downloaded fixtures contain a real Node runtime and a small version-reporting CLI; this verifies updater behavior, not the functionality of a complete new release. No real installation was updated.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: explicit requests intentionally permit reinstalls and downgrades. Version equality is now checked before activation for all standalone update entrypoints.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows deferred replacement, full release-package acceptance, daemon/UI upgrade orchestration and release approval policies.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: existing calls without the option retain version discovery; malformed versions are rejected more strictly.

## Linked Issues

Closes #11484

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

为独立安装新增 `qwen update --target-version <version>`。指定目标时跳过 npm 版本查询，通过现有下载与校验流程安装该精确版本，并继续支持 `QWEN_UPDATE_BASE_URL`。不指定参数时保留原有版本查询行为。

支持具体稳定版和预发布版本，以及可选的 `v` 前缀。显式请求允许同版本重装和降级。非法目标在下载前拒绝；下载后若程序报告的版本与目标不一致，则在激活前拒绝。不支持的安装方式返回可操作的错误提示，避免建议一个未固定版本的升级命令。帮助与错误文案已本地化。

## 需求背景

用户可能已经确定要安装的版本，但无法访问 npm registry。仅配置可访问的制品源仍然不够，因为当前升级命令会先查询 registry。指定版本可以移除这个依赖，并避免版本发现选择另一个版本。

## 审查者验证计划

### 验证方法

- 在 npm registry 不可用时，结合自定义 HTTPS 下载源执行指定版本升级。应准确安装目标版本，不调用 npm，也不访问 registry。
- 验证具体预发布版本、同版本重装和显式降级。每种情况均应使用指定版本，并保留旧安装以供回退。
- 验证可变标签、非法版本、缺少参数、制品不存在、校验不匹配和包内程序版本不匹配。失败必须保留旧安装，并清理锁与临时文件。
- 非独立安装应返回非零退出码，提示手动安装指定版本，不输出未固定版本的包管理器升级命令。
- 不提供目标参数时，应继续执行原有版本查询。

### 修改前后证据

修改前：已安装 CLI 的升级帮助中没有指定版本参数；源码在下载前始终查询版本。

修改后：相关单测通过；隔离 CLI 测试使用本地 HTTPS 制品源，在 registry 不可用的条件下验证准确安装及失败保护。详细 E2E 证据单独评论发布。

验证通过：完整构建、工作区类型检查、bundle、170 项相关测试，以及改动文件的 ESLint 和 Prettier 检查。最终验证使用 npm 锁文件；可选 pnpm 布局触发了无关的文档导出体积限制，npm 构建通过了同一门禁。

### 测试平台

- macOS：构建、类型检查、单测和隔离 CLI E2E 已验证。
- Windows：未在本地验证。
- Linux：仅检查基线升级帮助，未在本地验证新实现。

### 验证环境

Node.js 22.23.1。E2E 使用隔离 HOME、临时安装、本地 HTTPS 服务、临时受信 CA，以及网络和子进程监测。下载制品由真实 Node 运行时和精简的版本输出 CLI 组成，证明的是升级器行为，而非完整新版本的功能验收。未升级任何真实安装。

## 风险与范围

- 显式指定版本允许重装和降级；所有独立升级入口都会在激活前核对版本一致性。
- 未覆盖 Windows 延迟替换、完整发布包验收、daemon/UI 升级编排或版本审核策略。
- 未指定参数时保留现有行为；非法版本校验更加严格。

关联并关闭 #11484。

</details>

prs.title: fix(test): budget the standalone runtime suite for the release pool
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Give the standalone Node/Bun regression suite more headroom on the shared release pool. Each worker has a 540-second cap; the outer spawn is derived as two worker caps plus 60 seconds of setup allowance, or 1,140 seconds. The same two workers, probes, assertions, and checksum verification remain in place.

The no-AK parity suites remain enrolled by #15142. Remove the three stale exemptions introduced during an earlier repair, which otherwise make the membership guard contradict that enrollment.

## Why it's needed

Release run [39621619809](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39621619809) hit the old 300-second per-worker cap. In attempt 2, the Node worker completed at about 294 seconds and the Bun worker received SIGTERM at about 301 seconds; the child then exited with failure. The old 600-second outer cap did not fire. The outer allowance is sized to contain the sequential workers and setup, not presented as an observed failure.

The release job has a separate 30-minute ceiling and also performs setup and script tests. The chosen 540/1,140-second limits leave room for those phases; the precise margin depends on runner load.

## Reviewer Test Plan

Verify both workers finish successfully on the release runner and retain their exit-code and signal diagnostics. Confirm the worker cap is 540 seconds, the outer cap is 1,140 seconds, and the no-AK membership guard accepts the three enrolled parity suites without exemptions.

### How to verify

Run `npm run test:standalone:runtimes:ci` for the real Node/Bun probes. Run the focused release-workflow and no-AK accounting meta-tests to check the existing budget assertions and enrollment contract. A loaded release-pool replay remains necessary to establish timing reliability there.

### Evidence (Before & After)

No UI change. The cited release logs demonstrate the worker-cap failure; this closeout corrects the accounting conflict and description. Fresh validation of this repair is recorded in the closeout comment rather than implying earlier test results were rerun.

## Risk & Scope

A genuinely hung worker can now run longer before failing. No production runtime behavior changes. The budget meta-tests use declaration parsing and upper bounds; they do not prove successful execution under load or a minimum budget. Broader budget-test hardening and runner policy changes are follow-ups.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15091

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

为共享发布池上的独立 Node/Bun 回归套件增加预算：每个 worker 540 秒，外层为两个 worker 预算加 60 秒，即 1,140 秒。探测、断言与校验和验证保持不变。保留 #15142 对三个 parity 套件的 no-AK 纳入，只删除此前修复留下的冲突豁免。

发布 run 39621619809 的证据只支持旧 300 秒 worker 上限被触发：第二次尝试中 Node 约 294 秒完成、Bun 约 301 秒收到 SIGTERM，随后子进程失败退出；旧 600 秒外层上限未触发。外层预算用于容纳顺序执行的 worker 与 setup，并非观测到的故障。30 分钟发布 job 还包含其他阶段，实际余量受 runner 负载影响。

验证真实 Node/Bun 探测及 release-workflow/no-AK 元测试；本次修复的实际验证在收尾评论记录。真实高负载发布池的时序可靠性仍需该环境验证。挂起的 worker 会更晚失败；不改变生产行为。预算元测试基于声明解析和上界，不证明高负载下能够完成，也不固定最小预算，进一步加固留作后续。

</details>

prs.title: feat(qqbot): let the agent send a local file to the chat
prs.body:
## What this PR does

It lets the agent hand media back to a QQ chat. A new per-channel switch, off by default, exposes four tools that each take an absolute local path: one sends a file, one an image, one a video, and one a voice message. The channel checks that the file really is a regular file inside the session's workspace or the system temporary directory (symlinks are resolved and refused when they escape, paths with more than one hard link are refused, and the opened descriptor is re-checked), then uploads it through the platform's chunked upload path and sends it as a rich-media message. The image, video, and voice tools also check the file's magic bytes and its per-kind soft limit before any upload, so a file the platform would render as something else — a GIF, a WebP, an over-limit image — is refused with a pointer to the file tool instead of being quietly downgraded to a file card. Every send reuses the turn's reply anchor and message-sequence counter, so media sent mid-turn stays in the same reply chain as that turn's text; when the reply window has closed it falls back to an active message, and when active messages are disabled it reports the refusal instead of dropping the media or silently replacing it with text. Upload failures are reported to the model with the platform's error code classified, so a retryable part failure can be retried and a daily-limit rejection is not.

## Why it's needed

An agent working in a channel could read a conversation and write files, but had no supported way to deliver one to the user: images, videos, and voice messages could come in, and text could go out, but a report, a generated archive, a chart, a short clip, or a voice note produced locally had to be retrieved by hand from the machine. The tools close that gap with the same ownership rule as the other adapter tools — a tool is only offered to sessions of the channel that registered it. The platform renders an image, a video, and a voice message differently from a file card, so the sender picks the form the user should see instead of every artifact arriving as a download.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Enable the new file switch on a QQ channel and, from a session in that chat, ask the agent to send a file it created inside the workspace; a file card should arrive in the chat and the send should belong to the same reply chain as that turn's text. Then confirm the boundary: a path outside the workspace and outside the temporary directory is refused, a symlink pointing outside is refused, a file over the size cap is refused before any upload, and with the switch off the tool is not registered at all. In a chat where active messages are disabled, force the turn's reply window to close and confirm the tool reports the refusal rather than sending text. Then ask the same session for a generated PNG, an MP4, and a WAV (or MP3/SILK/OGG): the chat should receive an image message, a playable video, and a voice bar, each still in that turn's reply chain. Hand the image tool a GIF or a 21 MB PNG and confirm it is refused before any upload with the accepted formats and the file-tool fallback named, instead of arriving as a file card.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — channel-side tools, no TUI change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only; the platform upload and send paths are exercised with a mocked HTTP layer.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the tools hand a local file to the platform under the bot's own identity, so they are opt-in per channel and bounded to the session workspace, the temporary directory, and a per-kind size cap (20 MiB for files, 20 MB for images and voice messages, 30 MB for videos); the path and format checks are the security-relevant part.
- Not validated / out of scope: a real end-to-end send against the live QQ platform. The accepted format lists come from the platform's documentation, which disagrees with itself on image and voice formats (the file-type table says `png`/`jpg` and `silk`, the overview text also lists `gif`/`webp`/`bmp` and `mp3`/`wav`/`ogg`); the design follows the table for images and the wider list for voice, and a format the platform rejects comes back as its own error with a fallback to the file tool. The bilingual design document is at `docs/design/2026-10-25-qqbot-outbound-media.md`.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; the switch defaults off and the change adds a new option and tool rather than changing existing behaviour.

## Linked Issues

Depends on #14348 — the adapter-tool pipeline these tools are exposed through; rebased on it and only the outbound-media increments are new here.

prs.title: feat(cli): capture and restore complete OpenTUI checkpoints
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Create complete OpenTUI checkpoints at real edit approvals, preserve canonical conversation metadata, and restore through the existing shared scheduler and recording transaction. Cancelled or replaced owners cannot publish incomplete checkpoints or stale replay results. Successful compact Read/search/list summaries follow Ink while approval, error, cancellation, image and interactive groups retain their individual behavior.

Dependencies #15386, #15384 and #15283 have merged. Against the actual merged main `f520bac5`, it contains **32 files, +4,338/−487 = 4,825 changed lines (net +3,851)**, below the requested 6,000-line limit. Capture, publication, actual consumers, recovery and unique regressions stay together. Moving Ink's existing pure summary logic counts on both sides of the diff; its original bodies remain unchanged.

## Why it's needed

A shared restore transaction needs a real checkpoint producer. Displayed text loses canonical metadata, and capturing before pending tool events reach their consumer can omit the edit awaiting approval. Asynchronous recording must also honor cancellation. This batch connects those boundaries without introducing a schema, framework, dependency, runtime pin or default-renderer change.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Enable checkpointing and request a real edit. The approval should acquire a complete restore point only after the pending edit has entered the conversation. Approving that same entrance during a pending write should retain its valid checkpoint. Cancelling, switching session/turn, or leaving and re-entering approval must prevent obsolete publication and remove unpublished temporary data. Disabled checkpointing and unsupported existing callers must not access checkpoint storage.

Restore a real Read/Edit checkpoint, retain its original backup, approve one replay and explicitly continue. The new physical execution must answer the original logical call. After natural quit and same-session cold resume, active context must retain the new result and exclude discarded results/answers, while original raw records remain intact. The hot and cold successful Read label must match Ink.

Cancel replay while durable recording is held, then release it: cancelled ownership must not append or publish. A healthy immediate completion should still publish once. Verify local tool-only restore completes without an automatic model request or repeated execution, then accepts exactly one explicit follow-up. Also verify quit/exit summaries, cold image/file context and actual conversation rewind followed by a new prompt.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Historical regressions retained in this PR include publication after signal cancellation and the actual Ink `Read` versus OpenTUI `ReadFile` display mismatch. Their original failed runs remain recorded; historical heads and runtimes are not relabeled as current acceptance.

prs.title: feat(channels): expose adapter tools to agent sessions and add a QQ recall tool
prs.body:
## What this PR does

It lets a channel adapter publish its own tools to the agent sessions it runs, and adds the first consumer of that pipeline: recalling a QQ message. The bridge binds each exposed tool to the session that owns it, so a tool call is attributed to the session the bridge is carrying rather than to whatever session id appears in the frame. The QQ adapter then registers one moderation tool that recalls a message by id through the platform API, gated by a channel-level switch.

## Why it's needed

An agent answering inside a channel session could read the conversation but had no way to act on the platform: there was no supported path for an adapter to offer a tool, and no safe way to bind a tool call to the session that owns it. Operators asked for recall — a message sent by mistake had to be removed by hand in the platform UI. This PR adds the pipeline with the binding as a first-class concern, and lands recall as its first consumer so the pipeline is exercised by a real tool rather than by tests alone.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Enable the moderation switch on a QQ group channel where the bot is a group admin, and from an agent session in that channel:

1. call `qq_recall_message` with no argument — it must be refused with an error naming `member_openid` and `message_id`, and no platform request is made;
2. call it with `member_openid` — the member's most recent tracked message is recalled and the reply reports the destroyed id; a second call with the same openid reaches the previous message, not the destroyed one;
3. call it with an explicit `message_id` — that id is deleted whether or not the channel still tracks it;
4. call it in a direct chat — refused as unsupported (the platform only recalls the bot's own messages there);
5. with `moderationRecallWindowMs: 0` — `member_openid` is refused, an explicit `message_id` still works, and the channel records no inbound history; with `N > 0`, a target older than N no longer resolves; an invalid value warns once and falls back to `-1` (no time limit, the default).

Then confirm the binding negative: a frame that claims a different session id cannot invoke a tool bound to another session, and the removed inject dispatch mode cannot be used to bypass the binding. After a channel reconnect, confirm a re-anchored session still resolves its bound tools. With the switch off, confirm the tool is not registered, cannot be invoked, and no inbound history is recorded.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — server-side tool pipeline, no TUI. 独立审查结论：加固版声明核实通过、inject 剔除干净、recall 端到端可用、重锚安全、三组变异实测（含删掉 `channelName !== this.name` 守卫会红）。按用户新规本地不做大幅构建，权威验证交给本 PR 的 CI。

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only; per the current user rule the local checkout does not run large builds or full suites, so CI is the authoritative run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: exposing adapter tools widens what a channel session can do. The security-relevant part is the binding — the session id in a frame is a carrier, not a credential — and the removal of the inject dispatch mode; both are covered by mutation-tested cases.
- Not validated / out of scope: no live QQ API call and no `qwen channel start` run locally; the remaining review follow-ups (R1-9, R1-18, R1-30, R1-14) are recorded in the status comment below.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; the moderation switch defaults off, and the pipeline adds exports rather than changing existing ones.

## 消费者清单（闸门用）

- 管线：`ChannelAgentBridge`、`ChannelLoopTools`、`AcpBridge`、`DaemonChannelBridge`、`base/src/index.ts` 的导出，以及 `packages/cli/src/commands/channel/daemon-worker.ts`。
- QQ 侧：`api.ts` 的 `requestQQApi`、`types.ts` 的 `moderationTools`、`moderation-tools.ts` 的 `qq_recall_message`、`QQChannel.ts` 的注册与钩子。
- 文档：`docs/users/features/channels/qqbot.md` 的 `moderationTools` 选项行。
- 下游：`packages/acp-bridge/src/status.ts`、`packages/cli/src/acp-integration/acpAgent.ts`（main 已有，未改）。

## 为何必须一起落（CONTRIBUTING 2000 行规则）

本 PR 的 changed lines = 3165（GitHub 统计 3047+/118−），超过 2000，按 `CONTRIBUTING.md:33-36` 需"拆成可独立合并的小 PR **或** 解释为何必须一起落"。选择解释：管线本身只是把适配器工具接进会话，**没有消费者就无法验证**；recall 是它的第一个消费者，**没有管线就无法被调用**。两者合起来才是"agent 能通过通道工具操作平台"这一个可评审的行为。测试 1989 行是同一机制的 pinning 套件，与实现分离就失去保证，因此再拆也压不到 2000 以下。生产 changed lines 为 1147（+1066/−81），文档 29。

## 局限性

- **4 条 minor 的现状**：`requireGroup` 死代码已删除、c2c + `member_openid` 边界随直聊拒绝而不可达、`loop` 轮次假 id 经由的隐式 turn 解析路径已移除、复数措辞已在 `1ba5843b79` 处理；剩余评审遗留项见下方【评审遗留项状态】评论。
- 拆小 diff 不会缩短 fork PR 的 ubuntu lane 60 分钟上限（`ci.yml` 无 paths 过滤，拆小只减单 lane 耗时、不减 lane 数）。
- **环境限制（非本 PR 缺陷）**：fork 的 ubuntu `Test` lane 有 60 分钟上限，撞顶会被 GitHub 取消（job 结论 `cancelled`，`gh pr checks` 归到 fail 桶），**这不代表用例失败**；外部贡献者没有 rerun 权限（REST `rerun-failed-jobs` → 403 "Must have admin rights"），需要时请有权限的人 rerun。权威验证 = 集成侧 `check-union` + 聚焦单文件套件。
- 按用户新规本地不做大幅构建与全量套件，验证以 PR CI 为准。
- 与 #13882 的文本合并冲突不是功能耦合，但会让两条线的落地顺序互相影响。

## 独立审计

独立 subagent 审查结论：**VERDICT `claims-accurate-with-caveats`；`SAFE TO MERGE ALONE: yes`；未发现已证可利用的漏洞。**

- **[本 PR 引入，已在本单元修]** `moderationTools` 原实现是 `=== false` 才返回，即**默认 ON**——既有 QQ 部署会静默获得模型可调用的破坏性动作，且 `channels/` 没有操作员开关。已由 `9f542b9cbc` 改成显式 opt-in（`moderationTools !== true` 才注册），同步改 `types.ts`/`docs qqbot.md` 的默认值说明（默认 false），把 truthy-but-non-boolean 用例改成断言不注册，并新增 `registers nothing by default`。
- **[既有，只交代不修]** F1：绑定是集合成员判定而非传输身份（探针显示跨会话可解析，但模型不可触达、无利用链，代码已自述）。F2：daemon 用闭包绑定、ACP 用帧字段的不对称。F3：recall 半径仅绑定会话内，`message_id` 无归属/格式校验；member 定向默认不做时间限制（`moderationRecallWindowMs` 缺省 `-1`，每聊最多 50 条），显式 `message_id` 不受该窗口约束。F5：失败回显平台 body 无长度上限。F7：对已启用 loop 的频道是行为变化（环形缓冲有界）。
- **正面结论**：main 上反向帧的 `sessionId` 是**未校验直接用**（`859a337500:.../AcpBridge.ts:776-779`），**本 PR 关掉了这个问题**。
- 正面事实：schema 由代码强制（非装饰）；门禁在 tip 树全绿（`tsc --build` base + qqbot `--force` exit 0、Prettier/ESLint exit 0、聚焦 6 文件 405 条测试；opt-in 修复后自证 406 passed）；PR 自身 18 文件，`packages/{channels,cli}` 之外只有 `docs/.../qqbot.md`。
- **方法学提醒**：本仓 `git diff main <tip>` 不可用（浅克隆的 `main` 是 fork 点，会混入 1223 个无关文件）；本 PR 的文件集要用各 commit 的 `git diff --name-only <c>^ <c>` 取并集。

## 范围

**管线**（`packages/channels/base/src/`）：`ChannelAgentBridge.ts`、`ChannelLoopTools.ts`、`AcpBridge.ts`、`DaemonChannelBridge.ts`、`index.ts`，以及 `packages/cli/src/commands/channel/daemon-worker.ts` 与对应测试——把适配器自有的通道工具暴露给 agent 会话，用 `boundSessionId` + `channelLoopMcpBoundSessions` 把"frame 的 sessionId 是载体、不是凭证"钉进实现（旧的不安全路径已从 `AcpBridge.ts:777-779` 移除）。

**第一个消费者**（`packages/channels/qqbot/src/`）：`api.ts` 的 `requestQQApi`、`types.ts` 的 `moderationTools` 开关、`moderation-tools.ts` 只保留 `qq_recall_message`（220 行，而不是完整 1003 行）、`QQChannel.ts` 的注册与钩子、`api.test.ts` / `tools.test.ts` / `events.test.ts` 的对应用例，以及 `docs/users/features/channels/qqbot.md` 的选项行。

## 依赖父分支 / 父单元

base `main`，无父单元。**与 #13882 无符号/功能依赖**：本 PR 用到的新符号都是自建，`qwen/control/session/mcp/runtime-add` 及其 handler 在 main 已存在（`packages/acp-bridge/src/status.ts:242`、`packages/cli/src/acp-integration/acpAgent.ts:13825`）。但**与 #13882 及本系列其它动 `QQChannel.ts` 的单元存在文本合并冲突**（实测 `git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only ddc6feb2a8 db0ba5c317` 4 处）：`QQChannel.ts` 构造器尾部（本 PR 插 `registerModerationTools()`，#13882 插 `attachBridgeBoundarySeal()`）、`QQChannel.ts` `setBridge` 尾部（同点）、`events.test.ts` 文件末尾（双方各追加一个顶层 describe）、`docs/.../qqbot.md` 选项表（双方各加一行）。`types.ts` 与 `base/src/index.ts` 自动合并干净。

此外，**与本系列的兄弟 PR 也存在同类冲突点**：`QQChannel.ts` 构造器末尾与 `setBridge` 内（A2/B/C 系列都会碰）、`events.test.ts` EOF（A2/C1 都会追加 describe）。落地顺序上谁先合谁后合，都需要在 `QQChannel.ts` 与 `events.test.ts` 各 rebase 一次。**落地顺序需协调**。

## 生产行数

生产 +950/−78；文档 +20/−5；测试 +1572/−32；合计 +2542/−115。生产 950 ≥500 → 升级 maintainer 知会（<1000，不触 large-PR 提示）。

## 验收证据

独立 subagent 对抗性审查**通过**（无 blocker）：加固版声明核实通过（`boundSessionId` / `channelLoopMcpBoundSessions`，旧路径 `AcpBridge.ts:777-779` 已移除）；`DispatchMode` 无 `'inject'`，inject 剔除干净；recall 端到端可用；重锚安全；三组变异实测，含"删掉 `channelName !== this.name` 守卫"会让用例变红。第一轮审查另指出**测试强度缺口**（断言未钉住 `method`、`inputSchema.properties` 的 `message_id`/`member_openid`、`resolveChat` 收到的 `sessionId` 等），已由跟进 commit `4adba87db4` 补齐（4 文件 +82/−14：上述断言、`50065001`/`status:0`/非字符串参数三例、中性化 fixture 命名、`AcpBridge.boundSessionId` 的"成员校验非传输校验"注释）。按用户新规本地不做大幅构建，权威验证交给本 PR 的 CI。

## Adversarial review

独立 subagent 对抗性审查**通过**（无 blocker；4 条 minor 见"局限性"，作 follow-up）。第一轮的测试强度缺口已由 `4adba87db4` 关闭；第二份独立静态审查与第一份结论一致。

## Linked Issues

References #13882（同 fork 上的独立切片，不作为 #13882 的承接单元）。

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

本 PR 让通道适配器把自有的工具发布给它运行的 agent 会话，并落地第一个消费者：撤回 QQ 消息。桥把每个暴露的工具绑定到持有它的会话，因此工具调用归属于桥所承载的那个会话，而不是 frame 里出现的任意 session id。QQ 适配器随后注册一个按 id 撤回消息的审核工具，由通道级开关控制。

为什么需要：在通道会话里作答的 agent 能读对话，却没有操作平台的受支持路径——适配器没有发布工具的方式，也没有把工具调用安全绑定到持有它的会话的方式。运维提出要撤回：发错的消息此前只能在平台界面手工删除。本 PR 把管线连同"绑定"这一首要关注点一起落地，并以 recall 作为第一个消费者，使管线被真实工具而不是仅被测试覆盖。

验收方式：在 QQ 群（机器人是管理员）打开审核开关，从该通道的 agent 会话依次确认：无参调用被拒（错误里指明 `member_openid` 与 `message_id`，不发平台请求）；`member_openid` 撤回该成员最近被追踪的消息，成功回显被销毁的 id，第二次调用撤回到上一条；显式 `message_id` 直接删除；直聊调用被拒；`moderationRecallWindowMs: 0` 时 `member_openid` 被拒而 `message_id` 仍可用且不记录入站历史，`N > 0` 时超期目标不再解析，非法值告警一次并回落 `-1`。再确认反面：声称另一个 session id 的 frame 不能调用绑定到别的会话的工具，已移除的 inject 分发模式也不能绕过绑定。通道重连后，确认重新锚定的会话仍能解析其绑定的工具。关闭开关后，确认工具未注册、无法调用，且不记录入站历史。

证据：独立 subagent 审查通过（加固版声明核实通过、旧不安全路径已移除、inject 剔除干净、recall 端到端可用、重锚安全、三组变异实测含删掉 `channelName !== this.name` 守卫会红）；第一轮指出的测试强度缺口已由 `4adba87db4` 补齐（4 文件 +82/−14：`method` / `inputSchema.properties` / `resolveChat` 的 `sessionId` 断言、`50065001`/`status:0`/非字符串参数三例、中性化 fixture 命名、`boundSessionId` 成员校验注释）。按用户新规本地不做大幅构建，权威验证交给 PR CI。

为何必须一起落：changed lines 3165 超过 CONTRIBUTING 的 2000 行线，但管线没有消费者无法验证、recall 没有管线无法被调用，合起来才是"agent 通过通道工具操作平台"这一个可评审行为；测试 1989 行是同一机制的 pinning 套件，与实现分离就失去保证。生产 changed lines 1147（+1066/−81）。

依赖：base `main`，无父单元。与 #13882 **无符号/功能依赖**（用到的新符号都是自建，相关 handler 在 main 已存在），但**有 4 处文本合并冲突**：`QQChannel.ts` 构造器尾部与 `setBridge` 尾部、`events.test.ts` 末尾、`docs/.../qqbot.md` 选项表；`types.ts` 与 `base/src/index.ts` 自动合并干净。**与本系列兄弟 PR 也有同类冲突点**：`QQChannel.ts` 构造器末尾与 `setBridge` 内（A2/B/C 系列都会碰）、`events.test.ts` EOF（A2/C1 都会追加 describe），落地顺序上谁先合谁后合都要在 `QQChannel.ts` 与 `events.test.ts` 各 rebase 一次。

局限性：4 条 minor 的处理现状见正文与置顶状态评论；拆小 diff 不会缩短 fork PR 的 ubuntu lane 60 分钟上限（环境侧限制）；本地不做大幅构建与全量套件，验证以 PR CI 为准。

</details>

prs.title: fix(ci): scope the sdk-java test-job lock to the cache write-back (#15281)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The self-hosted Java test lane no longer holds the pool-wide Maven host lock for its entire test suite. It seeds a job-local Maven repository, runs the SDK install and the managed-agent tests unlocked, and takes the ticketed host lock only for the bounded cache write-back. The write-back reuses the MariaDB lane's nlink-delta copy, its 300-second backstop, and its fixed-release excludes. The workflow meta-tests and the bilingual design note follow the new scope, and the workflow size baseline records the real growth.

## Why it's needed

Issue #15281's Managed Agent gate failure is a lock wait, not a test failure. The check-run annotation names the exact state: `::error::sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes as queue ticket 262 (fast)`. The lock is shared across the ECS pool and serialized a ~925-second suite per hold, so a handful of sibling jobs consumed the whole 5400-second budget before this job ran Maven. #15128 already moved the MariaDB lane to the write-back-only scope for the same reason; the push-time test job was the remaining whole-suite hold and the lane that timed out.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Push a PR that touches a managed-agent path and open the `SDK Java (fast) / ubuntu-latest / Java 21` job. The self-hosted step should show the `cp -aln` seed and all three Maven invocations before any `Waiting for the sdk-java host lock` line; the lock wait should appear only at the cache write-back. The focused meta-tests also pin Maven above the lock, the job-local repository on each self-hosted leg, and the write-back lock for both sites.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the job ended with `::error::sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes as queue ticket 262 (fast); head of queue is 0-0000000264-3663917` before Maven ran. After: the suite runs immediately; the host lock is taken only for the write-back, whose hold is bounded by the 300-second backstop. N/A for UI.

### Tested on

|     OS     |                    Status                     |
| :--------: | :-------------------------------------------: |
|  🍏 macOS  |                ⚠️ not tested                  |
| 🪟 Windows |                ⚠️ not tested                  |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ meta-tests, lint, typecheck, build         |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — workflow and meta-test change. JDK 21 and Maven are not installed in this container, so the real Java suite is left to CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the test lane now seeds and writes back a job-local Maven repository; a cold host pays the seed/download cost once, and the write-back is best-effort and capped at 300 seconds, matching the MariaDB lane.
- Not validated / out of scope: the real JDK 21/Maven suite was not run locally (no JDK/Maven in the container); CI runs it. Pool capacity and the lock's 5400-second budget are unchanged.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

Design documents: [English](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15281

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 为什么需要

Issue #15281 的 Managed Agent gate 失败是一次锁等待，不是测试失败。check-run 注解给出了确切状态：`::error::sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes as queue ticket 262 (fast)`。这把锁在 ECS 池内共享，每次持锁串行化一个约 925 秒的套件，因此少数几个兄弟 job 就在本 job 启动 Maven 之前耗尽了整整 5400 秒预算。#15128 已经出于同样的原因把 MariaDB 通道改成只在写回时持锁；push 时的 test job 是最后一个整套持锁的站点，也是这次超时的通道。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

### 证据（Before & After）

之前：job 在 Maven 启动前就以 `::error::sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes as queue ticket 262 (fast); head of queue is 0-0000000264-3663917` 结束。之后：套件立即运行；宿主锁只在写回时获取，且持锁时长受 300 秒兜底约束。UI 变化：N/A。

|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 元测试、lint、typecheck、build         |

### 环境（可选）

N/A —— 工作流和元测试改动。本容器没有安装 JDK 21 和 Maven，因此真实 Java 套件交给 CI 运行。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：test 通道现在播种并写回 job 本地 Maven 仓库；冷宿主会支付一次播种/下载成本，写回是尽力而为且上限 300 秒，与 MariaDB 通道一致。
- 未验证 / 范围外：未在本地运行真实 JDK 21/Maven 套件（容器内没有 JDK/Maven）；由 CI 运行。池容量和锁的 5400 秒预算保持不变。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #15281

prs.title: feat(core): use the XDG config directory for new installs on Linux
prs.body:
## What this PR does

On Linux, Qwen Code now follows the XDG Base Directory spec for its global directory. A new install keeps settings, credentials and the rest of its global state in `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/qwen` (`~/.config/qwen` when the variable is unset) instead of adding `~/.qwen` to the home directory. Existing installs keep using `~/.qwen` with nothing to migrate, and macOS and Windows behave exactly as before.

The global directory is now resolved in this order:

1. `QWEN_HOME`, when set (unchanged).
2. On macOS and Windows, `~/.qwen` (unchanged).
3. On Linux and other XDG platforms, if `~/.qwen` doesn't exist, `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/qwen` is used. A relative `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` is ignored, as the spec says, and `~/.config` is used instead.
4. If `~/.qwen` exists and the XDG directory already holds `installation_id` or `output-language.md`, the XDG directory is used.
5. Otherwise `~/.qwen` is used.

Steps 4 and 5 follow the rule from the issue thread, keeping `~/.qwen` when it exists, with one guard. When both directories exist, the decision comes from files Qwen Code itself writes on first run, not from whether a directory exists. `installation_id` is written unless usage statistics are off, and `output-language.md` on every start except bare mode. That means an unrelated program's `~/.config/qwen` can never take over an existing `~/.qwen`. It also means a `~/.qwen` that something recreates after an XDG install can't pull that install back and make it look like settings and auth were lost. Several things can recreate it: the Live discovery rendezvous, an older CLI bundled with the VS Code companion, and the opt-in profilers.

Everything that works out the global directory on its own now applies the same rule, so they keep agreeing on one directory the way they already do for `QWEN_HOME`. That covers the CLI's settings fast path, the serve runtime-directory fallback, the launcher's managed-update root, the VS Code companion's lock-file location, the channels base package and the SDK peer registry. Two places that found the home directory by taking the parent of the global directory now use the home directory directly, so `~/.env` is still the file they read. Auto mode's self-modification guard now also protects the resolved global directory when `QWEN_HOME` is unset. Without that, `~/.config/qwen/settings.json` and its `hooks/` and `skills/` would lose the protection that `~/.qwen/...` gets from the path patterns.

A design note (English and Chinese) covers the alternatives I considered, and there is an E2E test plan for the Linux scenarios.

## Why it's needed

#1210 asks for this: on Linux, tools are expected to keep configuration under `~/.config` instead of adding another dotdir to `$HOME`. The discussion there asked for this compatibility rule: keep using `~/.qwen` when it already exists, and use the XDG location otherwise.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

On Linux, with a throwaway home so your real config is never touched (`export HOME=$(mktemp -d); unset QWEN_HOME XDG_CONFIG_HOME`). Running `qwen -p "say hi"` without credentials is enough, because it does first-run setup and then stops at the auth check.

1. In an empty home, `~/.config/qwen` gets `installation_id` and `output-language.md`, and no `~/.qwen` appears.
2. With `~/.qwen` created first, Qwen Code keeps using `~/.qwen`.
3. With `~/.qwen` plus a `~/.config/qwen` holding only a `settings.json`, `~/.qwen` is still used.
4. After step 1, `mkdir ~/.qwen` and run again. `~/.config/qwen` stays in use.
5. `export XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$HOME/xdg` gives `$HOME/xdg/qwen`. A relative value is ignored, and `QWEN_HOME` still wins.
6. On macOS or Windows, `~/.qwen` is used even if `~/.config/qwen` exists.

Unit tests cover each of these rules in core and in every place that mirrors it. What I ran locally (macOS, with a throwaway `HOME`):

- `cd packages/core && npx vitest run` on the storage, auto mode and affected suites: 16 files, 1396 passed. The whole core suite also passes, apart from one latency-budget test that only fails under full-suite load and passes on its own.
- `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run` on the lite path resolver, settings, path freshness, serve fast path, trusted folders, sandbox config, theme manager, daemon discovery and managed npm update suites: 9 files, 529 passed.
- `cd packages/vscode-ide-companion && npx vitest run src/utils/paths.test.ts src/ide-server.test.ts`: 36 passed.
- `cd packages/channels/base && npx vitest run src/paths.test.ts`: 17 passed.
- `cd packages/sdk-typescript && npx vitest run test/unit/peer/registry.test.ts`: 24 passed.
- `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/cli-entry.test.js`: 25 passed.
- Typecheck for each touched package, `eslint --max-warnings 0` and `prettier --check`: all clean.

To check the Linux behaviour without a Linux box, I temporarily turned off the macOS exemption and ran the same suites with an empty `HOME`, the way Linux CI runs them. Only the cases asserting that macOS keeps `~/.qwen` failed, which is expected. That is also how I found the existing tests that needed `QWEN_HOME` pinned. As a baseline dry-run, I ran the repository's launcher with a throwaway `HOME` and no credentials. It confirmed which files a first run writes; the details are in the E2E plan.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A, no UI change. Before: a new Linux install creates `~/.qwen`. After: it creates `~/.config/qwen`.

### Tested on

|   OS    | Status |
| :-----: | :----: |
|  macOS  | tested (unit tests, typecheck, lint, format, dry-run) |
| Windows | not tested |
|  Linux  | not tested on a Linux machine; covered by unit tests with the platform stubbed, plus the simulated run described above |

### Environment (optional)

Node 24.18.0, pnpm 11.24.0 via corepack. Unit tests, plus a dry-run of the repository's launcher.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: on Linux the default depends on what is on disk. Someone who copied a whole `~/.qwen` into `~/.config/qwen` but kept the original would switch to the copy, which is the expected result of a migration. When `QWEN_HOME` is unset, resolving the default on Linux costs one to three `existsSync` calls. A few existing tests assumed the default was always `<home>/.qwen` or mocked the filesystem without `existsSync`. They now pin `QWEN_HOME` to the fake home they already used, so they behave the same on Linux CI, which runs with an empty HOME.
- Not validated / out of scope: there is no automatic migration of an existing `~/.qwen`. Config, data and state are not split across `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, `XDG_DATA_HOME` and `XDG_STATE_HOME` (runtime output still follows the global directory unless `QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR` is set). Some prompt texts and docs still say `~/.qwen` literally, as they already do under `QWEN_HOME`. A few opt-in diagnostics, the Live discovery rendezvous and the repository's own telemetry and sandbox helper scripts still use `~/.qwen`. `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` is read from the environment Qwen Code starts with; unlike `QWEN_HOME`, it isn't pre-resolved from a user-level `.env` file.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none for existing installs. New Linux installs use `~/.config/qwen`. To move an existing install, run `mv ~/.qwen "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/qwen"`; the moved directory already contains the marker files. To keep the old location on a new machine, set `QWEN_HOME=~/.qwen` or create `~/.qwen` before the first run.

Design note: `docs/design/2026-10-24-xdg-base-directory.md` (English) and `docs/design/2026-10-24-xdg-base-directory.zh-CN.md` (简体中文). E2E test plan: `.qwen/e2e-tests/xdg-base-directory.md`.

## Linked Issues

Closes #1210

I'm happy to take suggested changes, whether that's the marker files, the precedence, or splitting config, data and state into separate XDG directories in a follow-up.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的作用

在 Linux 上，Qwen Code 的全局目录现在遵循 XDG Base Directory 规范。新安装会把设置、凭据和其他全局状态保存在 `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/qwen`（未设置该变量时为 `~/.config/qwen`），而不再在主目录下新建 `~/.qwen`。已有安装继续使用 `~/.qwen`，无需迁移；macOS 和 Windows 的行为完全不变。

全局目录现在按以下顺序确定：

1. 设置了 `QWEN_HOME` 时使用它（不变）。
2. 在 macOS 和 Windows 上使用 `~/.qwen`（不变）。
3. 在 Linux 及其他遵循 XDG 的平台上，如果 `~/.qwen` 不存在，使用 `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/qwen`。按规范忽略相对路径形式的 `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`，改用 `~/.config`。
4. 如果 `~/.qwen` 存在，且 XDG 目录中已有 `installation_id` 或 `output-language.md`，使用 XDG 目录。
5. 否则使用 `~/.qwen`。

第 4、5 步遵循 issue 讨论中提出的规则（`~/.qwen` 存在时继续使用），但增加了一道保护：两个目录都存在时，由 Qwen Code 自己在首次运行时写入的文件来决定，而不是看目录是否存在。`installation_id` 会被写入（除非关闭了使用统计），`output-language.md` 会在每次启动时写入（bare 模式除外）。因此，无关程序的 `~/.config/qwen` 永远不会取代已有的 `~/.qwen`；而在 XDG 安装之后被某些程序重新创建的 `~/.qwen`，也不会把安装拉回旧位置，造成设置和登录状态“丢失”的假象。可能重新创建它的有：Live 发现的约定位置、VS Code 插件内置的旧版 CLI，以及需手动开启的性能分析工具。

所有各自推导全局目录的地方现在都使用同一规则，因此它们仍像现在对待 `QWEN_HOME` 一样指向同一个目录，包括：CLI 的设置快速路径、serve 的运行时目录回退、启动器的托管更新根目录、VS Code 插件的锁文件位置、channels 基础包以及 SDK 的 peer 注册表。有两处原本通过取全局目录的父目录来得到主目录，现在直接使用主目录，因此读取的仍是 `~/.env`。在未设置 `QWEN_HOME` 时，Auto 模式的自我修改保护现在也覆盖解析后的全局目录；否则 `~/.config/qwen/settings.json` 及其 `hooks/`、`skills/` 会失去 `~/.qwen/...` 通过路径模式获得的保护。

另附一份中英文设计说明（包括考虑过的其他方案），以及一份针对 Linux 场景的 E2E 测试计划。

## 为什么需要

这是 #1210 的请求：在 Linux 上，工具应把配置放在 `~/.config` 下，而不是在 `$HOME` 中再添加一个点目录。该讨论要求的兼容规则是：已有 `~/.qwen` 时继续使用，否则使用 XDG 位置。

## 审阅者验证计划

### 验证方法

在 Linux 上使用一次性的主目录，确保不会触碰真实配置（`export HOME=$(mktemp -d); unset QWEN_HOME XDG_CONFIG_HOME`）。不带凭据运行 `qwen -p "say hi"` 即可：它会完成首次运行的初始化，然后停在认证检查处。

1. 在空主目录中运行后，`~/.config/qwen` 中出现 `installation_id` 和 `output-language.md`，且不会出现 `~/.qwen`。
2. 先创建 `~/.qwen`：Qwen Code 继续使用 `~/.qwen`。
3. 同时存在 `~/.qwen` 和只含 `settings.json` 的 `~/.config/qwen`：仍使用 `~/.qwen`。
4. 在第 1 步之后执行 `mkdir ~/.qwen` 并再次运行：仍使用 `~/.config/qwen`。
5. `export XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$HOME/xdg` 得到 `$HOME/xdg/qwen`；相对路径会被忽略，`QWEN_HOME` 仍然优先。
6. 在 macOS 或 Windows 上，即使存在 `~/.config/qwen` 也使用 `~/.qwen`。

单元测试覆盖了 core 中以及每个镜像该规则的地方的上述规则。我在本地（macOS，使用一次性的 `HOME`）运行了：

- `cd packages/core && npx vitest run`：storage、Auto 模式及受影响的测试套件共 16 个文件、1396 个测试通过。完整的 core 套件也通过，只有一个延迟预算测试会在整套运行的负载下失败，单独运行时通过。
- `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run`：轻量路径解析、设置、路径时效、serve 快速路径、受信任目录、沙箱配置、主题管理、daemon 发现和托管 npm 更新等套件共 9 个文件、529 个测试通过。
- `cd packages/vscode-ide-companion && npx vitest run src/utils/paths.test.ts src/ide-server.test.ts`：36 个通过。
- `cd packages/channels/base && npx vitest run src/paths.test.ts`：17 个通过。
- `cd packages/sdk-typescript && npx vitest run test/unit/peer/registry.test.ts`：24 个通过。
- `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/cli-entry.test.js`：25 个通过。
- 各相关包的类型检查、`eslint --max-warnings 0` 和 `prettier --check`：全部通过。

为了在没有 Linux 机器的情况下验证 Linux 行为，我临时关闭了 macOS 例外，并用空的 `HOME`（与 Linux CI 相同）运行了同样的测试套件。只有断言 macOS 继续使用 `~/.qwen` 的用例失败，这是预期结果；需要固定 `QWEN_HOME` 的现有测试也是这样找出来的。作为基线 dry-run，我用一次性的 `HOME`、不带凭据运行了仓库的启动器，确认了首次运行会写入哪些文件，细节见 E2E 测试计划。

### 证据（前后对比）

不适用，无 UI 变化。之前：Linux 新安装会创建 `~/.qwen`。之后：会创建 `~/.config/qwen`。

### 测试平台

macOS：已测试（单元测试、类型检查、lint、格式检查、dry-run）。Windows：未测试。Linux：未在 Linux 机器上测试；由模拟平台的单元测试及上述模拟运行覆盖。

### 环境

Node 24.18.0，通过 corepack 使用 pnpm 11.24.0。单元测试，外加对仓库启动器的 dry-run。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：在 Linux 上，默认目录取决于磁盘上的内容。如果有人把整个 `~/.qwen` 复制到 `~/.config/qwen` 却保留了原目录，会切换到副本，这正是迁移的预期结果。在 Linux 上，未设置 `QWEN_HOME` 时，解析默认目录需要一到三次 `existsSync` 调用。一些现有测试假定默认目录总是 `<home>/.qwen`，或在 mock 文件系统时没有提供 `existsSync`；它们现在把 `QWEN_HOME` 固定到原本使用的假主目录，因此在使用空 HOME 运行的 Linux CI 上行为一致。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：不会自动迁移已有的 `~/.qwen`；配置、数据和状态没有拆分到 `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`、`XDG_DATA_HOME` 和 `XDG_STATE_HOME`（除非设置了 `QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR`，运行时输出仍跟随全局目录）；部分提示词和文档仍字面写着 `~/.qwen`，这在使用 `QWEN_HOME` 时已是如此；少数需手动开启的诊断功能、Live 发现的约定位置，以及仓库自身的遥测和沙箱辅助脚本仍使用 `~/.qwen`；`XDG_CONFIG_HOME` 从 Qwen Code 启动时的环境读取，不会像 `QWEN_HOME` 那样从用户级 `.env` 文件预先解析。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：对现有安装没有影响。Linux 新安装使用 `~/.config/qwen`。要迁移现有安装，运行 `mv ~/.qwen "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/qwen"`，迁移后的目录本身已包含标记文件。要在新机器上保留旧位置，设置 `QWEN_HOME=~/.qwen`，或在首次运行前创建 `~/.qwen`。

设计说明：`docs/design/2026-10-24-xdg-base-directory.md`（English）和 `docs/design/2026-10-24-xdg-base-directory.zh-CN.md`（简体中文）。E2E 测试计划：`.qwen/e2e-tests/xdg-base-directory.md`。

## 关联 Issue

Closes #1210

欢迎提出修改建议，无论是关于标记文件、优先级，还是在后续 PR 中把配置、数据和状态拆分到不同的 XDG 目录。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): avoid double-counting reasoning in model costs
prs.body:
## What this PR does

I opened #15444, and this PR is my independent implementation of that report. It derives billable output from the aggregate total when that total is usable, instead of always adding candidates and thoughts. The same shared calculation now feeds Ink, OpenTUI, and non-interactive model statistics. Missing or inconsistent totals use the existing output-token fallback rather than being clamped to zero. A missing prompt count cannot turn cached or unaccounted input into output cost, and non-interactive totals are summed across the same source buckets used by the panels.

In contrast to #15464's inlined expressions and OpenTUI regression, this implementation uses one shared helper for all four cost sites, adds direct Ink and non-interactive coverage in addition to OpenTUI, and tests both reasoning conventions plus missing and unusable totals.

## Why it's needed

OpenAI-compatible usage reports reasoning as a breakdown of completion tokens, so adding thoughts to candidates bills that reasoning twice. Gemini reports thoughts separately, so simply deleting the thoughts term would undercount its output instead. With prompt=100000, candidates=150000, thoughts=120000, and total=250000, the current OpenAI-shaped estimate is `$0.2700` at an output price of 1 per million tokens; the correct estimate is `$0.1500`.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Use synthetic usage with input priced at 0 and output priced at 1 per million tokens. Confirm the OpenAI-shaped case above renders `$0.1500`, while the displayed candidates and thoughts remain unchanged. Then use Gemini-shaped usage with prompt=100000, candidates=50000, thoughts=120000, and total=270000; its estimate must remain `$0.1700`. Finally, check an OpenAI-shaped aggregate whose total is no greater than prompt: it must use the fallback rather than report zero output cost. Check these outcomes in Ink, OpenTUI, and non-interactive `/stats model` output.

Local verification completed on the final branch after merging current main:

- Six focused Vitest files, including source-attribution coverage: 156 passed, 0 failed.
- Independent source-level OpenTUI projection across five usage shapes: `$0.1500` for OpenAI-shaped usage, `$0.1700` for Gemini-shaped usage, `$0.2000` for the unusable-total fallback case, and `$0.0002` for each of the cached-only and total-only cases.
- A mutation check that removes aggregate-total derivation turns both new discriminating regressions red; the source was restored byte-identical.
- Three two-source cases through the real panel projection and non-interactive command now produce the same cost after previously diverging.
- Targeted ESLint and Prettier checks on the changed files: passed with zero warnings.
- `git diff --check`: passed.

The full `npm run build` and `npm run typecheck` were also attempted, but are not green on this machine. Build stops in untouched channel-base code on a `Buffer<ArrayBufferLike>` versus `BlobPart` error. Full typecheck additionally reports Buffer/BodyInit conflicts and stale workspace declarations after the main merge, all outside this diff. These failures are not being presented as successful full-repository checks.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Offline source-level projection, with no hosted model request:

| Usage shape | Before | After |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| OpenAI-shaped, usable total | `$0.2700` | `$0.1500` |
| Gemini-shaped, usable total | `$0.1700` | `$0.1700` |
| OpenAI-shaped, unusable total | `$0.2500` | `$0.2000` |

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :----: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ focused tests and source-level projection; ⚠️ full build/typecheck blocked by unrelated local type errors |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 22.23.3, package-level Vitest with coverage disabled, and direct execution of the source projection with synthetic metrics. No live API credentials or private data were used.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a session that mixes responses with and without usable aggregate totals remains an estimate because the raw bucket loses per-event provenance. The fallback deliberately reuses the repository's existing output-token heuristic; this is not an invoice reconciliation change.
- Not validated / out of scope: live provider responses, provider invoices, and the unrelated full-repository type failures described above.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Prompt, candidates, and thoughts displays are unchanged; only estimated-cost arithmetic changes.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15444

## 本 PR 的内容

我提交了 #15444，本 PR 是我针对该报告独立完成的另一套实现。当聚合总量可用时，可计费输出量改为从聚合总量推导，不再无条件把 candidates 与 thoughts 相加。Ink、OpenTUI 和非交互模型统计现在共用同一套计算。总量缺失或不一致时使用现有输出 token 回退逻辑，不会被钳制成零。prompt 缺失不会把 cached 或无法解释的输入变成输出成本，非交互金额则按与面板相同的 source 桶逐项求和。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

使用合成用量，把输入价格设为 0、每百万输出 token 价格设为 1。确认上述 OpenAI 形态显示 `$0.1500`，同时 candidates 与 thoughts 的展示值不变。再使用 prompt=100000、candidates=50000、thoughts=120000、total=270000 的 Gemini 形态，估算必须保持 `$0.1700`。最后检查 total 不大于 prompt 的 OpenAI 形态聚合，必须走回退逻辑，而不是把输出成本报成零。分别在 Ink、OpenTUI 和非交互 `/stats model` 输出中核对这些结果。

- 独立源码级 OpenTUI 投影覆盖五种用量形态：OpenAI 形态为 `$0.1500`，Gemini 形态为 `$0.1700`，无效总量回退用例为 `$0.2000`，cached-only 和 total-only 两个用例均为 `$0.0002`。
- 删除聚合总量推导的变异检查会让两项新增判别性回归变红，源码已逐字节恢复。
- 三组双 source 用例通过真实面板投影和非交互命令验证，修复前两边金额不同，修复后一致。
- 变更文件的定向 ESLint 和 Prettier：零警告通过。
- `git diff --check`：通过。

也尝试了完整的 `npm run build` 和 `npm run typecheck`，但它们在本机并非全绿。构建停在未修改的 channel-base 代码，错误为 `Buffer<ArrayBufferLike>` 与 `BlobPart` 不兼容。完整类型检查还报告 Buffer/BodyInit 冲突以及合入 main 后的工作区声明陈旧，均不在本 diff 内。这里没有把这些失败写成全仓检查成功。

### 前后证据

离线源码级投影，没有请求托管模型：

| 用量形态 | 修改前 | 修改后 |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| OpenAI 形态，总量可用 | `$0.2700` | `$0.1500` |
| Gemini 形态，总量可用 | `$0.1700` | `$0.1700` |
| OpenAI 形态，总量不可用 | `$0.2500` | `$0.2000` |

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :--: | :----: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 聚焦测试与源码级投影；⚠️ 完整构建和类型检查受无关本机类型错误阻塞 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未测试 |

### 环境（可选）

Node.js 22.23.3，关闭 coverage 的包级 Vitest，以及使用合成指标直接执行源码投影。未使用 live API 凭证或私有数据。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：如果同一会话混有上报和未上报可用聚合总量的响应，原始聚合桶会丢失逐事件来源，因此结果仍是估算。回退逻辑刻意复用仓库现有的输出 token 启发式规则，本 PR 不是账单对账改造。
- 未验证或不在范围内：真实 provider 响应、provider 账单，以及上述无关的全仓类型失败。

prs.title: test(cli): budget the hosted approval wait for loaded runners (#15093)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Budgets the hosted approval test helper's wait through the repository's existing slow-host policy instead of a fixed 10-second window. On the ecs-qwen pool the wait is 45 seconds, clamped to that pool's 60-second per-test ceiling; on a saturated non-ECS host it is 15 seconds, clamped to the 15-second ceiling; elsewhere it keeps the current 10 seconds. The polling assertions are unchanged.

## Why it's needed

Main CI failed on commit `9efdca76d39a` in `hosted-workspace-tool-turn.test.ts > keeps who is asked in 'default' mode for call 1 (PreToolUse 'allow', PermissionRequest allow undefined)`. The helper waits for the turn's sequential fsynced durable writes (options publish, action request, durable-wait checkpoint) before answering the approval. On the shared, coverage-enabled ECS runner that chain can outlast a fixed budget even when nothing is wrong. This helper has already been widened twice for the same reason (#12915, #13399), and the failing case is one of the heaviest in its table: both admission passes run, both hooks fire, the tool input is published, and the action is awaited. The failing CI step ran for 48 minutes, which is consistent with the contention-based race.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the affected group on the fast path and on the slow-host path; both should report 11 passing cases:

- `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-workspace-tool-turn.test.ts -t "keeps who is asked"`
- `cd packages/cli && RUNNER_NAME=ecs-qwen-autofix npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-workspace-tool-turn.test.ts -t "keeps who is asked"`

To reproduce the failure signature and confirm the budget, temporarily delay the `managed-action-options` publish by 11 seconds (install the delay before `turn.execute`). At the fast 10-second budget the failing case reports `expected [] to have a length of 1 but got +0` after about 10 seconds; with `RUNNER_NAME=ecs-qwen-autofix` the same delay passes in about 11 seconds. The temporary probe is not part of the commit.

The full affected file also passes: `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-workspace-tool-turn.test.ts` reports 377 passed.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test-only change with no user-visible behavior. The probe above shows the before (10 s budget times out on an 11 s durable publish) and after (slow-host budget passes the same delay).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux sandbox, Node 22, Vitest with v8 coverage. `npm run build` first failed before compiling because the sandbox denies writes to the default corepack cache; rerunning with `COREPACK_HOME=/tmp/corepack-home` passed. `npm run typecheck` and `npm run lint` passed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: on a saturated non-ECS host the wait can now reach the 15-second per-test ceiling; a genuine hang there may surface as a runner timeout rather than the assertion, which is the same tradeoff the hosted-harness suite already accepts. Production behavior is untouched.
- Not validated / out of scope: the exact CI job log is not anonymously downloadable, so the diagnosis relies on the reproduced assertion signature, the two prior fixes, and the failing job's duration. macOS and Windows were not run locally.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15093

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

将托管审批测试辅助函数的等待预算改为使用仓库既有的慢主机策略，而不是固定的 10 秒窗口。在 ecs-qwen 池上等待 45 秒，并受该池 60 秒单测上限约束；在饱和的非 ECS 主机上等待 15 秒，并受 15 秒上限约束；其他环境保持当前的 10 秒。轮询断言未改动。

## 为什么需要

主 CI 在提交 `9efdca76d39a` 上失败于 `hosted-workspace-tool-turn.test.ts > keeps who is asked in 'default' mode for call 1 (PreToolUse 'allow', PermissionRequest allow undefined)`。该辅助函数会等待该轮次串行、已 fsync 的持久化写入（选项发布、动作请求、持久等待检查点）完成后才回答审批。在共享且启用覆盖率的 ECS runner 上，这条链路即使一切正常也可能超过固定预算。该辅助函数已经因为同样的原因被放宽过两次（#12915、#13399），而失败用例是其表格中最重的用例之一：两轮准入都会执行，两个 Hook 都会触发，工具输入会被发布，并且动作会被等待。失败的 CI 步骤运行了 48 分钟，这与基于争用的竞态相符。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

在快速路径和慢主机路径上运行受影响的用例组；两者都应报告 11 项通过：

- `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-workspace-tool-turn.test.ts -t "keeps who is asked"`
- `cd packages/cli && RUNNER_NAME=ecs-qwen-autofix npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-workspace-tool-turn.test.ts -t "keeps who is asked"`

要复现失败签名并确认预算，可临时将 `managed-action-options` 发布延迟 11 秒（在 `turn.execute` 之前安装延迟）。在快速的 10 秒预算下，失败用例会在约 10 秒后报告 `expected [] to have a length of 1 but got +0`；使用 `RUNNER_NAME=ecs-qwen-autofix` 时，同样的延迟会在约 11 秒内通过。临时探针不属于提交内容。

完整受影响文件也通过：`cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-workspace-tool-turn.test.ts` 报告 377 项通过。

### 证据（修改前与修改后）

不适用——仅测试变更，没有用户可见行为。上面的探针展示了修改前（10 秒预算在 11 秒持久化发布下超时）与修改后（慢主机预算在同样延迟下通过）。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

Linux 沙箱、Node 22、启用 v8 覆盖率的 Vitest。`npm run build` 首次在编译前失败，因为沙箱不允许写入默认的 corepack 缓存；使用 `COREPACK_HOME=/tmp/corepack-home` 重跑后通过。`npm run typecheck` 与 `npm run lint` 均通过。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：在饱和的非 ECS 主机上，等待现在可能达到 15 秒的单测上限；那里的真正挂起可能会以 runner 超时而不是断言的形式出现，这与 hosted-harness 套件已经接受的权衡相同。生产行为未受影响。
- 未验证 / 范围外：确切的 CI 作业日志无法匿名下载，因此诊断依赖复现出的断言签名、此前的两次修复以及失败作业的持续时间。本地未运行 macOS 和 Windows。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #15093

</details>

prs.title: feat(core): shrink tool results to the headroom left before auto-compaction
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When a session is close to auto-compaction, shrink the next request's tool results to its remaining headroom. Use only the same chat's last successful usage report for the current provider route and unchanged history prefix. System instructions, session context and tool declarations must match that report; equivalent refreshes preserve it, while changed inputs and obsolete in-flight responses invalidate it without clearing usage counters. Explicit truncation settings take priority.

Measure headroom against auto-compaction and share the selected budget across the batch, charging protected text, media and framing first. Keep the tighter aggregate budget and avoid cutting results twice. If an allocation cannot fit a complete truncation notice, preserve the batch for normal compaction and hard-limit admission. When an artifact path cannot fit, use a complete pointerless notice. Save full originals through the existing best-effort persistence path whenever results are shortened. Before persistence, resolve any read that the selected preview would shorten. If a regular-chat read cannot be traced to a path in model history, preserve the entire batch for normal compaction and overflow handling so worker cache residency still matches the full content the model receives.

Defaults stay at 25,000 characters / 1,000 lines. Result-size accounting moved to #13652. Design: [English](docs/design/pressure-aware-tool-output.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/pressure-aware-tool-output.zh-CN.md).

## Why it is needed

#2566: static tool budgets can push a long session over the compaction trigger prematurely. A hard-ceiling anchor cuts too late; an obsolete usage anchor cuts against the wrong context. At the other extreme, sub-notice allocations erased failure diagnostics and could advertise a nonexistent partial artifact path. A supported PreToolUse repair can supply a read path while recorded model arguments remain `{}`; shortening that result without notifying the worker could then make a later read incorrectly omit the full body.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Near the auto trigger, return a large result: it should shrink to available headroom. Far from or past auto, or after restore/route change/explicit settings, it should keep the static behavior.
- Change fixed inputs, including during a held response: stale usage should not reanchor. Equivalent refreshes should retain the headroom anchor and usage counters.
- Leave only enough headroom for an empty or incomplete notice: original output and error should reach normal compaction admission. A larger but path-insufficient preview should contain a complete notice, a nonempty error indication and no partial recovery path.
- Check the complete persisted original after a meaningful cut and verify user/protected text and previous file-read rights survive.
- Repair an empty-argument read through PreToolUse: the full result should remain in request/history before persistence, and a later unchanged-file placeholder should be valid. With a resolvable original path, normal shortening should notify the worker, preserve prior-read rights and allow a subsequent full reread.

### Evidence (Before & After)

[Current before/after report and actual tmux excerpts](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13599#issuecomment-6080873864). The current repair passed 35 focused pressure cases, affected Core build/typecheck and static checks. The first full-file run passed 589/590; a media fixture lacking its recorded read call was corrected, and its original media headroom assertions plus inode invalidation passed in the final pressure group. No fresh all-590 pass is claimed.

Actual compiled-Core API/tmux controls exercise the hook and separate worker cache: repaired original `{}` preserves 20,033 characters, while resolvable original path still shortens to 2,576 characters, notifies the worker and rereads the full body. Each makes two controlled generation calls; all 11 watched compiled modules loaded with matching hashes. The generator and compaction boundary are controlled (NOOP), with observer loader/assertion failures retained. The resolved-control mutable cache receipt reflects a later reread, not a frozen after-cut snapshot. Earlier tiny-budget and CLI/TUI evidence stays tied to its tested commit.

### Tested on

macOS, Node 22.22.0, current commit `224c21e8212e33e9889a6c3d4dfead08f3757c15`. At that commit the focused suites pass (`llm-chat` 623, `tool-response-finalizer` 48, `microcompact` 103, plus `truncation`/`goal-turn-integration`/`fileReadCache`/`agent` 531) with Core typecheck, ESLint and Prettier clean; the R12-1 and R13-1 regression cases were mutation-checked red against the pre-fix code. Current necessary CI is tracked separately.

## Risk & Scope

The tiny-budget fallback and unresolved-read whole-batch preservation can require normal compaction instead of suppressing text. The latter deliberately may exceed the selected finite character budget; existing compaction, hard admission and overflow handling apply, potentially adding text or compaction. It does not guarantee exact token admission. A pointerless preview omits detailed content when it cannot fit; persistence remains best effort under existing disk limits. Shortened file reads disarm quote-back residency while retaining prior-read rights; uniquely correlated shell shortening leaves file-read residency intact. Existing fork ownership remains unchanged. Unresolved would-cut reads in regular chat now preserve the full batch before persistence; there is no worker API change or blanket cache clear that revokes prior-read rights. The current controlled-Core fixture does not establish a new CLI, browser, real-model or cross-platform result. Line caps and defaults do not adapt.

## Linked Issues

Closes #2566
Result-size accounting split to #13652 (#11536).

<details><summary>中文说明</summary>

接近自动压缩时，根据同一聊天、同一路由且固定输入和历史仍有效的成功用量报告缩小下一请求的工具结果；等价刷新保留依据，内容变化或在途旧响应不重建过期依据，也不清空用量计数。保护文本、媒体和结构先计入余量，与聚合预算取较紧值且不重复裁剪。放不下完整提示时保留原文交给压缩/硬上限准入；完整路径放不下时只发送完整无指针提示，正常裁剪仍尽力保存完整原文。默认25k字符/1000行保持不变，结果统计另在#13652。

本次修复 PreToolUse 补齐实际读取路径、历史原始参数仍为 `{}` 的缓存缺口。落盘前先检查最终预览将裁剪的读取，普通聊天无法定位路径时保留整个批次，确保 worker 驻留状态与模型实际收到的内容一致；可定位读取仍正常裁剪、通知 worker 并保留先读权限，没有新增 worker API。例外批次可能超过有限字符预算，交由正常压缩、硬准入或溢出处理，可能增加文本和压缩，不能声称精确 token 准入。双语设计同步记录。

当前提交 `224c21e8212e3` 的聚焦套件全部通过（`llm-chat` 623、`tool-response-finalizer` 48、`microcompact` 103，以及 `truncation`/`goal-turn-integration`/`fileReadCache`/`agent` 531），Core 类型检查、ESLint、Prettier 干净；R12-1/R13-1 的回归用例均经变异验证在修复前为红。首次全文件589/590通过，媒体fixture未记录读取调用；补齐路径关联后，原媒体预算断言和inode解除断言在最终压力组通过，未冒称全590重新通过。实际编译Core API/tmux中，修正读取保留20,033字符；可定位读取仍裁到2,576字符、通知worker，随后完整重读。每种两次受控生成调用、11个加载模块散列匹配；generator/NOOP压缩是控制边界。保留loader和观察断言失败及修正后的结果。控制中二次读取会更新缓存对象，不能将序列化结果视为裁剪后的冻结快照。历史极小预算及CLI/TUI证据保留原提交，本轮不冒称新CLI、Docker、浏览器、真实模型或真实压缩验收。CI、人工批准、合并和发布独立判断。

prs.title: feat(managed): add experimental Kubernetes deployment
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds an experimental one-command Helm installation for the signed Managed Agent control plane, a private co-located Hosted Harness and persistent MySQL. Optional trusted single-node LOCAL execution supports registered Workspaces, file tools and approved foreground Shell. An authenticated gateway serves the existing Managed-only browser interface and rejects ordinary daemon operations.

The installation uses a canonical Workspace identity in text and tool modes. The browser also keeps a single composer when permission rules are available and tool events update the conversation; previously a duplicate sibling identity left old composers on the page.

## Why it's needed

The existing Kubernetes Runtime and CSI support does not install a complete Managed Agent application. Browser access also needs a dedicated authorization boundary so its credential cannot become a general daemon operator credential.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Install the default text deployment with matching images and model configuration. Unsigned requests should fail; a signed Session should complete a model Turn, retain history and continue after an idle Pod replacement. Upgrades should preserve exact credentials. Uninstall should retain the database and credentials, and missing original credentials should prevent reinitializing retained storage.

In trusted LOCAL mode, create a Workspace, edit/read a file, approve a foreground test command and independently confirm its physical output occurs once. Denying a separate command should produce no file. A known-completed request replay should return its original Turn without another execution. Close tool Sessions and confirm original worker exit, drain receipts and clear holders before planned replacement; a new Session should read the retained Workspace afterward.

Authenticate through the browser form, create/select a Workspace, change a project file, approve a command and inspect the actual tool result. With permission rules enabled, conversation updates and Session switches should keep one composer. Ordinary daemon filesystem, Workspace, Session, settings, MCP, ACP and WebSocket routes should reject even an authenticated browser credential.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: no complete application installation chart or dedicated gateway entry point. A real browser run also exposed repeated composers when permission-rule controls and tool events were present. A focused pre-fix regression failed with two composers, and the production replay grew to 24 orphan DOM composers while React owned only one.

After: full source build/typecheck/bundle pass; CLI tests 222/222, entry UI tests 36/36, Managed conversation tests 151/151 and deployment tests 15/15 pass. Helm lint and strict schema validation pass for eight resources. The corrected source component tree retains one composer through 12 events with no duplicate-key warning.

Actual Linux arm64 kind checks passed application installation, anonymous 401, controlled-model text Turns, same-Session history and continuation after Pod replacement, credential-preserving tool upgrade, actual file changes, approved foreground Node test, known-completed idempotent replay, denied Shell and independent physical worker/holder/journal closure. The latest corrected chart was exercised in tool mode; the text restart run predates its canonical-identity correction. Both real browser runs completed their file Turn, then stopped at the composer defect; browser Shell and the post-fix Kubernetes browser flow remain unverified.

The rebuilt real bundled gateway passed independent browser verification against a controlled HTTP upstream: form login, Session creation, three Allow decisions and tool/SSE completion retained one DOM/current React composer and editor in all 18 samples; 25 forwarded requests passed HMAC and fixed-principal checks. This did not start Java or Kubernetes and does not replace post-fix cluster acceptance.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS arm64 | Build/typecheck/bundle, focused tests and real bundled-gateway checks pass |
| Windows | Not tested locally |
| Linux arm64 | CLI container, kind text/restart and API tools/physical-close pass; post-fix full browser flow pending |

### Environment

Isolated local VZ/Colima and kind, task-local Docker configuration and kubeconfig, with existing preview services untouched. Model calls used a controlled fixture, not a real provider. The original CLI Dockerfile and composite Runtime Dockerfile built successfully. Current-source Java SDK/server artifacts were compiled with host JDK 21, checked for matching embedded SDK, and packaged in a pinned official Linux JRE; the original multi-stage Java Dockerfile cold build and full Java suites were not completed.

The Linux images were built from tracked product source a4782e65; the later browser correction at 236f07a44 was rebuilt and verified as a macOS bundled gateway, and has not yet been installed in the Linux cluster. The user-authorized shared 60-minute Java/application budget was enforced. After normal Session closure and independent physical checks, port forwards and the task VM stopped before the deadline, retaining disks and evidence. Subsequent frontend-only reproductions used controlled upstream responses and did not restart Java or the cluster.

## Risk & Scope

- Experimental single replica with Recreate and downtime. LOCAL tools use the trusted server account; the gateway represents one fixed trusted tenant/actor.
- Close tool Sessions and verify original physical holders before planned replacement. A new Pod cannot adopt old LOCAL workers from another PID/time namespace. Background tools, multi-user SSO, HA, ACK/CSI and production acceptance are outside this change.
- Retain SQL, PVCs and the complete credential set. Do not automatically roll back schema-changing upgrades. Actual uninstall/reinstall, new-Session retained-Workspace reads, the post-fix Kubernetes browser flow, real-provider calls and required CI/full Java gates remain pending. Local rendering/controlled-peer tests do not establish those gates.

Designs: [Bootstrap English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/236f07a44f1b4615171567bb0e2e109d3165bae7/docs/design/2026-10-24-managed-agent-kubernetes.md), [Bootstrap Chinese](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/236f07a44f1b4615171567bb0e2e109d3165bae7/docs/design/2026-10-24-managed-agent-kubernetes.zh-CN.md), [Tools and WebShell English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/236f07a44f1b4615171567bb0e2e109d3165bae7/docs/design/2026-10-25-managed-agent-kubernetes-tools.md), [Tools and WebShell Chinese](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/236f07a44f1b4615171567bb0e2e109d3165bae7/docs/design/2026-10-25-managed-agent-kubernetes-tools.zh-CN.md). Both language pairs are complete and synchronized.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 变更

增加实验性的一条 Helm 命令安装入口，部署签名认证的 Managed Agent 控制面、同 Pod 私有 Hosted Harness 和持久化 MySQL。可选可信单节点 LOCAL 执行支持已注册 Workspace、文件工具和审批后的前台 Shell。认证网关提供现有 Managed-only 浏览器界面，并拒绝普通 daemon 操作。

文本和工具模式使用一致的规范 Workspace 身份。浏览器开启权限规则后，工具事件更新会话时也应保持单个输入框；此前两个兄弟组件身份重复，导致旧输入框遗留在页面中。

## 动机

现有 Kubernetes Runtime 和 CSI 支持没有安装完整的 Managed Agent 应用。浏览器还需要独立权限边界，防止其凭据变成通用 daemon 操作者凭据。

## 评审验证

### 验证方式

使用匹配镜像和模型配置安装默认文本部署。未签名请求应拒绝；签名 Session 应完成模型 Turn、保留历史，并在空闲 Pod 替换后继续。升级应保留精确凭据；卸载应保留数据库与凭据，缺少原凭据时应阻止对保留存储进行误初始化。

开启可信 LOCAL 模式，创建 Workspace、编辑/读取文件、批准前台测试命令，并独立确认物理输出只发生一次。拒绝另一个命令后不应产生文件。已完成请求重放应返回原 Turn，不能再次执行。计划替换前关闭工具 Session，检查原始 worker 退出、drain receipt 和 holder 清空；替换后的新 Session 应读取保留 Workspace。

通过表单认证、创建/选择 Workspace、修改项目文件、批准命令并查看实际工具结果。开启权限规则后，会话更新及 Session 切换应始终保留一个输入框。即使携带有效浏览器凭据，普通 daemon 的文件系统、Workspace、Session、settings、MCP、ACP 和 WebSocket 路由也应拒绝。

### 前后证据

之前没有完整应用安装 Chart 或专用网关入口。真实浏览器还发现开启权限规则并接收工具事件后输入框重复：修复前定向回归出现两个输入框，生产页面重放增长到 24 个遗留 DOM 输入框，而 React 当前树只有一个。

现在完整源码 build/typecheck/bundle、CLI 222/222、入口 UI 36/36、Managed 会话 151/151、部署测试 15/15 通过；Helm lint 和八个资源严格 schema 校验通过。修复后的真实源码组件树在 12 次事件更新中保持单输入框，无重复 key 警告。

真实 Linux arm64 kind 已通过应用安装、匿名 401、受控模型文本 Turn、Pod 替换后同 Session 历史与继续对话、保留凭据的工具模式升级、实际文件变更、批准前台 Node 测试、已完成请求幂等重放、拒绝 Shell，以及独立 worker/holder/journal 物理关闭检查。最新修正 Chart 已实跑工具模式；文本重启验收发生在规范身份修正之前。两次真实浏览器均完成文件 Turn 后因输入框缺陷而停止，浏览器 Shell 和修复后的 Kubernetes 浏览器全流程尚未验收。

修复后的真实 bundled 网关已通过受控 HTTP 上游复验：真实表单登录、创建 Session、三轮 Allow 审批及工具/SSE 链的 18 次采样均只有一个 DOM/当前 React 输入框和编辑器；25 个转发请求的 HMAC 和固定身份校验通过。该检查没有启动 Java 或 Kubernetes，不能代替修复后的集群全流程验收。

### 测试平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS arm64 | build/typecheck/bundle、定向测试、真实 bundled 网关检查通过 |
| Windows | 未本地验证 |
| Linux arm64 | CLI 容器、kind 文本/重启和 API 工具/物理关闭通过；修复后完整浏览器流程待验证 |

### 环境

使用隔离的本地 VZ/Colima 和 kind、任务专用 Docker 配置及 kubeconfig，没有修改现有预览服务。模型调用使用受控 fixture，不是真实 provider。原始 CLI Dockerfile 和组合 Runtime Dockerfile 已构建成功。当前源码的 Java SDK/server 使用宿主 JDK 21 编译，核对内嵌 SDK 匹配后装入固定官方 Linux JRE；原始多阶段 Java Dockerfile 冷构建及完整 Java suites 尚未完成。

Linux 镜像来自 tracked 产品源码 a4782e65；之后的浏览器修复 236f07a44 已重新构建并通过 macOS bundled 网关验证，尚未装入 Linux 集群。严格遵守用户批准的共享 60 分钟 Java/应用验证预算。正常关闭 Session 并完成独立物理检查后，port-forward 和任务 VM 在截止前停止，磁盘与证据保留。之后仅运行受控上游响应的前端离线复现，没有重启 Java 或集群。

## 风险与范围

- 实验性单副本使用 Recreate，存在停机时间。LOCAL 工具以可信服务账号运行，网关代表固定的一个可信 tenant/actor。
- 计划替换前必须关闭工具 Session 并核验原始物理 holder。新 Pod 不能接管不同 PID/time namespace 的旧 LOCAL worker。后台工具、多用户 SSO、HA、ACK/CSI 和生产验收不属于本次范围。
- 保留 SQL、PVC 和完整凭据集合。禁止自动回滚改变 schema 的升级。真实卸载/重装、新 Session 读取保留 Workspace、修复后的 Kubernetes 浏览器流程、真实 provider 调用及必需 CI/完整 Java gates 仍待完成。本地渲染和受控 peer 测试不等价于这些门槛。

上方链接提供 Bootstrap 与工具/WebShell 两份设计的英文及中文版本；两个语言对均完整同步。没有关联 issue。
