prs.title: fix(cli): stop double-counting reasoning tokens in cost estimates
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Model cost estimates derived the billable output token count as `candidates + thoughts` at four places. That is correct for the Gemini-style usage convention, where `thoughts` is disjoint from `candidates`, but OpenAI-style providers already include reasoning tokens inside `candidates` — and their reported `total` reflects that — so the reasoning got billed twice.

This adds one shared helper, `billableOutputTokens(tokens)`, next to `calculateCost` in `packages/cli/src/utils/costCalculator.ts:67`, and all four cost sites now call it. It derives output as `total - prompt`, which is correct under both conventions, and trusts that derivation only inside the band the two conventions allow:

```ts
const derived = total - prompt;
if (derived >= candidates && derived <= candidates + thoughts) return derived;
return candidates + thoughts;
```

Outside the band an operand did not survive the provider, so it falls back to summing rather than guessing whether `thoughts` is folded into `candidates` — that depends on the provider's `auth_type`, which an accumulated bucket no longer carries, and guessing wrong would drop a disjoint provider's reasoning from the bill entirely. The `total − prompt` derivation itself is the one already used by `commands/review/cost-ledger.ts:170-176`.

Four sites, all reached from the same `ModelMetricsCore.tokens` shape:

| Site | Bills | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui/components/ModelStatsDisplay.tsx:120` — `hasPricing` probe | per `(model, source)` bucket | `billableOutputTokens(metrics.tokens)` |
| `ui/components/ModelStatsDisplay.tsx:269` — `Estimated` row | per `(model, source)` bucket | same helper |
| `ui/opentui/item-projection.ts:250` — `entryCost` | per `(model, source)` bucket | same helper |
| `ui/commands/statsCommand.ts:790-795` — non-interactive `/stats model` | **sum over the model's `bySource` buckets** | same helper, per bucket |

The last row is not symmetric with the other three, and that is deliberate. `billableOutputTokens` is a clamp, so it is **not additive**: `f(Σ buckets) ≠ Σ f(bucket)`. `uiTelemetry.ts:644-645` feeds every event into both the model aggregate and its per-source bucket from the same raw counters, so the aggregate is exactly the sum of the buckets — which made the deleted `candidates + thoughts` additive and the new clamp non-additive. Billing the aggregate at this one site would therefore disagree with the panel, and can fall straight back into the double count:

```
main       {prompt:100000, candidates:150000, thoughts:120000, total:250000} -> f = 150000
researcher {prompt:0,      candidates:0,      thoughts:0,      total:250000} -> f =      0
Σ f(bucket) = 150000  ($0.1500)   <- what the panel renders
aggregate   = {prompt:100000, candidates:150000, thoughts:120000, total:500000}
f(aggregate) = 270000 ($0.2700)   <- the exact pre-PR double count
```

So `/stats model` sums the same buckets the panel renders. `Object.values(bySource)` with an aggregate fallback mirrors `flattenModelsBySource` (`ui/utils/modelsBySource.ts:54`) in all three of its branches — empty `bySource`, session-wide main-only collapse, and multi-source split — so the two surfaces stay equal by construction rather than by coincidence.

`tokens.total` is the provider total: `packages/core/src/telemetry/uiTelemetry.ts:236` returns `event.total_token_count` when it is positive, and its fallback at `:242-248` already special-cases `openai` / `qwen-oauth` precisely because those providers fold reasoning into the output count. That is why deriving from `total` is sound here rather than a second guess.

## Why it's needed

With `prompt=100000, candidates=150000, thoughts=120000, total=250000` (OpenAI-style — reasoning already inside `candidates`), the output came out as `270000` instead of the `150000` the provider reported. Priced at $1/M output that renders `$0.2700` where `$0.1500` is correct: the estimate is inflated by the entire reasoning count, and the inflation grows with how much the model thinks.

The fix is provably a no-op on the disjoint convention. With `prompt=100000, candidates=50000, thoughts=120000, total=270000`, `total - prompt = 170000` already equals `candidates + thoughts = 170000`.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the four affected files:

```
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run \
  src/utils/costCalculator.test.ts \
  src/ui/commands/statsCommand.test.ts \
  src/ui/components/ModelStatsDisplay.test.tsx \
  src/ui/opentui/item-projection.test.ts --coverage=false
```

`Test Files 4 passed (4)`, `Tests 138 passed (138)` — `costCalculator` 24, `statsCommand` 41, `ModelStatsDisplay` 18, `item-projection` 55.

The helper itself is pinned by six legs in `costCalculator.test.ts` under `describe('billableOutputTokens')`: both conventions in band, a total-only record, a cached-only prompt coerced to 0, a short total below `candidates`, the inclusive lower bound, and the no-usable-total fallback.

Each surface then gets a leg driving the real render path, priced at `{ inputPerMillionTokens: 0, outputPerMillionTokens: 1 }` so the rendered dollar figure is exactly `outputTokens / 1_000_000` and isolates the output term:

- `item-projection.test.ts` — six legs under `describe('cost does not double-count included reasoning tokens (#15444)')`, driving the exported `projectModelStats` (so the module-private `entryCost` is exercised as a pure function — no API traffic, no render harness). The OpenAI leg asserts `Estimated $0.1500` and `not.toContain('$0.2700')`; the Gemini leg asserts `$0.1700` is unchanged, without which an implementation that dropped thinking entirely would still pass.
- `ModelStatsDisplay.test.tsx` — one OpenAI-shaped leg on the ink surface.
- `statsCommand.test.ts` — two legs on the non-interactive surface: the OpenAI shape, and a **two-bucket** leg asserting `$0.1620` with `not.toContain('$0.2020')` to pin the per-bucket granularity.

Confirmed red on unfixed code first, verbatim:

```
× cost does not double-count included reasoning tokens (#15444) > bills total − prompt when reasoning is already inside candidates
AssertionError: expected 'Model Stats For Nerds\n\nqwen3-max\nA…' to contain 'Estimated $0.1500'
- Estimated $0.1500
+ Estimated $0.2700
 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  1 failed | 46 passed (47)
```

**Injected-mutation witness.** Every mutation was applied alone (never several at once — their effects can cancel), the whole test file re-run (never `-t`), the pattern's occurrence count asserted `== 1` before substitution, and the file restored afterwards with `diff -q` against a pristine copy:

| Mutation | Surface | Result | Caught by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| M1 revert `statsCommand` to `f(model aggregate)` | `statsCommand.test.ts` | rc=1, 1 failed | the `$0.1620` leg |
| M2 `f(bucket)` → plain `bucket.tokens.candidates` | `statsCommand.test.ts` | rc=1, 1 failed | the `$0.1620` leg |
| M3 `f(bucket)` → pre-PR `candidates + thoughts` | `statsCommand.test.ts` | rc=1, 2 failed | both `#15444` legs |
| M4 `hasPricing` probe → `candidates + thoughts` | `ModelStatsDisplay.test.tsx` | rc=0, 18 passed | **survives — see Risk & Scope** |

Baseline for each, unmutated: rc=0. M4 is reported honestly as a survivor rather than papered over with a fixture; the reachability argument is in Risk & Scope.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Rendered by the projection's own text output for the same synthesized metrics — before is unfixed `main`, after is this branch:

| Shape | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| OpenAI (`total=250000`) | `Estimated $0.2700` | `Estimated $0.1500` |
| Gemini (`total=270000`) | `Estimated $0.1700` | `Estimated $0.1700` (unchanged) |
| No total (`total=0`) | `Estimated $0.1700` | `Estimated $0.1700` (unchanged) |
| Two buckets, one out of band (non-interactive `/stats model`) | `Estimated cost: $0.2820` | `Estimated cost: $0.1620` |

No screenshot or recording: the defect is arithmetic on synthesized metrics and this host has no browser, so there is no live TUI to capture. The strings above are the actual return values of `projectModelStats` and the `/stats model` action.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only (`vitest`), Linux. Commands run:

- `npx vitest run <the 4 files above> --coverage=false` → `Test Files 4 passed (4)`, `Tests 138 passed (138)`
- `npx eslint --max-warnings 0 --no-warn-ignored <the changed .ts/.tsx>` → rc=0
- `npx prettier --check <the changed files>` → rc=0
- `npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/cli` → rc=2 with **exactly 2 errors**, both pre-existing `TS6305` for `packages/core/dist/src/utils/toml-to-markdown-converter{,.test}.d.ts` — core's `dist` is not built on this host. `TS2300` count is 0 (the duplicate-identifier probe for merge residue), and **no error mentions any file this PR touches**. So this is not a "0 errors" claim, it is "no error attributable to this diff, plus a known 2-error host baseline".

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the band changes which number is billed whenever the provider reports a usable `total`. On the disjoint (Gemini) convention the two derivations are arithmetically identical, so the observable change is confined to providers that fold reasoning into `candidates` — which is the bug being fixed.
- **Known limitation of the band (not a regression, disclosed rather than fixed here).** The band is a tolerance of width `thoughts`, not a proof, so an accounting error smaller than a bucket's `thoughts` passes silently in both directions. Because `uiTelemetry.ts:644-645` feeds `models` and `bySource` the **raw** `event.input_token_count` / `event.total_token_count` — unlike `statsModels` at `:646-652`, which gets `normalizedPromptTokens` / `normalizedTotalTokens` — one bucket can mix inconsistent records: a cache-hit response contributes `0` to `prompt` while `total` keeps the cache, and a response with `total_token_count === 0` contributes nothing to `total` while its prompt and output still land. Mixed inside a single bucket, the error can stay inside the band. Measured, over-billing `{prompt:100000, candidates:160000, thoughts:122000, total:302000, cached:40000}` gives `202000` where the true OpenAI-style output is `160000`; at the base SHA the same record billed `candidates + thoughts = 282000`, so this PR is strictly closer (+42000 vs +122000), which is why it is a limitation and not a regression. The symmetric under-bill is `{prompt:120000, candidates:60000, thoughts:120000, total:270000}` → `150000` instead of `180000`. The complete fix is producer-side — give the buckets the same normalized values `statsModels` already gets — and belongs in a separate change to `packages/core`, not in this cost-derivation PR.
- **Why M4 survives, and why that is the correct result.** `calculateCost` returns null once pricing exists only when `inputTokens <= 0 && outputTokens <= 0`, so the `hasPricing` probe can differ between `billableOutputTokens(t)` and `candidates + thoughts` only when `prompt <= 0` and exactly one of the two is `<= 0`. Solving that gives a single record shape: `{prompt: 0, candidates: 0, thoughts > 0, total: 0}`. A brute-force sweep of 625 records confirms exactly those and no others. Producing it needs an API response event with `input_token_count === 0`, `output_token_count === 0`, `total_token_count === 0` and `thoughts_token_count > 0` — a response reporting reasoning and nothing else. Adding a leg for it would pin an unreachable branch, so the gap is recorded instead. Note also that the probe and the `Estimated` row call the identical expression, so they cannot disagree in the harmful direction (section hidden while a row has a cost); the only divergence is a cosmetic all-`N/A` section on that impossible record.
- Not validated / out of scope: the producer-side normalization above. The counts shown in the Tokens section are deliberately untouched; only the Cost derivation changed. `statsCommand.ts:783` still prints `output=<candidates>`, which is a raw counter, not the billed term — pre-existing in kind and left alone.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15444

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

模型成本估算在四处把可计费的 output token 数算成 `candidates + thoughts`。这对 Gemini 式 usage 约定是对的（`thoughts` 与 `candidates` 互不重叠），但 OpenAI 式 provider 的 reasoning token 本来就已经包含在 `candidates` 里（它上报的 `total` 也是这么算的），于是 reasoning 被重复计了一次费。

本 PR 在 `packages/cli/src/utils/costCalculator.ts:67` 的 `calculateCost` 旁边新增一个共享 helper `billableOutputTokens(tokens)`，四处成本调用点统一改为调用它。它用 `total - prompt` 推导 output —— 这个式子在两种约定下都成立 —— 并且只在两种约定所允许的区间内信任这个推导值：

```ts
const derived = total - prompt;
if (derived >= candidates && derived <= candidates + thoughts) return derived;
return candidates + thoughts;
```

区间之外说明有某个操作数没能从 provider 完整传下来，此时回退到求和，而不是去猜 `thoughts` 是否被折进了 `candidates` —— 那取决于 provider 的 `auth_type`，而累加后的 bucket 已经不再携带这个信息，猜错就会把互不重叠型 provider 的 reasoning 整个从账单里丢掉。`total − prompt` 这个推导本身就是 `commands/review/cost-ledger.ts:170-176` 已经在用的写法。

四处改动，读的都是同一个 `ModelMetricsCore.tokens` 结构：`ModelStatsDisplay.tsx:120` 的 `hasPricing` 探测与 `:269` 的 `Estimated` 行、`item-projection.ts:250` 的 `entryCost` 都按 `(model, source)` 分桶计费；`statsCommand.ts:790-795` 的非交互式 `/stats model` 则**对该模型的 `bySource` 各桶求和**。

最后一行与前三处不对称，这是刻意的。`billableOutputTokens` 是一个钳位，因此**不满足可加性**：`f(Σ buckets) ≠ Σ f(bucket)`。`uiTelemetry.ts:644-645` 把每个事件用同一份原始计数同时累加进模型聚合与对应的 source 桶，所以聚合恰好等于各桶之和 —— 这意味着被删掉的 `candidates + thoughts` 是可加的，而新的钳位不是。因此在这一处对聚合计费会与面板不一致，并且会直接退回本 PR 要修的那个重复计费：

```
main       {prompt:100000, candidates:150000, thoughts:120000, total:250000} -> f = 150000
researcher {prompt:0,      candidates:0,      thoughts:0,      total:250000} -> f =      0
Σ f(bucket) = 150000  ($0.1500)   <- 面板渲染的值
aggregate   = {prompt:100000, candidates:150000, thoughts:120000, total:500000}
f(aggregate) = 270000 ($0.2700)   <- 正是修复前的重复计费值
```

所以 `/stats model` 改为对面板渲染的同一批桶求和。带聚合兜底的 `Object.values(bySource)` 与 `flattenModelsBySource`（`ui/utils/modelsBySource.ts:54`）在它的三个分支上完全对应 —— `bySource` 为空、会话级只有 main 的折叠、以及多 source 拆分 —— 因此两个界面相等是构造上成立的，不是巧合。

`tokens.total` 就是 provider 上报的 total：`packages/core/src/telemetry/uiTelemetry.ts:236` 在 `event.total_token_count` 为正时直接返回它，而 `:242-248` 的兜底分支本来就专门区分了 `openai` / `qwen-oauth` —— 正因为这两类 provider 把 reasoning 折进了 output。所以在这里基于 `total` 推导是有依据的，不是第二次猜测。

## 为什么需要

当 `prompt=100000, candidates=150000, thoughts=120000, total=250000`（OpenAI 式，reasoning 已在 `candidates` 内）时，output 被算成 `270000`，而 provider 实际上报的是 `150000`。按 $1/M output 计价，界面显示 `$0.2700`，正确值是 `$0.1500`：估算被整整一份 reasoning 的量抬高，而且模型想得越多、抬得越高。

这个修复对互不重叠的约定是可证明的 no-op。当 `prompt=100000, candidates=50000, thoughts=120000, total=270000` 时，`total - prompt = 170000` 本来就等于 `candidates + thoughts = 170000`。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

跑受影响的四个文件：`cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/utils/costCalculator.test.ts src/ui/commands/statsCommand.test.ts src/ui/components/ModelStatsDisplay.test.tsx src/ui/opentui/item-projection.test.ts --coverage=false`，结果 `Test Files 4 passed (4)`、`Tests 138 passed (138)`（costCalculator 24、statsCommand 41、ModelStatsDisplay 18、item-projection 55）。

helper 本身由 `costCalculator.test.ts` 中 `describe('billableOutputTokens')` 的六条用例钉住：两种约定在区间内、只有 total 的记录、prompt 被强制归零的纯缓存记录、total 短于 `candidates`、下界取等、以及没有可用 total 时的回退。

各个界面再各有一条走真实渲染路径的用例，定价取 `{ inputPerMillionTokens: 0, outputPerMillionTokens: 1 }`，使渲染出的美元数字恰好等于 `outputTokens / 1_000_000`，从而把 output 项单独隔离出来：`item-projection.test.ts` 六条（驱动导出的 `projectModelStats`，因此模块私有的 `entryCost` 是以纯函数方式被覆盖的，不需要 API 流量也不需要渲染框架），OpenAI 那条断言 `Estimated $0.1500` 且 `not.toContain('$0.2700')`，Gemini 那条断言 `$0.1700` 保持不变（缺了它，一个把 thinking 整个丢掉的实现也能通过 OpenAI 那条）；`ModelStatsDisplay.test.tsx` 一条 OpenAI 形态；`statsCommand.test.ts` 两条 —— OpenAI 形态，以及一条**双桶**用例断言 `$0.1620` 且 `not.toContain('$0.2020')`，用来钉住按桶计费的粒度。

先在未修复代码上确认见红，原始输出：

```
× cost does not double-count included reasoning tokens (#15444) > bills total − prompt when reasoning is already inside candidates
AssertionError: expected 'Model Stats For Nerds\n\nqwen3-max\nA…' to contain 'Estimated $0.1500'
- Estimated $0.1500
+ Estimated $0.2700
 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  1 failed | 46 passed (47)
```

**注入式变异见证。** 每个变异都单独施加（从不同时施加多个 —— 它们的效果会互相抵消），重跑整个测试文件（从不使用 `-t`），替换前先断言该模式在文件中出现次数 `== 1`，随后用 `diff -q` 对照原始副本还原：M1 把 `statsCommand` 改回对聚合取 `f` → rc=1、1 failed，被 `$0.1620` 那条抓到；M2 把 `f(bucket)` 换成裸 `bucket.tokens.candidates` → rc=1、1 failed，同样被 `$0.1620` 那条抓到；M3 把 `f(bucket)` 换成修复前的 `candidates + thoughts` → rc=1、2 failed，两条 `#15444` 用例都抓到；M4 把 `hasPricing` 探测换成 `candidates + thoughts` → rc=0、18 passed，**存活**（见「风险与范围」）。每个变异未施加时的基线都是 rc=0。M4 如实报告为存活变异，没有用一个人造 fixture 把它盖过去，可达性论证写在「风险与范围」里。

### 前后对照证据

下表是同一份合成指标下、投影函数与非交互式 `/stats model` 自身文本输出的结果，before 为未修复的 `main`，after 为本分支：OpenAI 形态（`total=250000`）由 `Estimated $0.2700` 变为 `Estimated $0.1500`；Gemini 形态（`total=270000`）前后都是 `Estimated $0.1700`；没有 total 的形态（`total=0`）前后也都是 `Estimated $0.1700`；两个桶且其中一个落在区间外的形态，非交互式 `/stats model` 由 `Estimated cost: $0.2820` 变为 `Estimated cost: $0.1620`。

没有截图或录屏：这个缺陷是对合成指标的算术，且本机没有浏览器，因此没有可采集的实时 TUI。上面的字符串是 `projectModelStats` 与 `/stats model` action 的实际返回值。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

仅单元测试（`vitest`），Linux。执行的命令：上述四个文件的 `vitest` → `Test Files 4 passed (4)`、`Tests 138 passed (138)`；`npx eslint --max-warnings 0 --no-warn-ignored <改动的 .ts/.tsx>` → rc=0；`npx prettier --check <改动文件>` → rc=0；`npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/cli` → rc=2，**恰好 2 条错误**，都是本机没有构建 `packages/core/dist` 导致的既有 `TS6305`（`packages/core/dist/src/utils/toml-to-markdown-converter{,.test}.d.ts`）。`TS2300` 计数为 0（这是探测合并残留重复标识符的探针），且**没有任何一条错误提到本 PR 改动的文件**。所以这里不是「0 errors」的声明，而是「没有可归因于本 diff 的错误，外加一个已知的 2 条宿主机基线」。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：只要 provider 上报了可用的 `total`，区间就会改变用于计费的那个数。在互不重叠（Gemini）的约定下两种推导在算术上完全相同，所以可观察到的变化被限定在把 reasoning 折进 `candidates` 的 provider 上 —— 而这正是要修的缺陷。
- **区间的已知局限（不是回归，这里选择披露而不是修）。** 区间是一个宽度为 `thoughts` 的容差，不是一个证明，因此小于该桶 `thoughts` 的记账误差会在两个方向上都静默通过。由于 `uiTelemetry.ts:644-645` 喂给 `models` 与 `bySource` 的是**原始**的 `event.input_token_count` / `event.total_token_count` —— 而 `:646-652` 的 `statsModels` 拿到的是 `normalizedPromptTokens` / `normalizedTotalTokens` —— 同一个桶里可能混进互相不一致的记录：命中缓存的响应给 `prompt` 贡献 `0`，而 `total` 仍带着缓存量；`total_token_count === 0` 的响应给 `total` 贡献 0，而它的 prompt 与 output 照样落进桶里。混在同一个桶内时，误差可能仍留在区间内。实测多计费：`{prompt:100000, candidates:160000, thoughts:122000, total:302000, cached:40000}` 得到 `202000`，而 OpenAI 约定下真实 output 是 `160000`；在 base SHA 上同一条记录计的是 `candidates + thoughts = 282000`，所以本 PR 是严格更接近的（+42000 对 +122000），这也是它属于局限而非回归的原因。对称方向的少计费是 `{prompt:120000, candidates:60000, thoughts:120000, total:270000}` → 得到 `150000` 而不是 `180000`。完整的修法在生产侧 —— 让这些桶拿到 `statsModels` 已经在用的那份归一化值 —— 那属于 `packages/core` 的独立改动，不该塞进这个成本推导 PR。
- **M4 为什么存活，以及为什么这是正确结果。** 在定价存在的前提下，`calculateCost` 只在 `inputTokens <= 0 && outputTokens <= 0` 时返回 null，所以 `hasPricing` 探测要在 `billableOutputTokens(t)` 与 `candidates + thoughts` 之间产生差异，只可能是 `prompt <= 0` 且两者中恰好一个 `<= 0`。解这个条件得到唯一一种记录形态：`{prompt: 0, candidates: 0, thoughts > 0, total: 0}`。对 625 条记录做穷举扫描，确认差异集合恰好就是这些、没有别的。要造出它，需要一条 `input_token_count === 0`、`output_token_count === 0`、`total_token_count === 0` 而 `thoughts_token_count > 0` 的 API 响应事件 —— 一条只上报 reasoning、别的什么都没有的响应。为它补一条用例等于钉住一个不可达分支，所以这里选择记录这个缺口。另外，探测与 `Estimated` 行调用的是完全相同的表达式，因此它们不会在有害的方向上不一致（区块被隐藏而某行其实有成本）；唯一的分歧是在那条不可能的记录上多渲染一个全为 `N/A` 的区块，属于外观问题。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：上面那条生产侧归一化。Tokens 区块显示的各项计数有意未改动，只改了 Cost 的推导。`statsCommand.ts:783` 仍然打印 `output=<candidates>`，那是原始计数而不是计费项 —— 形态上是既有行为，本次不动。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

Fixes #15444

prs.title: fix(ci): run the sdk-java suite before taking the host lock
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The self-hosted SDK Java test lane now seeds a job-local Maven repository from the host cache, runs the SDK suite, the SDK install, and the Managed Agent suite from that copy without the per-host lock, and takes the ticketed host lock only for the final cache write-back. The write-back's `mkdir` and bounded `find`/`cp` children close fd 9 so a cancelled job's survivor cannot retain the lock. Both lock sites in the workflow now follow the same write-back-only rule, and the cache loop is unchanged.

## Why it's needed

Run 39771949573's fast-tier job failed in `Run Java SDK tests (self-hosted)` on both attempts, each time after exactly 5400 seconds, with the annotation `sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes as queue ticket 223 (fast)`. The job was waiting, not testing: the full-tier Java 21 leg of run 39754414693 ran for 89 minutes on the same host range, and the fast job failed five seconds after that leg ended. #15128 scoped the MariaDB lane's lock to its cache write-back, but the test job still serialized its whole suite on the same lock. A loaded host can therefore consume the entire fast-tier budget before Maven starts. This change removes that failure mode for the fast tier and shortens the test job's own hold to the write-back.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Inspect the self-hosted test step: the job-local repository seed and every Maven command should appear before the `source .../sdk-java-lock.sh` acquisition, and the write-back should follow it with `mkdir ... 9>&-` and the bounded `find ... 9>&-` copy. Run `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts sdk-java-workflow workflow-size` from the repository root and expect 351 passed, 1 skipped. On the next ECS pool run, the `Run Java SDK tests (self-hosted)` step should start Maven without a `Waiting for the sdk-java host lock` line; any lock wait is now limited to the final write-back.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — CI-only change; no user-visible interface.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.23.2 on Linux. Java and Maven are not installed in the sandbox, so the Java suites were not run locally; the workflow and its Node pins were verified.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the test job's Maven suites now run concurrently with other pool jobs instead of serializing on the host lock. This follows #15128's write-back-only scoping for the MariaDB lane; the host-shared Maven cache is still protected by the seed/write-back lock, and the write-back children close fd 9.
- Not validated / out of scope: the Maven suites themselves on a real ECS host (CI owns that), and any change to the 5400 s budget or the job ceilings.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The `lock not acquired within` signature, the bare-lock fallback for older release tags, and the tier priority are unchanged.
- Design docs: [English](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15242

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

self-hosted 的 SDK Java test 通道现在从宿主机缓存播种一个 job 本地 Maven 仓库，SDK 套件、SDK install 和 Managed Agent 套件都从该副本运行且不持每宿主机锁，只在最后的缓存写回时获取票据锁。写回的 `mkdir` 和有界 `find`/`cp` 子进程会关闭 fd 9，避免被取消 job 的幸存进程继续持有锁。workflow 的两处取锁点现在都遵循“只锁写回”的规则，缓存循环保持不变。

## 为什么需要

Run 39771949573 的 fast 档 job 两次 attempt 都在 `Run Java SDK tests (self-hosted)` 失败，每次恰好 5400 秒，annotation 为 `sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes as queue ticket 223 (fast)`。它是在等待，不是测试：run 39754414693 的 full 档 Java 21 leg 在同一宿主机范围运行了 89 分钟，而 fast job 在该 leg 结束后 5 秒失败。#15128 已把 MariaDB 通道的锁收缩到缓存写回，但 test job 仍把整套测试串行在同一把锁上。负载高的宿主机因此可以在 Maven 启动前耗尽 fast 档的全部预算。本改动消除 fast 档的这一失败模式，并把 test job 自身的持锁缩短到写回。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

检查 self-hosted test 步骤：job 本地仓库的播种和所有 Maven 命令都应出现在 `source .../sdk-java-lock.sh` 取锁之前，写回应在其后，并带有 `mkdir ... 9>&-` 和有界 `find ... 9>&-` 复制。在仓库根目录运行 `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts sdk-java-workflow workflow-size`，预期 351 通过、1 跳过。下一次 ECS 池运行时，`Run Java SDK tests (self-hosted)` 步骤应当不再打印 `Waiting for the sdk-java host lock` 就开始 Maven；任何锁等待现在都只可能发生在最后的写回。

### 证据（Before & After）

N/A —— 仅 CI 改动，没有用户可见界面。

### 测试环境

| OS | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ 已测试 |

### 环境（可选）

Linux 上的 Node 22.23.2。沙箱未安装 Java 和 Maven，因此 Java 套件未在本地运行；已验证 workflow 及其 Node pin。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：test job 的 Maven 套件现在会与其他池 job 并发运行，而不是在宿主机锁上串行。这遵循 #15128 为 MariaDB 通道确立的“只锁写回”范围；宿主机共享 Maven 缓存仍由播种/写回锁保护，且写回子进程会关闭 fd 9。
- 未验证 / 范围外：真实 ECS 宿主机上的 Maven 套件本身（由 CI 负责），以及 5400 秒预算或 job 上限的任何改动。
- 破坏性改动 / 迁移说明：无。`lock not acquired within` 签名、旧 release tag 的裸锁回退和档位优先级都保持不变。
- 设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 issue

Fixes #15242

auto_merge.commit_title: fix(ci): run the sdk-java suite before taking the host lock (#15254)
auto_merge.commit_message:
* fix(ci): run the sdk-java suite before taking the host lock (#15242)

Run 39771949573's fast-tier job spent both attempts' full 5400 s lock
budget waiting: the full-tier Java 21 leg of run 39754414693 ran for 89
minutes on the same host, and the fast job failed five seconds after that
leg ended. The MariaDB lane's #15128 fix scoped the lock to its cache
write-back, but the test job still held the host lock across the SDK and
Managed Agent Maven suites.

Seed the test job's Maven repository from the host cache, run its suite
from that job-local copy, and take the ticketed host lock only for the
cache write-back. The write-back children close fd 9 so a cancelled job's
survivor cannot retain the lock, and the workflow pins move with the new
order.

* fix(ci): keep the SDK Java gate green when the write-back lock expires (#15242)

The write-back lock acquisition could redden a job whose suite had already passed (CI run 39814549427). Treat it like the best-effort copy it guards: warn and skip on timeout in both the helper and fallback arms, while leaving the helper's pinned lock-not-acquired signature alone.

Tighten the workflow pins: assert the region below the lock instead of first-occurrence Maven indices, pin both write-back copies byte-equal, bind the job-local MAVEN_ARGS to its step, and include the write-back bound in the test job's ceiling model. Restate the hold-length derivations and record the concurrency blast radius in both design languages.

Co-authored-by: Qwen-Coder <qwen-coder@alibabacloud.com>

* fix(ci): keep the lock helper outside this PR's footprint (#15242)

Co-authored-by: Qwen-Coder <qwen-coder@alibabacloud.com>

* fix(ci): describe the sdk-java 89-minute leg as the leg, not the suite (#15242)

Co-authored-by: Qwen-Coder <qwen-coder@alibabacloud.com>

* fix(ci): keep tolerated sdk-java lock timeouts out of rerun classification (#15242)

The warn-and-skip downgrade left the helper's `lock not acquired within`
annotation on a step that now exits 0, so a later genuine failure in the
same job could be classified as infrastructure. Both call sites rewrite
the timeout line before it reaches the log, and probe flock plus the cache
directory first: bash suppresses errexit for a function on the left of
`||`, so without the probes a setup fault spun out the full wait green.

The skip test now plants a publishable delta, asserts nothing was
published, checks the captured annotations against the live
INFRA_FAILURE_SIGNATURES list, and adds a setup-fault arm. The workflow
size baseline is re-measured, and the design docs' classifier, promotion,
and budget claims are corrected in both languages.

prs.title: feat(mods): observe turn start and completion
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Mods can now follow the main loop's turns. `turn.start` and `turn.complete` hooks run in headless runs and in the Ink and OpenTUI terminals, in the shapes Claude Code 2.1.309 declares, and `$.turn.abort` ends the running turn.

- `turn.start` fires once UserPromptSubmit admits a prompt, before the first model request. It carries the prompt as submitted and a new `turnId`.
  - A prompt that a hook blocks has no turn.
  - The model request does not wait for the hooks; the turn's tool middleware and its end queue behind them.
  - Cancelling the turn also ends `turn.start` hooks that are still running, as in Claude Code.
- `turn.complete` fires once when the turn ends. It carries:
  - `answer`: the visible text of the turn's last model response;
  - `durationMs`;
  - `reason` and `isAborted`: `answer`, `aborted` or `error`;
  - `turnId`;
  - `usage`: the four API token counts summed over the turn's own model responses, and the model of the last one.
- A `turn.complete` hook that returns a different `{ text }` shows it beneath the answer, and the conversation record keeps the answer:
  - in a terminal, as a `[Mod <plugins>]` transcript line;
  - in headless text mode, on stderr after the answer;
  - in JSON modes, as a `system`/`ui_log` message before the result.
- A prompt or answer longer than 128 KiB as JSON keeps its head and tail around `[... truncated for Mods ...]`, so it still fits the Mod payload, and the event carries `isTextTruncated` or `isAnswerTruncated`. Claude Code passes it whole.
- `$.turn.abort({ turnId })` ends the running turn and its tools as a cancel does. It leaves no "Request cancelled." notice and does not restore the prompt to the composer.
  - The host judges the id. The call rejects when no turn is running, when the id is another turn's, or when the turn is already ending.
  - In headless runs the turn ends with the error result "A Mod ended the turn." and exit code 130; a stream-json session goes on.
  - A person's Esc still counts when it comes too, before or after the Mod's call.
- Turns are the prompts a person submits: typed, piped or from a command, plus Ctrl+Y retries and the headless continuation of an interrupted turn. Subagent and teammate turns, scheduled prompts, notifications and goal continuations fire no turn events.
- Headless runs fire them on both loops: the current one and the shared agent loop behind `experimental.unifiedAgentLoop` (#15369).
- Core gains one `sendMessageStream` option, `onPromptAdmitted`, called once after UserPromptSubmit lets the prompt through. Turn events do not depend on classic hooks, so a session with only Mods dispatches them.
- It also fixes a shared agent loop bug that the turn events exposed (commit `fix(cli): end an interrupted shared-loop tool batch with its result`). An interrupt during a tool call made `runNonInteractive` reject instead of ending with the interrupted result, so a stream-json session got no result for that turn.

Design: [English](docs/design/2026-10-24-mod-turn-events.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-24-mod-turn-events.zh-CN.md). User guide: the new "Turn events" section of `docs/users/extension/mods.md`.

## Why it's needed

Mods written for Claude Code follow turns:

- Token Weather, the first milestone sample in #13749, reads `$.session.usage()` in `turn.complete` after every turn.
- Summary Mods return a line from `turn.complete`.
- Guards end a turn with `$.turn.abort`.

Until now Qwen Code skipped these hooks at load ("Hooks for unsupported events will not run: turn.complete, turn.start"), and `$.turn.abort` threw `Mod API not supported`.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Unit tests:
   - `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/mods src/core/client.test.ts src/telemetry/uiTelemetry.test.ts`
   - `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/services/mod-session.test.ts src/nonInteractiveCli.test.ts src/ui/hooks/use-llm-stream.test.tsx src/ui/opentui/live-turn.test.ts src/ui/opentui/live-session.test.ts`
   - `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/mod-worker-bundle.test.js`
2. End to end: install a Mod that logs `turn.start`/`turn.complete`, aborts its own turn from a `tool.call` hook, and returns `{ text }` from `turn.complete`. Then run it against a local OpenAI-compatible fixture:
   - headless JSON, text, abort, and a 300,000-character prompt and answer, on both loops (`QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_UNIFIED_AGENT_LOOP=1` for the shared one);
   - Ink and OpenTUI: a turn with a tool call, a Mod abort, Esc during a running tool, a second answer, and a failed request retried with Ctrl+Y.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The end-to-end runs use the built bundle, an isolated home, YOLO, and a loopback OpenAI-compatible fixture. The fixture's tool turn reports prompt tokens 111111 (1000 cached) and then 222222 (2000 cached), with 7 and 9 completion tokens.

**Before** (a bundle of the #15348 head, without this change; the same Mod and prompts):

- Startup: `Hooks for unsupported events will not run: turn.complete, turn.start`.
- The JSON run answers with no turn hooks and no note.
- In the abort run, `$.turn.abort` throws `Mod API not supported`, so the hook is skipped. The `echo` it meant to stop runs, its result goes back to the model, and the run exits 0.

Review round (each finding reproduced with a scratch test at `fa0ac1f0de`):

- `openai-responses` usage counted reasoning twice: `output_tokens` 180 instead of 100.
- OpenTUI: an Esc and a `$.turn.abort` on the same turn, in either order, never called the Esc's settle.
- A 300,000-character prompt or answer made the worker request fail with `Mod request is too large.`, so no hook heard the event.

After merging `main`, before the shared-loop commits, the same headless runs with `QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_UNIFIED_AGENT_LOOP=1` gave `turn.complete` an empty answer and no usage. The abort run ended with "An unexpected critical error occurred: TurnInterruptedError: A Mod ended the turn." and exit code 1.

**After** (this branch, head `b6fb24d456`):

| Run | Result |
| --- | --- |
| headless JSON, current and shared loop | `turn.start` `{text: "RUN:<nonce>"}`; a wrong id is rejected (`is not the running turn`); `turn.complete` `{answer: "DONE:<nonce>", reason: "answer", usage: {input_tokens: 330333, output_tokens: 16, cache_read_input_tokens: 3000, cache_creation_input_tokens: 0, model: "fixture"}}`; the note arrives as `system`/`ui_log` before the result |
| headless text, both loops | the note `[Mod d1-mod] D1NOTE 14` is printed after the answer |
| headless abort, both loops | exit 130; result `is_error: true`, "A Mod ended the turn."; `turn.complete` reason `aborted`; the tool never ran |
| headless 300,000-character prompt and answer, both loops | `turn.start` text of 131,065 characters with `isTextTruncated: true`; `turn.complete` answer of 131,068 with `isAnswerTruncated: true`; the note `D1NOTE 131068` |
| Ink | tool turn answered with its note; Mod abort ended the turn with no "Request cancelled."; Esc mid-stream ended it with "Request cancelled.", the partial answer and no usage; the next turn answered; a failed request (`reason: "error"`) retried with Ctrl+Y as a turn with `text: ""`; exit 0 |
| OpenTUI (strict, Bun 1.3.13) | the same six turns with the same events and usage; exit 0 |

Ink transcript (tmux, 520 columns, long lines cut):

```text
> RUN:26a8e125
●︎ [Mod d1-mod] D1START {"text":"RUN:26a8e125","truncated":false,"id":true,"wrong":true}
◆︎ DONE:26a8e125
●︎ [Mod d1-mod] D1COMPLETE {"answer":"DONE:26a8e125","answerTruncated":false,"reason":"answer","isAborted":false,"same":true,"usage":{"input_tokens":330333,"output_tokens":16,…
●︎ [Mod d1-mod] D1NOTE 13
> ABORT:26a8e125
●︎ [Mod d1-mod] D1START {"text":"ABORT:26a8e125","truncated":false,"id":true,"wrong":true}
  {"error":"Tool denied by Mod. Mod tool dispatch failed: Error: Mod dispatch cancelled."}
●︎ [Mod d1-mod] D1COMPLETE {"answer":"","answerTruncated":false,"reason":"aborted","isAborted":true,"same":true,"usage":{"input_tokens":1234,"output_tokens":7,…
> SLOW:26a8e125
●︎ [Mod d1-mod] D1START {"text":"SLOW:26a8e125","truncated":false,"id":true,"wrong":true}
◆︎ Working 26a8e125
●︎ Request cancelled.
●︎ [Mod d1-mod] D1COMPLETE {"answer":"Working 26a8e125","answerTruncated":false,"reason":"aborted","isAborted":true,"same":true,"usage":null,…
> SECOND:26a8e125
●︎ [Mod d1-mod] D1START {"text":"SECOND:26a8e125","truncated":false,"id":true,"wrong":true}
◆︎ DONE2:26a8e125
●︎ [Mod d1-mod] D1COMPLETE {"answer":"DONE2:26a8e125","answerTruncated":false,"reason":"answer",…
●︎ [Mod d1-mod] D1NOTE 14
> FAIL:26a8e125
●︎ [Mod d1-mod] D1START {"text":"FAIL:26a8e125","truncated":false,"id":true,"wrong":true}
●︎ [Mod d1-mod] D1COMPLETE {"answer":"","answerTruncated":false,"reason":"error",…
✕ [API Error: fixture failure 26a8e125] (Press Ctrl+Y to retry)
●︎ [Mod d1-mod] D1START {"text":"","truncated":false,"id":true,"wrong":true}
◆︎ RETRIED:26a8e125
●︎ [Mod d1-mod] D1COMPLETE {"answer":"RETRIED:26a8e125","answerTruncated":false,"reason":"answer",…
●︎ [Mod d1-mod] D1NOTE 16
```

The `✕ … Ctrl+Y` line is from the capture taken before Ctrl+Y, which clears it. A compaction notice that the fixture's large token counts trigger is left out.

Tests:

- Every new unit test was checked against a deliberate break of the code it covers, 66 breaks in all, and each break made its test fail:
  - 42 in the first commit: 2 in the client, 21 in the Mod session, 19 in the three hosts;
  - 17 for the review fixes;
  - 7 for the merge follow-ups.
- Final head, after the merge with `main`:
  - core: the Mod, client, telemetry and agent-loop suites pass (17 files, 968 tests);
  - cli: the Mod session, headless, Ink stream, OpenTUI and nonInteractive suites pass (109 files, 3473 tests);
  - `integration-tests/cli/agent-loop-parity.test.ts` and `integration-tests/interactive/mods-tool-middleware.test.ts` pass on the built bundle (37 tests);
  - `scripts/tests/mod-worker-bundle.test.js` passes. Its stale load-reply expectation was the earlier `Test (ubuntu)` failure.
- The scoped lint (ESLint and Prettier, as CI selects files) and `npm run typecheck` pass.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Built CLI bundle with `experimental.mods`, isolated home, loopback OpenAI-compatible fixture; terminal runs in tmux at 520 columns, OpenTUI on Bun 1.3.13.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff:
  - Ink ends a turn when its stream goes idle, the one state all of its end paths reach. A path that kept the stream busy would delay `turn.complete`, and the next admitted prompt ends any open turn first.
  - In a terminal, `turn.complete` hooks run after the answer. A slow hook delays the next turn's tool middleware by up to its budget.
  - A Mod that ends its turn from its own `tool.call` hook leaves that call shown as "Tool denied by Mod. Mod tool dispatch failed: … cancelled". This is the existing mapping of a failed Mod dispatch, the same as when Esc interrupts a Mod hook; showing it as cancelled can follow separately.
  - A prompt or answer over 128 KiB as JSON reaches the hooks cut, unlike in Claude Code. The flags say so.
- Not validated / out of scope:
  - subagent and teammate turns (`agentId`);
  - `turn.step`;
  - `$.prompt.submit` after an abort;
  - turns the main loop starts on its own;
  - the `refusal` reason;
  - end to end: `openai-responses` usage and an Esc racing a Mod's abort in OpenTUI (both covered by unit tests);
  - macOS and Windows.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none outside `experimental.mods`. Hooks on `turn.start` and `turn.complete` that were skipped at load now run.

## Linked Issues

Part of #13749. Follows #15348.

prs.title: feat(web-shell): manage extra workspace directories from settings
prs.body:
## What this PR does Web Shell now has a Workspace directories section in Settings that lists, adds, and removes the extra directories of the selected workspace. A new workspace-scoped route and ACP control method validate the path, apply the change to every live session's workspace context, persist it in `context.includeDirectories`, refresh hierarchical memory when configured, and tell the model about the new roots. The add flow reuses the existing directory dialog, so path autocomplete, Browse, and inline errors behave exactly like "Add workspace". ## Why it's needed The CLI already supports `/directory add`, but Web Shell had no way to see or change the same workspace setting: the key was not rendered by the settings panel and no daemon route exposed it. Users had to leave the Web Shell and drop to the CLI for a workspace-level setting that also affects running sessions. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify Run `npm run build && npm run bundle`, then start a daemon with a temporary workspace (`node dist/cli.js serve --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port --workspace `) and open the Web Shell. In Settings → Workspace directories, the primary directory is read-only, an extra directory added through the route or the UI appears with a remove control, and the section shows the file-access warning. Add a directory with Add directory → Browse or by typing a path; the list updates and `.qwen/settings.json` gains `context.includeDirectories`. Restart the daemon and the entry persists. Remove it and both the list and the setting update. Removing the primary directory returns `400 initial_directory`; a relative path returns `400 invalid_path`, a file returns `404 directory_not_found`, and a path with NUL returns `400 invalid_path`. On an untrusted workspace the route answers `403`; SSH, managed, standalone, and experimental paired-engine daemons do not advertise the capability or register the route. ### Evidence (Before & After) Before (pre-change build `519bcdd596`): the Settings panel has no Workspace directories category. After: Settings → Workspace directories shows the primary directory, the extra directory, the remove control, and the file-access warning. Add directory reuses the existing dialog with path input, autocomplete, and Browse. Unit and E2E evidence: 11 route tests, 200 capability-parity cases plus the docs contract, the new handler test (live apply, persistence, primary-directory refusal, stale-directory removal), 101 Web Shell tests, and a real-daemon run covering add/list/remove, restart persistence, duplicate/trailing-slash/symlink normalization, and the invalid-path cases above. ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ | | 🐧 Linux | ✅ | ### Environment Local bundle from `npm run build && npm run bundle`; headless Chromium for the screenshots; a temporary workspace under `/tmp`; no model credentials, so the live-session file read is covered by the handler test rather than a model turn. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: adding a directory widens the roots that workspace-bounded tools may read and write. The route is trust-gated, the UI says so, and SSH, managed, standalone, and experimental paired-engine daemons do not offer it. - Not validated / out of scope: a browser-level click-through beyond the screenshots; a model-driven read of the added directory; macOS and Windows. - Breaking changes / migration notes: none. New conditional capability `workspace_directories`; daemons without settings persistence keep it unadvertised. Design docs: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-workspace-directories/docs/design/web-shell-workspace-directories.md) and [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-workspace-directories/docs/design/web-shell-workspace-directories.zh-CN.md). ## Linked Issues N/A.
中文说明 ## 这个 PR 做了什么 Web Shell 设置里新增了“工作区目录”区块，用来列出、添加和移除当前工作区的额外目录。新增的工作区级路由与 ACP 控制方法会校验路径、把变更应用到每个运行中会话的工作区上下文、持久化到 `context.includeDirectories`、在配置允许时刷新分层记忆，并把新的根目录告知模型。添加流程复用现有的目录对话框，因此路径补全、浏览和行内错误都与“添加工作区”完全一致。 ## 为什么需要 CLI 早已支持 `/directory add`，但 Web Shell 看不到也改不了同一个工作区设置：设置面板不渲染这个键，daemon 也没有暴露它的路由。用户为了一个同时影响运行中会话的工作区级设置，只能离开 Web Shell 去用 CLI。 ## 评审测试计划 ### 如何验证 执行 `npm run build && npm run bundle`，用临时工作区启动 daemon（`node dist/cli.js serve --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port --workspace `），打开 Web Shell。在“设置 → 工作区目录”里，主目录只读，通过路由或界面添加的额外目录会带移除按钮出现，区块同时展示文件访问范围提示。点击“添加目录 → 浏览”或直接输入路径；列表更新，`.qwen/settings.json` 增加 `context.includeDirectories`。重启 daemon 后条目仍在。移除后列表与设置同步更新。移除主目录返回 `400 initial_directory`；相对路径返回 `400 invalid_path`，文件返回 `404 directory_not_found`，含 NUL 的路径返回 `400 invalid_path`。未信任的工作区返回 `403`；SSH、managed、standalone 以及实验性双引擎 daemon 既不声明该能力位也不注册路由。 ### 证据（改动前 / 改动后） 改动前（改动前构建 `519bcdd596`）：设置面板没有“工作区目录”分类。 改动后：设置 → 工作区目录展示主目录、额外目录、移除按钮以及文件访问范围提示。 “添加目录”复用现有对话框，包含路径输入、补全与浏览。 单元与端到端证据：11 个路由测试、200 个能力对齐用例加文档契约、新的处理函数测试（即时生效、持久化、拒绝主目录、目录消失后仍可移除）、101 个 Web Shell 测试，以及真实 daemon 运行覆盖的添加/列出/移除、重启持久化、重复/尾斜杠/符号链接规范化，以及上面的非法路径用例。 ### 测试平台 | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ | | 🐧 Linux | ✅ | ### 环境 本地 bundle（`npm run build && npm run bundle`）；截图使用无头 Chromium；临时工作区位于 `/tmp`；没有模型凭据，因此运行中会话读取目录由处理函数测试覆盖，而不是真实模型回合。 ## 风险与范围 - 主要风险或取舍：增加目录会扩大工作区工具可读写的根目录。路由有信任校验，界面有明确提示，SSH、managed、standalone 与实验性双引擎 daemon 都不提供该功能。 - 未验证 / 范围外：截图之外的浏览器点击流程；由模型驱动的额外目录读取；macOS 与 Windows。 - 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。新增条件能力位 `workspace_directories`；未接入设置持久化的 daemon 不会声明它。设计文档：[英文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-workspace-directories/docs/design/web-shell-workspace-directories.md) 与 [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-workspace-directories/docs/design/web-shell-workspace-directories.zh-CN.md)。 ## 关联 Issue 无。

prs.title: fix(core): report speculation files that could not be applied
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Report real speculation copy failures with the failed paths and first I/O cause. Keep successfully applied files and their count; if any edit reached disk, report the partial result without resubmitting the same turn. Missing overlay entries and directory placeholders are skipped.

## Why it's needed

Swallowing a copy error lets the UI and model history claim an edit landed. Retrying after a partial copy can apply the edits twice. Both paths need an explicit failure result.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

From `packages/core`: `pnpm exec vitest run src/followup/overlayFs.test.ts src/followup/accept-speculation.test.ts`. From `packages/cli`: `pnpm exec vitest run src/ui/AppContainer.test.tsx`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

At `46fe6684` (merged main `5122ec9`): core `src/followup` 150 passed (31 in the two changed files); CLI `AppContainer.test.tsx` 252 passed. Tests cover real copy failures, applied/failed counts and cause, missing/directory entries, a real file changed after the snapshot, open-stage vs copy-stage damage, the correction injected for paths that did not land, failed telemetry, and no resubmit after partial writes. Earlier parent-directory red/green evidence remains in the review thread.

Core `tsc --noEmit` and the full `pnpm --filter @qwen-code/qwen-code run build` passed. The standalone CLI `tsc --noEmit` reports four errors in main-side files outside this diff (`acpAgent.ts`, `attach.ts`, `memory-import.ts`, `run-qwen-serve.ts`). ESLint and Prettier are clean on the six changed files. Full preflight, Windows/Linux, and live speculation E2E were not run locally.

### Tested on

macOS. Windows and Linux were not tested locally.

prs.title: feat(web-shell): create workspaces from a Git URL
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a Git repository source to the Web Shell Add-workspace dialog. A user can paste a clone URL, choose a new target directory, watch clone progress, cancel it, and land in the cloned workspace without leaving the browser.

The daemon performs the clone as an asynchronous job, so a long clone does not exceed the client's mutation budget and remains observable. A successful clone is registered through the existing workspace route, which keeps capacity, nesting, persistence, and the daemon's trust policy in one place.

Design: [English](docs/design/2026-10-23-web-shell-git-clone-workspace.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-23-web-shell-git-clone-workspace.zh-CN.md)

## Why it's needed

Before this change the dialog could only register a directory that already existed on the daemon host or create an empty directory. Starting from a repository meant leaving the browser, cloning in a terminal on that machine, and registering the path afterwards. On a remote daemon that detour is the main usability gap in workspace creation.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start a daemon from this branch on a host with `git`, open the Web Shell, and open Add Workspace. A source selector should offer "Existing directory" and "Git repository"; a daemon without `git` or without dynamic registration should not offer the Git source.
2. Choose "Git repository", enter a repository URL the host can reach, and enter an absolute target path whose parent exists and whose final component does not. Submit and confirm the progress panel advances, the dialog closes after success, and the workspace opens with the repository content.
3. Start another clone and cancel it. The progress panel should return to a terminal cancelled state and the target directory should not remain.
4. Try an existing target, a relative target, and an `ext::` URL. Each should fail with a clear error and leave no new directory.
5. Confirm a successful clone appears in the workspace list like any manually registered directory. Trust is whatever the daemon's folder-trust policy assigns; the clone path does not grant trust.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before — the Add-workspace dialog only offers a directory path:

![Before: directory-only Add Workspace dialog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/pr15361/workspace-before.png)

After — choose the Git repository source and fill the URL and target:

![After: Git repository source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/pr15361/workspace-git-source.png)

After — pick the clone parent from folder suggestions:

![After: clone target suggestions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/pr15361/workspace-git-suggestions.png)

After — clone progress with cancel:

![After: clone progress](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/pr15361/workspace-git-progress.png)

The progress capture holds a running job at 42% so the transient panel stays visible.

The screenshots come from the real Web Shell served by a local build; the base capture uses the installed 0.26.0 daemon. The daemon flow was also verified end to end against a real local bare repository: capability advertisement, 202 job creation, progress to 100%, cloned content, registration, and the `target_nested`, `target_exists`, `invalid_url`, and `invalid_target` rejections.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Local build (`npm run build` plus the CLI package build with a 6 GB heap), daemon started from `packages/cli/dist/index.js`, local bare Git fixture, Node.js 24.22.1, git 2.43.7.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: clone jobs are process-local. A daemon restart forgets a running job, and a clone that completes after the page closes leaves an unregistered directory that the user can add manually.
- Not validated / out of scope: browser-level E2E (no browser binaries), macOS and Windows hosts, cloning through the in-place remote-daemon add proxy, shallow clones, branch/tag selection, submodules, and Git LFS.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The capability is additive; older daemons omit it and older clients ignore it.

## Linked Issues

N/A

![变更后：clone 目标目录建议](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/pr15361/workspace-git-suggestions.png)

### 测试环境

### 环境

本地构建（`npm run build` 以及用 6 GB 堆构建 CLI 包），从 `packages/cli/dist/index.js` 启动守护进程，使用本地 bare Git 仓库，Node.js 24.22.1，git 2.43.7。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：clone 任务状态是进程内的。守护进程重启会忘记运行中的任务；页面关闭后才完成的 clone 会留下未注册目录，用户可以手动添加。
- 未验证 / 范围外：浏览器级 E2E（没有浏览器二进制）、macOS 与 Windows 主机、经就地远程守护进程添加代理的 clone、浅克隆、分支/tag 选择、submodule 和 Git LFS。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。能力是增量式的；旧守护进程不宣告它，旧客户端会忽略它。

prs.title: fix(memory): match reader advice to the binding index budget
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes memory-index overflow advice match the binding line and character budgets. Diagnosis includes the recognized writer notice and reports the actual candidate count. Description shortening is offered only when the formatted entries' names and links can fit without descriptions; grouped links remain part of that floor. When shortening can work, the advice names the total 25,000-unit target.

## Why it's needed

170 ordinary entries of 150 UTF-16 code units total 25,669 units. Shortening each description by ten units keeps every name and link and reduces the index to 23,969. The previous warning incorrectly said shortening could not help. This deliberately corrects the assertion inherited from #14834.

The same warning must handle the opposite case: long links can exceed the character budget even after every description is removed. It should then offer pruning or merging, rather than repeat an exhausted shortening lever. A stale index containing 199 entries plus the writer notice must also report 199 candidates, rather than the 200-entry cap.

This implements #15277 item 1 against main. Items 2–5 depend on #14937 and remain separate. Main `1eee20a72bb1a4fe53cc1221f5d61e3ed7cf2c93` is integrated to bring the branch under the current lint gate; no CI policy is changed by this PR.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Load 170 entries of 150 units, then shorten descriptions to 140 units while preserving names and links. All 170 should load without a warning.
- Load 201 short entries, or 200 short entries followed by a huge entry outside the cap. The warning must not falsely claim the first 200 exceed the character budget or recommend description shortening for the line limit.
- Generate a real-writer index whose body fits but whose appended notice exceeds 25,000 units. The correct length diagnosis and 150-unit lever should survive in project, user and team contexts, including LF/CRLF inputs.
- Load 250 entries of 150 units. Both limits bind; pruning to 200 still leaves character overflow. Reducing those 200 to 124 units should retain all 200 at 24,999 units.
- Load 199 entries of 150 units plus the known notice. The warning should say 199 candidates and keep the drop denominator at 199.
- Load entries whose names and links alone exceed the budget, before and after descriptions are removed. The warning must omit description-shortening advice. Grouped sibling links, trailing whitespace and separators inside titles must not be mistaken for descriptions.
- Load 200 entries of 200 units with short links. Bringing them to 150 still overflows, so advice must name the total budget; shortening further can recover them. Do not restore a blanket cannot-shorten claim.
- Preserve huge-entry advice, length-over-line precedence, retained identities/order, omission counts and existing budgets.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Current head: `61af9c3825f09e2ec5ef25eaa37907f9b3eeeba0`, after a normal, conflict-free merge of main `1eee20a72bb1a4fe53cc1221f5d61e3ed7cf2c93`. This includes lint-gate update `3b9b35e30dc4`, named by the failed upstream lint job, and merged Hosted Harness repair #15455 (`2a9fb6db5235`). All five PR implementation, test and documentation blobs are byte-identical to previous published head `9d337c87fc400873851a89689dfa1b283e5cceca`; the net PR changes no CI policy.

Fresh Linux / Node 22.21.1 verification on this exact head passes frozen installation, root build/bundle/typecheck, full repository ESLint, CI-scoped Prettier, **20 CI helper tests**, and the full memory suite (**1,132 passed / 2 skipped**). Bundled CLI version/help and the direct startup-closure check pass; tracked source remains clean.

On this reader head, the **14 focused Harness cases and complete 28-test approval-selection suite pass**, with retries disabled. The full 677-case Harness file was not rerun on this head. The sibling #14937 run on the same main and byte-identical Harness/approval test and production files produced 699 passes / six full-run failures; those six pass in focused runs on that head and main. Full-suite order/timing remains unresolved and is not claimed green here. New native upstream CI will test this exact reader head.

Fresh independent verification on this exact build passes **14/14 built-module cases** and **4/4 actual bundled CLI headless runs** against a local mock. Captured outbound catalogs cover line-only overflow, 199 entries plus notice, names/links that exceed the budget without descriptions, and an under-budget control. Module cases also cover all three memory scopes and ordinary-entry shortening before/after. The verifier checks retained identities/order, exact source/tree and unchanged source/modules/bundle. Settings use an isolated `QWEN_HOME`; system HOME and USERPROFILE remain inherited.

The [previous head's Windows results and five regression-control arms](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15368#issuecomment-6383617960) remain historical evidence for `24f24aea7a`: 59 prompt tests, eight failures with previous production, and 2/1/4/2 failures for the four mutations. Those controls and Windows tests were not rerun for this base sync. Source/test blobs are unchanged.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Not tested locally |
| Windows | Historical on `24f24aea7a`: build/bundle/typecheck/format/lint/CLI smoke and memory 1,125 passed / 9 skipped |
| Linux | Fresh on `61af9c3825`: checks above, memory 1,132 passed / 2 skipped, 14 focused Harness + 28 approval tests, 14 module cases and four actual local-mock CLI runs |

### Environment

Exact source commit: `61af9c3825f09e2ec5ef25eaa37907f9b3eeeba0`. Frozen pnpm installation was rerun before building. The net PR changes no dependency constraints. No live-provider, interactive TUI, Java SDK or new macOS/Windows verification is claimed. Focused Harness passes are not a full-suite result. New upstream CI and maintainer review remain separate gates.

## Risk & Scope

- Scope: warning diagnosis/advice, regression tests, documentation and sharing the writer's existing separator constants internally.
- Selection, retained contents/order, limits, persisted writer output and public APIs are unchanged. Unrecognized entry formats remain counted when measuring non-description content.
- Main risk: advising a remedy that cannot clear the budget. Character-only, line-only, combined, notice-bearing, long-link, grouped-link and outside-cap controls cover those decisions.
- Out of scope: macOS verification, live-provider/TUI sessions and #15277 items 2–5 pending #14937. Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Related to #15277, item 1 only; follows the reader-advice discussion on #14937 and corrects the no-shortening assertion associated with #14834. This does not close the entire issue.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

让记忆索引超限建议对应实际触及的行数和字符预算。归因计入已识别的写入器提示，并报告实际候选数量。只有格式化条目的名称与链接在移除描述后能符合预算，才建议缩短描述；分组链接仍计入不可缩短的部分。缩短有效时，建议明确给出总计 25,000 单元的目标。

## 为什么需要

170 条、每条 150 个 UTF-16 代码单元的普通条目共占 25,669 个单元。每条描述缩短十个单元，就能保留全部名称与链接，将总量减至 23,969。原警告却说缩短没有帮助。本次有意修正源于 #14834 的错误断言。

警告也必须处理相反情况：即使删除所有描述，长链接仍可能超过字符预算。此时应建议精简或合并，而不是重复已无效的缩短建议。包含 199 条条目及写入器提示的旧索引，也应报告 199 个候选，而非 200 条上限。

本 PR 针对 main 实现 #15277 第 1 项。第 2–5 项依赖 #14937，继续单独跟踪。已合并 main `1eee20a72bb1a4fe53cc1221f5d61e3ed7cf2c93`，使分支接受当前 lint 门禁；本 PR 不修改 CI 策略。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 加载 170 条、每条 150 单元的条目，保留名称与链接，将描述缩至每条总长 140 单元。全部 170 条应能加载且不再警告。
- 加载 201 条短条目，或 200 条短条目后追加一条上限之外的超大条目。警告不应错误声称前 200 条超过字符预算，也不应建议通过缩短描述解决行数限制。
- 使用实际写入器生成正文符合预算、追加提示后超过 25,000 单元的索引。项目、用户、团队作用域及 LF/CRLF 输入都应保留正确的长度归因和 150 单元建议。
- 加载 250 条、每条 150 单元的条目。两个限制同时生效；精简至 200 条仍有字符超限。再缩至每条 124 单元后，应在 24,999 单元内保留全部 200 条。
- 加载 199 条、每条 150 单元的条目及已知提示。警告应报告 199 个候选，遗漏计数的分母也保持 199。
- 加载名称与链接本身就超限的条目，分别保留和删除描述。警告都应省略缩短描述的建议。分组链接、尾随空白及标题内分隔符不得被误认为描述。
- 加载 200 条、每条 200 单元且链接较短的条目。缩至 150 单元仍超限，因此建议须说明总预算；进一步缩短可以恢复全部条目。不要恢复笼统的“缩短无用”断言。
- 保持超大条目建议、长度优先于行数的建议顺序、保留条目身份与顺序、遗漏计数和现有预算不变。

### 修复前后证据

当前精确 head `61af9c3825f09e2ec5ef25eaa37907f9b3eeeba0` 通过无冲突的正常合并纳入 main `1eee20a72bb1a4fe53cc1221f5d61e3ed7cf2c93`，包括旧上游 lint 任务指出的门禁更新 `3b9b35e30dc4` 及已合并的 Hosted Harness 修复 #15455（`2a9fb6db5235`）。净 PR 的五个实现、测试和文档文件与旧发布 head `9d337c87fc400873851a89689dfa1b283e5cceca` 逐字节相同，不修改 CI 策略。

此精确 head 在 Linux / Node 22.21.1 上通过冻结安装、全仓 build/bundle/typecheck、全仓 ESLint、CI 范围 Prettier、**20 项 CI helper 测试**及完整 memory suite（**1,132 通过 / 2 跳过**）。打包 CLI version/help、直接启动闭包与最终 tracked tree 检查通过。

此 reader head 的 **14 项定向 Harness 场景及完整 28 项 approval-selection 测试通过**，未启用重试。此 head 未重新执行完整 677 项 Harness 文件。相同 main、且 Harness/approval 测试及生产文件逐字节相同的姊妹 #14937 运行产生 699 通过 / 六项完整运行失败；这六项在该 head 和 main 的定向运行中均通过。完整 suite 的顺序/时序问题仍未解决，此处不声称完整运行全绿。新的原生上游 CI 将测试此精确 reader head。

此精确构建的独立验证通过 **14/14 项构建模块用例**和 **4/4 项实际打包 CLI 无头运行**，请求仅发送到本地 mock。出站目录覆盖仅行数超限、199 条加提示、无描述仍超字符预算及正常小索引；模块用例覆盖三个记忆作用域及普通条目缩短前后。检查保留身份/顺序、精确 source/tree 与未改变的源代码、模块和 bundle。设置通过独立 QWEN_HOME 隔离，系统 HOME 和 USERPROFILE 保持继承。

旧 head `24f24aea7a` 的 Windows 与五组回归控制仅作为历史证据：59 项 prompt 测试，旧生产代码产生八项失败，四个变体分别产生 2/1/4/2 项失败。本次 base sync 未重跑这些控制或 Windows 测试；实现和测试 blobs 未改变。

### 已测试平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | 未在本地测试 |
| Windows | 旧 head `24f24aea7a` 的历史证据：build/bundle/typecheck/format/lint/CLI 冒烟；memory 1,125 通过 / 9 跳过 |
| Linux | 新 head `61af9c3825`：上述检查，memory 1,132 通过 / 2 跳过，14 项定向 Harness + 28 项 approval，14 项模块用例及四项真实本地 mock CLI 场景 |

### 环境

精确源代码提交为 `61af9c3825f09e2ec5ef25eaa37907f9b3eeeba0`，构建前重新执行冻结 pnpm 安装。净 PR 不修改依赖约束。不新增声称真实提供商、交互 TUI、Java SDK 或 macOS/Windows 验证。定向 Harness 通过不等于完整 suite 通过。新上游 CI 和维护者评审仍是独立门禁。

## 风险与范围

- 范围：警告归因与建议、回归测试、文档，以及在内部共享写入器既有分隔符常量。
- 选择算法、保留内容与顺序、限制、保存的写入器输出及公共 API 均未改变。测量非描述内容时，无法识别的条目格式仍保留计数。
- 主要风险：建议一个无法解除超限的方法。仅字符、仅行数、双重限制、带提示、长链接、分组链接及候选上限之外的控制用例均有覆盖。
- 范围之外：macOS 验证、真实模型服务/TUI 会话，以及等待 #14937 的 #15277 第 2–5 项。无破坏性改动或迁移要求。

## 关联 issue

关联 #15277，仅处理第 1 项；延续 #14937 的读取侧建议讨论，并修正与 #14834 关联的“不应缩短”断言。本 PR 不关闭整个 issue。

</details>

prs.title: feat(hooks): add FileChanged notifications for local sessions
prs.body:
Latest verification / 最新验证: [author report / 作者报告](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13969#issuecomment-6253488649).

## What this PR does

Adds `FileChanged` notifications for local, non-managed sessions. Hooks can register literal cwd filenames or absolute files and recursive directories through successful synchronous `SessionStart` and `FileChanged` output. Notifications identify the listening session, absolute path and `add`, `change` or `unlink`, including changes made by external processes.

Subscriptions follow session rotation, skill hook registration/removal and cwd changes. Static registrations exclude regex fragments and directories. Initially absent siblings and deeply missing roots are discovered through surviving ancestors, deleted/recreated roots recover, retained queued events survive reconfiguration, and watcher errors permit registration retries. Recursive discovery skips implicit `.git` and `node_modules` subtrees while honoring explicit paths inside them; ordinary recursion has no depth limit. Linked English/Chinese design and user documentation explain the same behavior.

ACP bootstrap and MCP reconnect temporary configs do not start host subscriptions. Managed execution engines, remote environments and shell sandbox workers remain excluded. Late reload or skill registration after rotation rebinds the current owner; ended sessions and stale results remain disarmed.

CI repairs preserve behavior assertions, bundle-size limits and main's complete Java fault gates. Test-local idle observations wait for actual asynchronous settlement. Reference archives are verified in fresh extraction directories, and persistent runners use their existing local Maven seed without a redundant remote cache upload; fresh hosted release builds retain remote Maven caching.

## Why it's needed

Memory integrations need notifications from editors, shells and other writers, including directories outside cwd and multiple accessible workspaces. This provides a general filesystem event. Integrators register actual directories and route by absolute path; initial reconciliation and offline synchronization remain their responsibility.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Configure `.env|.envrc` while both files are absent. Create either first, atomically replace one and delete it; expect corresponding notifications. Unrelated cwd subdirectories stay silent.
- Register absolute files or a directory outside cwd. Future nested additions, changes and deletions, initially missing siblings and deeply missing roots must notify. Delete a root for 200ms and recreate it; later additions and changes must still arrive. Replacing or clearing dynamic paths retains static registrations.
- Register a repository root: implicit `.git` and `node_modules` changes stay silent, ordinary nested files notify. Explicitly register a path inside an excluded subtree to observe that path; unrelated siblings stay silent.
- Change cwd: static registrations move, old static paths stop notifying and explicit dynamic roots remain active. Reconfigure during a running hook: retained queued events continue, removed-root events are dropped. Watcher errors permit retries; shutdown cancels intake and pending registration.
- Rotate without SessionStart, then reload or register a skill; expect current-session notifications. ACP bootstrap, MCP reconnect, managed, remote and sandbox configs must not observe the host.

## Risk & Scope

- Notifications are best effort: events can be coalesced, duplicated or missed during downtime and reconfiguration. Handlers must avoid self-trigger loops.
- Remote/hosted event producers, durable synchronization, symlink traversal and memory toggles are outside scope. Discovery may enumerate the nearest existing ancestor; remaining scan-cost and queue-policy suggestions are recorded in the PR thread.
- Dynamic registrations use the last valid explicit list and reset with session ownership. Explicitly registering an excluded subtree intentionally observes that declared scope.

prs.title: fix(acp): carry rewind identity through daemon clients
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Carries the existing admitted rewind identity across ACP/daemon admission, retry/cancel, strict checkpoint resolution, recording/rollback, checkpoint notifications, SDK projection, and Web Shell/VS Code selection. A successful rewind outside a client's retained window now replaces that window atomically with the authoritative surviving prefix, including an empty prefix, and rebuilds daemon replay so reconnect and reload cannot revive discarded turns. Conversation changes are reconciled even when file restoration reports failures.

This is the ACP/daemon split from #13737. Prerequisites #13737 and #15439 are merged. Main was merged into this PR at `5ef3f7694ed01202ac6966016a7e1b9a764620e9`; that is branch integration, not this PR merging into main. The delivered repair is `937d65468006bfa65f7fc5d9299f988dabcdb928`.

## Why it's needed

Snapshot positions contain retry gaps and are not visible user-turn ordinals. Keeping producers, persistence, transport and consumers on the same unique admitted identity avoids selecting the wrong boundary. Previously, rewinding unloaded A could leave newer B/C visible. The server now proves the complete surviving prefix from its bounded replay before mutation, resets/reseeds that replay after conversation mutation, and sends the same prefix for bounded SDK installation.

The server deliberately refuses before model/files/recording mutation when its bounded history is missing, degraded, truncated, partial, or ambiguous, or does not contain a unique ordinary target. This can reject a native checkpoint that exists outside available server history; there is no unbounded history cache or ordinal guess. Ownership stays with the live session's resolved workspace.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Exercise retry gaps, multipart ordinary user messages, injected/system rows, resumed/selectively restored recordings, and recording disabled. Checkpoint selection, model/recording boundaries and client updates should agree on the same identity. Invalid or ambiguous ownership and incomplete server replay should refuse without mutation. A file restoration failure after conversation rewind should still reconcile the conversation.

With ROOT/A/B/C and a client retaining only B/C, rewind A: the same mounted consumer should show ROOT, and a subsequent D provider request should contain ROOT,D only. Repeat with recording enabled/disabled, reconnect with an old cursor, fresh/cache loads, and a loaded-B control retaining ROOT,A. Verify empty-prefix rewind, session switching, stale pagination invalidation, foreign-workspace refusal, busy refusal and successful retry without changing the primary workspace.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Independent local verification is bound to `937d65468006bfa65f7fc5d9299f988dabcdb928` by all 12 changed source/test/design blobs and eight built artifact hashes. The old-head FAIL report is historical evidence at `66dc3f3432d25638a3e95809b803377136703c9a`; the new verification below supersedes its open recovery-blocker status for the delivered candidate, without rewriting that failed run. Two consecutive independent read-only agent reviews were clean with Critical=0; no Codex CLI execution is claimed.

Applicable focused results: 3101 passing tests in 13 distinct files, counting each file once (ACP 1239/3, SDK 465/2, CLI 178/1, Web 838/4, core 327/2, VS Code 54/1). Root build/typecheck, scoped lint and SDK public-surface checks passed before the fixture-only VS Code repair; the repaired full 54-test file and its lint then passed. Root typecheck was not newly rerun after that fixture change.

Applicable live integration: 16 distinct scenarios / 122 assertions = six SDK scenarios / 72 assertions + nine browser scenarios / 44 assertions + one real two-workspace scenario / six assertions. Three canonical transcript readback checks are derived checks listed separately. Browser coverage mounted the built production Provider/hooks in a Probe shell against the actual built daemon/ACP/HTTP/SSE and a controlled loopback provider, using production self-echo defaults, strict B/C preconditions and the original 15-second deadline in both recording modes. This is browser integration with real DOM/network, not complete stock App or VS Code host E2E. Real captured D request bodies proved the surviving prefix. Actual record-budget pagination used 22 records; after rewind the Provider had hasMore=false, so public loadMore correctly issued no stale-anchor request. A new request reanchored to ROOT was not observed or claimed.

The real two-workspace case covered trusted secondary ownership, foreign-checkpoint refusal, busy HTTP 409, successful retry, and unchanged primary state. Unknown/untrusted/ambiguous/draining/removed paths have mechanism-test evidence only. Detailed independent verification is in the separate PR comment; retained local artifacts are not public evidence URLs.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Darwin arm64, Node 22.22.0; local checks and live integration above |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Local built daemon/ACP, HTTP/SSE, built SDK and production Provider/hooks in a browser Probe; controlled loopback provider. No actual model-service acceptance or stock product click-flow claim.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: authoritative recovery is limited to provable bounded server replay; incomplete history is recoverably refused before mutation. Optional replay payloads preserve legacy event behavior when absent.
- Scope: inherit the parent's 14-round Critical-only discipline. Fixed main `3b9b35e30dc49568e9a97468f396d44e2a1ac29b` comparison is 37 files +2762/−407, including the preserved ACP/daemon split; this repair relative to integration is 12 files +1056/−172, including six production paths +148/−9, necessary regressions and synchronized design. The old 51-file ancestry comparison is not the B scope baseline. Suggestions remain deferred to #13869.
- Not validated / out of scope: actual model/service acceptance, same-condition old-head ROOT baseline, complete stock App/rewind-control or VS Code host E2E, and screenshot pixel review. A historical nondefault Probe 15-second timeout still has UNKNOWN root cause; a later 30-second diagnostic does not retrospectively pass it. New default-config runs are separate evidence, not an explanation or deletion of that failure.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no new route, identity counter or unbounded journal; old events without replay retain existing compatibility. Local verification and clean reviews do not imply hosted CI or maintainer approval; Ready/CI status is tracked separately. No merge is requested.

Synchronized draft design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/937d65468006bfa65f7fc5d9299f988dabcdb928/docs/design/rewind-stable-prompt-identity.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/937d65468006bfa65f7fc5d9299f988dabcdb928/docs/design/rewind-stable-prompt-identity.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Related to #9437, which remains open pending ACP acceptance. Split from #13737; prerequisites #13737 and #15439 are merged. Follow-up suggestions: #13869.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这项修改做了什么

完整承接既有准入回退身份的 ACP/daemon 链路：准入、重试/取消、严格检查点解析、录制/回滚、检查点通知、SDK 投影，以及 Web Shell/VS Code 选择。成功回退到客户端窗口外时，现在会原子替换为权威存续前缀（含空前缀），并重建 daemon 回放，避免重连和重载复活已丢弃轮次。文件恢复报告失败但对话已改变时，仍会对账对话。

这是从 #13737 拆出的 ACP/daemon 部分。前置 #13737 和 #15439 均已合入。`5ef3f7694ed01202ac6966016a7e1b9a764620e9` 是把 main 合入本 PR 的整合提交，不代表本 PR 已合入 main。本次交付修复为 `937d65468006bfa65f7fc5d9299f988dabcdb928`。

## 为什么需要

快照位置包含重试空洞，不等于可见用户轮次。生产者、持久化、传输和消费者沿用同一唯一准入身份，可以避免选错边界。此前回退未加载的 A 后可能仍显示较新的 B/C。服务端现在先从有界回放证明完整存续前缀，对话修改后 reset/reseed 回放，再把同一前缀发送给 SDK 有界安装。

服务端有界历史缺失、降级、截断、不完整、有歧义或没有唯一普通用户目标时，会在模型/文件/录制修改前拒绝。因此原生检查点即使存在，若超出服务端可用历史也可能被拒绝；不增加无限历史缓存，不按序号猜测。所有权仍由实时会话解析到的 workspace 决定。

覆盖重试空洞、多片普通用户消息、注入/系统行、恢复/选择性恢复录制和关闭录制。检查点选择、模型/录制边界与客户端更新应关联同一身份。无效或有歧义的所有权及不完整服务端回放应在修改前拒绝。对话回退后文件恢复失败时仍应对账对话。

建立 ROOT/A/B/C，客户端仅保留 B/C，回退 A 后同一个 mounted 消费者应显示 ROOT，随后 D 的 provider 请求仅含 ROOT,D。覆盖开/关录制、旧 cursor 重连、fresh/cache load，以及加载 B 后保留 ROOT,A 的对照。验证空前缀、会话切换、旧分页失效、跨 workspace 检查点拒绝、busy 拒绝及成功重试，primary workspace 不变。

独立本地验证通过全部 12 个改动源码/测试/设计 blob 及八个构建产物指纹绑定 `937d65468006bfa65f7fc5d9299f988dabcdb928`。旧 head `66dc3f3432d25638a3e95809b803377136703c9a` 的 FAIL 是历史证据；下列新验证替代该恢复阻塞在新交付候选上的未解决状态，不改写旧失败运行。连续两次独立只读 agent 评审均 clean、Critical=0；未声称执行 Codex CLI。

当前适用 focused 结果为 13 个不同文件、3101 测试通过，每文件仅计一次：ACP 1239/3、SDK 465/2、CLI 178/1、Web 838/4、core 327/2、VS Code 54/1。全仓 build/typecheck、局部 lint、SDK public-surface 在仅修改 VS Code 夹具之前通过；修复后完整 54 测试和夹具 lint 通过。夹具修改后未新跑 root typecheck。

真实双 workspace 覆盖可信 secondary 所有权、foreign checkpoint 拒绝、busy HTTP 409、成功 retry 和 primary 不变。unknown/untrusted/ambiguous/draining/removed 仅有机制测试证据。独立验证详情见单独 PR 评论；保留的本地产物不充当公开证据 URL。

本地 built daemon/ACP、HTTP/SSE、built SDK，以及浏览器 Probe 中的生产 Provider/hooks；受控 loopback provider。不声称实际模型服务验收或完整产品点击链。

## 风险与范围

- 主要取舍：权威恢复限于服务端可证明的有界回放，历史不完整时在修改前可恢复拒绝。可选 replay 缺省时保持旧事件行为。
