prs.title: fix(web-shell): preserve wrapped drafts during arrow navigation
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Preserves unsent Web Shell drafts while ArrowUp/ArrowDown move between visual rows, including soft wraps and RTL or mixed-direction text. On an edge row, arrows first reach the document edge before browsing history; short single-row prompts retain immediate history recall.

Continuous paging applies only to active arrow-history browsing of a single logical line. Selections, entries with real newlines, edited recalls, and search/panel recalls retain editor control. Paging past the newest entry restores the draft. An explicit search or panel recall starts a fresh navigation sequence, so subsequent paging returns to the selected text without tags from an earlier draft. ArrowDown keeps a short recall focused in the composer; normal footer navigation remains available after returning from history to the draft.

## Why it's needed

A long paragraph can occupy several visual rows without containing a newline. Treating that paragraph as a history boundary replaces an unsent draft during ordinary caret movement. Horizontal visual endpoints also need not match logical document endpoints in bidi text, so the boundary decision now compares vertical caret and edge positions.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Establish two history entries, then enter a paragraph long enough to wrap. ArrowUp from a later row and ArrowDown from an earlier row should move the caret inside the document without changing its text. Repeat with explicit newlines and wrapped RTL text.
2. Move within the first/last row near the document edge. One arrow should reach the true edge; the next may browse history. Active browsing should page through wrapped single-line entries and eventually restore the draft.
3. Try short LTR, RTL, and mixed-direction prompts. ArrowUp should recall history immediately, and ArrowDown should restore the exact draft.
4. Select recalled text, edit a wrapped recall, or recall through search/the history panel. Arrows should preserve the text and keep normal editing behavior; entries containing real newlines should also keep caret movement inside their lines.

5. Browse history first, then pick a different wrapped entry through search or the panel. Interior arrows should preserve the pick. Browse again from the document edge and return; the selected text should return without tags from the earlier draft.

6. On a host with a visible task footer, recall a short single-row entry with and without prior arrow paging. ArrowDown should retain the text and composer focus. Browse up and back down to restore that selected text as a draft; a further ArrowDown should still hand off to the footer.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The latest follow-up is based on incoming PR head `785edf63`, synchronized with main at `9e2d6ebf`. Two new short-recall regressions fail before the fix because the footer callback is invoked, while the other 189 DOM tests pass. After the one-line guard, **all 282 related composer/history unit tests pass**. The same paired cases also require the footer callback after a real history cycle returns to the draft; replacing the guard with an unconditional consume makes both cases fail again.

The existing **17 Chromium browser regressions pass**, with no skips or retries. Those controls use the repository mock daemon. Independent baseline reproduction additionally reaches the actual task-pill button in all four short-recall cases (search/panel × prior/no-prior paging) using the supported host header configuration without the environment item and mocked background-task data.

Final independent verification passes **5/5 real built-CLI / actual-daemon cases**, without a mock daemon: short search/panel recalls retain text and focus, fresh paging begins at the newest entry and restores the selected draft, and an ordinary short-draft round trip works. The default standalone environment panel replaces the legacy task pill, so direct footer verification is separate: **4/4 real Chromium host-fixture cases pass** with mocked task data. Those cases verify focus remains in the composer during a recall and reaches the actual task button after paging returns to the draft. Source and CLI hashes match the final artifacts; the isolated daemon was stopped.

| Interaction | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Recall a short entry, then ArrowDown while the recall is active | Focus moves from the composer to the task pill | Composer focus and the recalled text remain |
| Browse from that recall and return to its draft, then ArrowDown again | Normal footer navigation is expected | Footer handoff remains available |

Full build, bundle, repository-wide typecheck, lint, changed-file formatting and whitespace checks pass. No fresh full preflight or cross-platform result is claimed. Upstream CI still needs maintainer approval (`action_required`), separately from local verification.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Chromium, unit tests, build checks |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64, Node.js 22.22.3, Chromium build 1234, viewport 1100 × 900. Production verification uses isolated configuration, runtime, and workspace directories.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: visual-row ownership depends on rendered editor geometry. Browser regressions cover bidi, wraps, state transitions, selections, and draft restoration; no performance improvement is claimed.
- Not validated / out of scope: other browser engines, Windows/Linux, touch textarea behavior, model execution, and a direct RTL document-end-to-footer focus handoff.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14879

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

在 Web Shell 中，上下方向键跨视觉行移动光标时保留未发送草稿，涵盖自动换行、RTL 和双向混排文本。在边缘视觉行，方向键先到达文档真正的起点或终点，再进入历史；短单视觉行提示仍可立即回溯历史。

连续历史分页仅适用于已启动方向键历史浏览且只有一个逻辑行的条目。选区、含真实换行的条目、编辑后的召回内容及搜索／面板召回仍由编辑器处理。越过最新历史条目时恢复草稿。显式搜索／面板召回会重新开始导航，之后翻页返回时恢复所选文本，不会附上更早草稿的标签。短召回条目按下方向键时保留输入框焦点；从历史返回草稿后，正常的 footer 导航仍可使用。

## 为什么需要

长段落即使没有换行符，也可能占据多个视觉行。将它直接视为历史边界，会在普通光标移动时替换未发送草稿。双向文本的水平视觉端点也未必对应逻辑文档端点，因此边界判断改为比较光标与文档边缘的纵向位置。

## 评审验证方案

### 如何验证

1. 建立两条历史后，输入足够自动换行的长段落。从靠后的视觉行按上方向键、从靠前的视觉行按下方向键，应在文档内部移动光标并保留全文。对含显式换行及自动换行 RTL 的文本重复验证。
2. 在首行／末行靠近文档边缘处移动光标。第一次方向键应到达真正边界，下一次才可进入历史。已启动的历史浏览应能连续翻阅自动换行的单逻辑行条目，并最终恢复草稿。
3. 分别输入短 LTR、RTL 和双向混排提示。上方向键应立即召回历史，下方向键应恢复完全相同的草稿。
4. 选中召回文本、编辑自动换行的历史条目，或通过搜索／历史面板召回。方向键应保留内容并维持普通编辑行为；含真实换行的条目也应能在内部各行间移动光标。

5. 先用方向键浏览历史，再通过搜索／面板选择另一条自动换行条目。内部方向键应保留所选文本。从文档边缘再次浏览并返回时，应恢复所选文本，且不附上更早草稿的标签。

6. 在显示任务 footer 的宿主中，分别在先前翻页和未翻页的情况下召回短单行条目。下方向键应保留内容及输入框焦点。再向上浏览并向下返回所选文本作为草稿后，下一次下方向键仍应能交接到 footer。

### 证据（前后对照）

最新跟进基于远端 PR 提交 `785edf63`，已同步主干 `9e2d6ebf`。新增两项短条目召回回归在修复前因错误调用 footer 回调而失败，其余 189 项 DOM 测试通过；加入一行保护后，**282 项相关输入框／历史单测全部通过**。相同配对用例还要求真实历史浏览返回草稿后仍调用 footer；把保护改为无条件吞键，会让两项再次失败。

既有 **17 项 Chromium 浏览器回归全部通过**，无跳过或重试；这些对照使用仓库模拟 daemon。独立基线复现还覆盖四种短召回序列（搜索／面板 × 先前翻页／未翻页），均观察到焦点落到实际任务按钮；夹具使用受支持的宿主 header 配置（不包含 environment 项）和模拟后台任务数据。

最终独立验证的 **5 项真实构建 CLI／真实 daemon 用例全部通过**，未使用模拟 daemon：短搜索／面板召回保留内容与焦点，重新翻页从最新条目开始并恢复所选草稿，普通短草稿往返也正常。默认 standalone 环境面板会替代旧任务按钮，因此直接 footer 验证分开记录：使用模拟任务数据的 **4 项真实 Chromium 宿主夹具用例全部通过**，确认活动召回时保留输入框焦点、翻页返回草稿后可正常聚焦实际任务按钮。源码及 CLI 校验值与最终产物一致，隔离 daemon 已关闭。

| 交互 | 修复前 | 修复后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 召回短条目，在召回仍活动时按下方向键 | 焦点从输入框转到任务按钮 | 保留输入框焦点与召回文本 |
| 从该召回继续浏览并返回草稿，再按下方向键 | 应保留正常 footer 导航 | footer 焦点交接仍可使用 |

完整构建、bundle、全仓类型检查、lint、改动文件格式及空白检查通过。未宣称新的完整 preflight 或跨平台结果。上游 CI 仍需维护者批准（`action_required`），与本地验证分别记录。

### 本地测试系统

| 系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Chromium、单元测试及构建检查 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 本地未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 本地未测试 |

### 环境（可选）

macOS arm64、Node.js 22.22.3、Chromium build 1234，视口 1100 × 900。生产验证使用隔离的配置、runtime 和 workspace 目录。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：视觉行归属依赖编辑器实际渲染几何。浏览器回归覆盖双向文本、自动换行、状态转换、选区与草稿恢复；未宣称性能提升。
- 未验证或超出范围：其他浏览器引擎、Windows/Linux、触摸设备 textarea、模型执行及 RTL 文档末尾到 footer 的直接焦点交接。
- 破坏性变更或迁移：无。

## 关联 Issue

修复 #14879。

prs.title: fix(memory): report omitted index entries at write time
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Rebuilt memory indexes report omitted index entries and scan-capped topic files separately, with a count and up to three bounded names per set. The next prompt preserves the writer diagnostic. The counts remain separate because one grouped team entry can represent several topic files.

Scan-only omissions describe an incomplete catalog and give a file-count remedy. Writer advice targets durable topic-file changes. Length advice applies only if bringing overlong candidates to the ordinary line bound would remove character overflow; a discarded long candidate does not change the diagnosis when ordinary entries alone still exceed the budget. The distinct huge-path case retains length advice.

The change preserves native-first ordering and the native-prefix character-budget priority, including long native links, while keeping both omission diagnostics. No import behavior is added beyond main.

Fixes #14877. Reader-advice follow-up is separate in #15368 (#15277 item 1). The eight previously deferred Suggestions remain tracked in #15277.

## Reviewer test plan

- Rebuild stores beyond the scan cap. Check topic-file counts and bounded names survive persistence and prompt loading, separately from index-budget entry counts.
- Keep under-budget stores silent, preserve retained identities/order, and retain the existing team grouping and deterministic selection.
- With 199 ordinary entries plus a discarded encoded-path candidate, shortening that candidate must not change the retained 165 entries or falsely turn count pressure into a length diagnosis. A lone huge path must retain length advice.
- Add newer imported files to a store containing older native entries. Native entries, including a long link, must survive both scoped and arbitrary-root rebuilding; imported files use spare capacity.
- Check the mixed-cap fixture reports **32 of 200 entries** and **207 of 407 topic files**, rather than adding the two omission counts.

## Validation

Current head: `12696e61ce3eab3d98ad85e570a58616b909279e`. I integrated main `1eee20a72bb1a4fe53cc1221f5d61e3ed7cf2c93` by a normal, conflict-free merge, including the merged Hosted Harness repair #15455 (`2a9fb6db5235`) and lint-gate update `3b9b35e30dc4`. All ten PR implementation, test and documentation blobs are byte-identical to previous head `e446d330218cf6e57f4eea57a7b7b7df88f6e130`; the net PR changes no CI policy.

Fresh Linux / Node 22.21.1 verification on this exact head passes frozen installation, root build/bundle/typecheck, full repository ESLint, CI-scoped Prettier, **20 CI helper tests**, and the full memory suite (**1,157 passed / 2 skipped**). Bundled CLI version/help and the direct startup-closure check pass; tracked source remains clean.

The [previous upstream Linux job](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40103539804/job/120906235313) failed on seven Hosted Harness scenarios. I reproduced the same seven failures on its integrated base `0d7518f0`, without this PR's memory delta. Main's repair is now included; those seven scenarios and its new accepted-auto case pass in the current full run.

The fresh full Hosted Harness plus approval-selection run is **699 passed / 6 failed**, with retries disabled. The six are different from the original seven: five timeouts and a release-call-count assertion. All six pass when selected together on this exact head (**6/6**) and on exact main `1eee20a72b` with the complete PR delta removed (**6/6**). An independent combined run of the fourteen original/new Harness cases and all approval-selection tests passes (**14 + 28**). This does not establish a deterministic inherited bug or make the full run green: full-suite order/timing remains unresolved. No source, timeout, retry or CI policy was changed to mask it. New native upstream CI and maintainer review remain separate gates.

<details>
<summary>Local full-run reproduction</summary>

Failed cases (all under `Hosted Harness no-tool session`):

- `retries an interrupted channel Write recovery after a transient fault instead of latching blocked`
- `retains cleanup debt after interrupted channel settlement until original-owner release succeeds`
- `wires the wake pump with the shared recovery predicate (M3b)`
- `restores the saved Hook pin and verifies its message closure (missing: undefined)`

prs.title: fix(core): re-inject path-conditional rules after their reminder is evicted
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Path-scoped rules from `.qwen/rules/*.md` become injectable again once the conversation loses the tool result that carried their reminder.

A conditional rule is injected at most once, which is what keeps a multi-file sweep from stamping the same block over and over. The consumed marker was session-global and never cleared, but the text it stands for is not durable: it rides a tool result, and old tool results are routinely blanked or replaced. When the text was gone the marker still claimed the rule was resident, so no later tool call could re-inject it for the rest of the session.

The rule this change enforces is that a marker must not outlive the text it stands for, so it clears the markers at all nine places that lose tool results: pre-send microcompaction, both compression paths, auto-compaction, `/rewind`, wholesale history replacement, stripping orphaned trailing entries on retry, a tool result that never reached the model, and `/clear` with its session-rotation variant. Each reset sits beside an invalidation that already exists at that boundary — the read-file cache, memory-body residency, loaded-skill tracking, the delivered memory-tree revision, the IDE context — so conditional rules stop being the one piece of derived "the model has seen this" state left unwired.

It also narrows the user-facing page, which promised the rule was injected once for the rest of the session. That described the old mechanism accurately and is wrong after this change.

## Why it's needed

Users are told a conditional rule governs the session from the moment it is first injected. On the shipped defaults — keep the five most recent tool results, clear on 60 minutes idle or 500K characters of compactable output — the reminder is gone long before the session is, and nothing brings it back. A team that uses `paths:` to gate a sensitive area gets a rule which silently stops applying partway through the session, which is the failure mode the rule was written to prevent.

The most user-visible instance is `/clear`: it hands back an empty conversation in which a `paths:`-gated rule can never fire again, for the life of the process, because neither it nor session rotation rebuilds the registry.

This was reported with the eviction paths and confirmed independently at the mechanism level in #13259 before any code was written. The four additional sites in the second commit came out of the review on this PR: the reviewer grepped every sibling invalidation rather than reading only the diff, which is how the transient-send-failure and `/clear` cases surfaced.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Nothing user-visible changes, so the pinning is at the unit and wiring level.

Run from repository root (workspace-scoped):

```bash
# Targeted test runs across modified packages/core suites:
pnpm --filter @qwen-code/qwen-code-core test packages/core/src/config/rulesDiscovery.test.ts -t "resetInjected|re-injects"
pnpm --filter @qwen-code/qwen-code-core test packages/core/src/core/client.test.ts -t "conditional rule injection markers"
```

Or from `packages/core`:

```bash
cd packages/core
npx vitest run src/core/client.test.ts src/core/client-goal.test.ts src/config/config.test.ts src/config/rulesDiscovery.test.ts src/services/memoryPressureMonitor.test.ts
```

- `packages/core/src/config/rulesDiscovery.test.ts`: verifies the registry re-injects a rule after its markers are cleared, and clearing markers keeps rules.
- `packages/core/src/core/client.test.ts`: verifies each boundary requests a reset, and no-op boundaries (no-op rewind, strip that removed nothing, microcompaction with `tokensSaved === 0`) preserve markers.
- `packages/core/src/core/client-goal.test.ts`: pins the client setup mock contract for goal test suites (round-2 regression fix).
- `packages/core/src/services/memoryPressureMonitor.test.ts`: covers the `compact_history` reset path beside fileReadCache clearing (round-3 fix).
- `/clear` is covered from both directions, since the command reaches the reset through two routes that each clear the read-file cache independently.

To confirm the end-to-end behaviour by hand: add a rule under `.qwen/rules/` with `paths: ['src/**']` and a distinctive string in its body, have the agent read a file under `src/`, then drive enough further tool calls that the first result falls out of the retained window (the size trigger is far easier to hit than idling for an hour), then have it read a different file under `src/`. Before this change: no reminder at all. After: the rule is re-emitted. `[TOOL-RESULT MC]` in the debug log is the signal that the carrier actually went.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — not user-visible. Verified locally across all four commits with Node 22 (`corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`):

```console
$ cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core/client.test.ts src/core/client-goal.test.ts src/config/config.test.ts src/config/rulesDiscovery.test.ts src/services/memoryPressureMonitor.test.ts
Test Files  5 passed (5)
     Tests  1577 passed (1577)
```

`npx prettier --check` is clean on all five touched files, and `npx eslint` is clean on the four TypeScript ones.

The assertions are load-bearing rather than decorative, checked by mutation against the full file rather than a filtered run: with the reset made a no-op, 9 of 482 tests fail — every conditional-rule assertion the file carries, and nothing else. With the four compaction calls disabled, exactly the 4 tests carrying those assertions fail and 478 pass. Removing the session-rotation call fails its own test while the sibling test in the same block stays green.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22 with `corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, then `npm run build --workspace=packages/core`, matching the CI setup. Unit tests only; no live session was run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the reset is wholesale, not path-scoped. After a boundary, a rule whose carrier is still inside the retained window can be injected a second time on a later match, costing one duplicate block. Scoping the reset to the evicted paths is possible but incomplete — the eviction metadata only reports paths for the file-path tools, so a rule triggered through any other tool's result would silently stay consumed. Duplicating a reminder is the safer direction of error than dropping one, and the extra cost is bounded by rules whose carriers were actually evicted.
- Not validated / out of scope: no end-to-end session run, so the user-visible drift is inferred from the mechanism rather than reproduced with a live model. Deliberately not fixed here: derived (subagent) configs share the parent's registry, so a rule consumed inside a subagent context is lost to the parent session and vice versa. That one is not reachable by clearing markers at eviction boundaries, because the parent never had a carrier to evict; it needs a scoping decision from a maintainer and is documented in #13259.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none in behaviour. Rules are injected more often after a boundary; the intra-boundary dedup and every other behaviour are unchanged. The documentation change moves the promise to match the mechanism, which is what the mechanism has actually guaranteed since conditional rules were introduced.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13259

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

当对话丢失了承载提醒的那条工具结果之后，来自 `.qwen/rules/*.md` 的按路径生效规则会重新变为可注入。

条件规则只注入一次，这正是让一次多文件操作不会反复盖上同一段文本的机制。但"已消费"标记是会话级的、且从不清除，而它代表的文本并不持久：文本挂在工具结果上，而旧工具结果会被例行清空或替换。文本消失后，标记仍然声称该规则仍在上下文中，于是后续任何工具调用都无法再注入它，这个规则在本次会话余下的时间里就再也不会出现。

本改动要执行的不变量是"标记不得活过它所代表的文本"，因此在全部九处"历史丢失工具结果"的位置清除标记：发送前的微压缩、两条压缩路径、自动压缩、`/rewind`、整段历史替换、重试时剥离孤立的尾部条目、从未送达模型的工具结果，以及 `/clear` 及其会话轮换变体。每一处重置都落在一个已存在于该边界的失效动作旁边——读文件缓存、记忆正文驻留状态、已加载 skill 跟踪、已投递的记忆树修订号、IDE 上下文——因此条件规则不再是唯一一个还没接上的派生"模型已看过"状态。

它同时收窄了面向用户的那一页文档，原文承诺该规则"注入一次、整个会话有效"——那准确描述了旧机制，但在本改动之后已不成立。

## 为什么需要

用户被告知：条件规则自首次注入起，在整个会话内生效。但按出厂默认值——只保留最近 5 条工具结果，空闲 60 分钟或可压缩输出累计 50 万字符即触发清除——提醒远在会话结束前就消失了，且没有任何机制把它带回来。若团队用 `paths:` 给某个敏感区域设防，会得到一条在会话中途静默失效的规则，而这恰恰是该规则本来要防止的失效模式。

用户最可见的一例是 `/clear`：它交回的是一个空会话，而在该进程余生里 `paths:` 规则再也无法触发——因为它与会话轮换都不重建注册表。

这个问题在 #13259 中带着驱逐路径被报告，并在写任何代码之前由维护者独立确认了机制层面成立。第二个提交中的另外四处来自本 PR 的评审：评审者 grep 了所有同类失效动作、而不只是读 diff，正是这样找出了"瞬时发送失败"与 `/clear` 两种情况。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

没有用户可见的变化，因此钉住它的测试在单元与接线层面。

在仓库根目录运行（工作区范围）：

```bash
# 针对修改后的 packages/core 套件单项运行：
pnpm --filter @qwen-code/qwen-code-core test packages/core/src/config/rulesDiscovery.test.ts -t "resetInjected|re-injects"
pnpm --filter @qwen-code/qwen-code-core test packages/core/src/core/client.test.ts -t "conditional rule injection markers"
```

或进入 `packages/core` 运行：

```bash
cd packages/core
npx vitest run src/core/client.test.ts src/core/client-goal.test.ts src/config/config.test.ts src/config/rulesDiscovery.test.ts src/services/memoryPressureMonitor.test.ts
```

- `packages/core/src/config/rulesDiscovery.test.ts`：验证清除标记后注册表会重新注入规则，且清除标记不会丢掉规则本身。
- `packages/core/src/core/client.test.ts`：验证每个边界都会请求重置，而空操作边界（空操作回退、什么都没剥离的 strip、`tokensSaved === 0` 的微压缩）会保留标记。
- `packages/core/src/core/client-goal.test.ts`：钉住目标测试套件的客户端 mock 契约（第 2 轮回归修复）。
- `packages/core/src/services/memoryPressureMonitor.test.ts`：覆盖 `compact_history` 重置路径及读文件缓存清除（第 3 轮修复）。
- `/clear` 从两个方向覆盖：该命令通过两条各自独立清除读文件缓存的路径抵达重置。

手工确认端到端行为：在 `.qwen/rules/` 下加一条 `paths: ['src/**']` 的规则，正文里放一个独特字符串；让 agent 读一个 `src/` 下的文件；再驱动足够多的工具调用，使第一条结果掉出保留窗口（体积触发比等一小时空闲容易得多）；然后让它读 `src/` 下的另一个文件。改动前：完全没有提醒。改动后：规则会被重新发出。调试日志里的 `[TOOL-RESULT MC]` 是载体确实已消失的信号。

### 证据（改动前后）

N/A —— 非用户可见。以下为全部 4 个提交在本地、Node 22、`corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` 下的实测运行结果：

```console
$ cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core/client.test.ts src/core/client-goal.test.ts src/config/config.test.ts src/config/rulesDiscovery.test.ts src/services/memoryPressureMonitor.test.ts
Test Files  5 passed (5)
     Tests  1577 passed (1577)
```

五个改动文件上的 `npx prettier --check` 无问题，四个 TypeScript 文件上的 `npx eslint` 无问题。

这些断言是承重的，不是装饰，且是在**完整文件**上（而非过滤后的子集）做变异检验得出的：把重置改成空操作时，482 个测试中 9 个失败——文件里承载的每一条条件规则断言全中，且没有牵连其它测试。禁用四处压缩调用时，恰好承载这些断言的 4 个测试失败、478 个通过。移除会话轮换那一处时，其自身测试失败，而同块内的邻居测试仍为绿。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### 环境（可选）

Node 22 搭配 `corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`，随后 `npm run build --workspace=packages/core`，与 CI 保持一致。仅运行单元测试，未跑真实会话。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：重置是整体的，不是按路径的。跨越边界之后，若某条规则的载体仍在保留窗口内，后续匹配可能让它被注入第二次，代价是一段重复文本。把重置限定到被驱逐的路径虽然可行但不完整——驱逐元数据只为文件路径类工具上报路径，因此通过其它工具结果触发的规则会静默地保持"已消费"。重复一条提醒比丢掉一条更安全，而额外开销被"载体确实被驱逐"的规则所限制。
- 未验证 / 超出本 PR 范围：未做端到端会话运行，因此用户可见的偏移是由机制推断而来，而非用真实模型复现。本 PR 有意不修的一项：派生的（子代理）配置与父会话共享同一个注册表，因此在子代理上下文里被消费的规则会对父会话丢失，反之亦然。这一问题无法通过在驱逐边界清除标记来修复，因为父会话从头到尾都没有可被驱逐的载体；它需要维护者决定作用域划分方式，已在 #13259 中记录。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：行为上无。跨边界后规则会被更频繁地注入；边界内的去重与其它行为均未改变。文档改动是把承诺调整到与机制一致，而这本来就是条件规则引入以来机制实际保证的东西。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #13259

</details>

prs.title: feat: project agent identity and Agent Team delivery onto the ACP/daemon wire (refs #13785)
prs.body:
## What this PR does Projects agent identity and Agent Team coordination onto the ACP/daemon wire, in two deliberately distinct collaboration columns. Subagent column (parent→child delegation): every projected subagent frame (thought, message, tool call, tool call update) now carries `_meta.agent = { agentName, depth, kind }` with a path-style name (`/root/general-purpose`), mirroring OpenAI Responses' per-item `agent` identity; the Web Shell keeps that path on the subagent panel name as a `title` tooltip only — no visible path chip ships in this slice (`SubAgentPanel.tsx:345`; pinned by `SubAgentPanel.test.tsx` `keeps the path on the name title without rendering it as a chip`). `agentName` is a readable role path, not a unique execution id: concurrent same-type subagents share it, and renaming the agent definition changes it. `parentToolCallId` distinguishes subagent executions; that boundary is documented on both the producer and the normalizer. Agent Team column (peer complete agents): an ACP-hosted session now attaches a leader sink (`team-sink.ts`). Before this, `TeamManager.pollLeaderInbox()` returned before consuming on this host (teammate reports stayed unread in the leader inbox) and `TEAMMATE_APPROVAL_REQUEST` was void-emitted — the coordination never reached anyone. Now teammate reports are delivered as `peer` background notifications carrying structured sender identity (`kind: 'teammate'`, minted from the inbox entry's `from`, never parsed from message text), roster joins/exits are projected as peer notifications so an already-attached client can track membership transitions (there is no current-state snapshot for late attach or reconnect), and teammate tool approvals route to the client's `requestPermission` (fail-closed: Cancel plus a `` to the leader when the host cannot answer; YOLO auto-approve only when the request carries no renderable details). ## Why it's needed #13785 records the gap: the public vocabulary names child agents and teams, but nothing a client receives says which agent produced what. Both reference protocols (OpenAI Responses multi-agent, Anthropic Managed Agents) treat agent identity as contractual. This slice delivers the identity dimension on the daemon/ACP projection and removes the "ACP host has no leader sink" failure class — the zero-signal class among the three host classes in #13785 M4 — giving M1b a reference wire shape. Peer delivery reuses core's existing `'peer'` background-notification channel (idle wake, loss accounting, kind-agnostic drain/display), without a new peer runtime. Team-binding approval retirement now uses one private, versioned `qwen/notify/session/teammate-binding-ended` notification on the existing SDK 0.14.1 connection; it adds no daemon REST route or public mediator API. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify At `3499b027c4faa`, 2,106 focused cases, targeted ESLint/Prettier, five affected workspace typechecks and integration typecheck passed on the exact committed candidate. Approval retirement, status identity, activity isolation and canonical START behavior were mutation-checked. A serialized ACP component probe verified old-binding cancellation and replacement approval at cap 1; a local macOS browser rendered the real transcript pipeline with injected protocol frames without splitting leader output or taking its usage. Main was synchronized to supply the current CI budget helper; obsolete assistant-activity handling was removed, and the rebuilt transcript's size ceiling was **raised** from 1,338,000 (main) to 1,340,000 in `packages/web-shell/client/build-artifact.test.ts` — merged with main the entry measures 1,338,274 UTF-16 units, past both main's ceiling and the 1,338,500 this branch carried. See the [current repair report](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#issuecomment-6192665587) for build results and verification limits. No real-provider or full daemon/browser E2E was run for this repair. The [real-model report and screenshots at `df760052100d1`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#issuecomment-6138227209) and the runtime observations below are historical evidence, not current-head acceptance. Real machine: boot the daemon from this branch with `QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_AGENT_TEAM=1 node scripts/dev.js serve --port

--token --workspace

`, create a session, send a team prompt (`team_create`, then spawn teammate `correctness` asking it to report one sentence ending in a marker). Expected and observed on SSE: peer notifications `teammate-roster-1` (status joined) and `teammate-message-2/3`, each carrying `_meta.agent={"agentName":"/root/correctness","depth":1,"kind":"teammate"}`, plus leader-reply frames with `source=background_notification_response`; the same capture contains zero subagent-column frames. Contrast run without a team: 47 `parentToolCallId`-chained frames carrying `kind:'subagent'` and zero peer markers — the two columns are mutually attributable at a glance. The Web Shell rendered the peer rows (`ⓘ … · peer`) and the verbatim teammate report in a real headless Chromium against the same daemon. ### Evidence (Before & After) Before: on this host an ACP session with a team delivered 0 teammate reports (retained unread in the leader inbox) and emitted 0 approval signals; no projected object carried any agent identity. After: the SSE markers and browser rendering described above. ### Tested on (earlier runtime acceptance) | OS | Status | | :--------: | :-------------: | | 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ not tested | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested | | 🐧 Linux | ✅ tested | ### Environment (optional) Linux host; daemon via `node scripts/dev.js serve` (no bundle step); headless Chromium (playwright) for Web Shell rendering; unit suites via vitest with `env -u QWEN_CODE_SERVE -u QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR`. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: identity is additive `_meta`; older readers ignore it. Teammate identity is minted only for single-sender batches — mixed-sender batches stay unattributed rather than misattributed. Status/idle team events are deliberately not projected (each would wake the leader into an automatic turn). Join/exit notifications are incremental, so a client that attaches late still needs a non-waking roster snapshot/query before it can claim authoritative current membership. - Not validated / out of scope: managed-agent public-contract projections (#13785 M1a/M2/M3) and client intervention verbs (M4) remain design surfaces; foreground nested subagents do not project their own frames today (verified on real machine: single `parentToolCallId` layer, depth values only 1), so depth ≥ 2 identity has no wire producer yet — nested trees remain record-projection work (M1a); cross-session teammate projection is M1b/M3. Mailbox consumption and model-visible delivery are not transactional; crash-safe redelivery after process/session destruction remains follow-up work, and reversible-close retention does not provide that guarantee. - Breaking changes / migration notes: identity fields are additive. Approval retirement requires this CLI/bridge pair; older bridges that ignore the new private notification retain the previous stale-approval behavior. No new daemon REST routes, public mediator APIs, dependencies or persisted formats. ## Linked Issues Refs #13785 (referenced without a closing keyword: the public-contract milestones remain open design work).
中文说明 ## 本 PR 做了什么 把 agent 身份与 Agent Team 协调投影到 ACP/daemon 的 wire 上，分为刻意保持区分的两条协作列。 subagent 列（父子委派）：每个投影出的 subagent 帧（thought、message、tool call、tool call update）现在都带 `_meta.agent = { agentName, depth, kind }`，名字为 path 风格（`/root/general-purpose`），与 OpenAI Responses 的逐 item `agent` 身份同形；Web Shell 本片只把该 path 挂在 subagent 面板名字的 `title` tooltip 上，不渲染可见的 path chip（`SubAgentPanel.tsx:345`；由 `SubAgentPanel.test.tsx` 的 `keeps the path on the name title without rendering it as a chip` 钉住）。`agentName` 是可读的角色 path，并不是唯一执行 ID：同类型并发 subagent 会共享它，agent 定义改名也会改变它；`parentToolCallId` 用于区分 subagent 执行，这一边界在生产侧与 normalizer 两侧都有文档。 Agent Team 列（对等完整 agent）：ACP 托管会话现在会挂一个 leader sink（`team-sink.ts`）。在此之前，本宿主上 `TeamManager.pollLeaderInbox()` 会在消费前早退（队员报告留在 leader inbox 里未读），`TEAMMATE_APPROVAL_REQUEST` 空 emit——协调过程到不了任何人手里。现在队员报告以 `peer` 背景通知投递，带结构化发送者身份（`kind: 'teammate'`，从 inbox 条目的 `from` 铸造，绝不从消息文本解析）；roster 的加入/退出投影为 peer 通知，已挂载的客户端可跟踪成员变化（晚挂载或重连时没有当前状态快照）；队员的工具审批路由到客户端 `requestPermission`（fail-closed：宿主无法应答时 Cancel 并向 leader 注入 ``；仅当请求不带可渲染细节且处于 YOLO 时才自动批准）。 ## 为什么需要 #13785 记录了缺口：公共词表里有 child agent 与 team，但客户端收到的任何东西都不说明「哪条输出是哪个 agent 产的」。两个参照协议（OpenAI Responses multi-agent、Anthropic Managed Agents）都把 agent 身份当契约内容。本片在 daemon/ACP 投影侧交付身份维度，并消掉「ACP 宿主没有 leader sink」这一失效类——即 #13785 M4 三类宿主中的零信号类——为 M1b 给出参考 wire 形状。peer 投递复用 core 既有的 `'peer'` 背景通知通道（空闲唤醒、丢失记账、kind 无关的 drain/display），不增加 peer runtime。队绑定审批回收新增一条私有、版本化的 `qwen/notify/session/teammate-binding-ended` 通知，走既有 SDK 0.14.1 连接；不添加 daemon REST 路由或 public mediator API。 ## 评审测试计划 ### 如何验证 `3499b027c4faa` 的精确提交候选通过 2,106 条聚焦用例、定向 ESLint/Prettier、五个相关 workspace 的类型检查和 integration 类型检查；审批回收、status 身份、活动隔离与 START canonical 行为做过变异反证。真实 ACP 串行化组件链路以 cap 1 验证旧绑定取消和新绑定审批；本地 macOS 浏览器通过真实 transcript 流水线渲染注入的协议帧，leader 答案与 usage 未被活动切断或夺走。已同步 main 补齐当前 CI 预算脚本，并删除旧 assistant 活动路径；重建 transcript 的体积阈值是**上调**的——由 main 的 1,338,000 提到 `packages/web-shell/client/build-artifact.test.ts` 里的 1,340,000，因为与 main 合并后该 entry 实测 1,338,274 UTF-16 单位，同时超出 main 的阈值和本分支此前携带的 1,338,500。构建结果与验证限制见[本轮修复报告](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#issuecomment-6192665587)。本轮未跑真实模型或完整 daemon/browser E2E。[`df760052100d1` 的真实模型报告与截图](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#issuecomment-6138227209)及下方真机记录仅为历史证据，不作为当前 head 验收。 真机：从本分支起 daemon（`QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_AGENT_TEAM=1 node scripts/dev.js serve --port

--token --workspace

`），建会话，发 team prompt（`team_create`，再派 teammate `correctness` 要求其回一句以 marker 结尾的话）。SSE 上期望并实测到：peer 通知 `teammate-roster-1`（status joined）与 `teammate-message-2/3`，均带 `_meta.agent={"agentName":"/root/correctness","depth":1,"kind":"teammate"}`，以及 `source=background_notification_response` 的 leader 回话帧；同一抓帧中 subagent 列帧为零。不带 team 的对照跑：47 帧 `parentToolCallId` 链帧带 `kind:'subagent'`、peer 标记零命中——两列形状互斥、可一眼归因。Web Shell 在真 headless Chromium 中对同一 daemon 渲染出了 peer 行（`ⓘ … · peer`）与队员原话。 ### 证据（Before & After） Before：本宿主上带 team 的 ACP 会话投递 0 条队员报告（留在 leader inbox 未读）、0 个审批信号；任何投影对象都不带 agent 身份。After：上述 SSE 标记与浏览器渲染。 ### Tested on（较早版本的真机验收） | OS | Status | | :--------: | :-------------: | | 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 未测试 | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 | | 🐧 Linux | ✅ 已测试 | ### 环境（可选） Linux 宿主机；daemon 走 `node scripts/dev.js serve`（无 bundle 步骤）；Web Shell 渲染用 headless Chromium（playwright）；单测走 vitest 并加 `env -u QWEN_CODE_SERVE -u QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR`。 ## 风险与范围 - 主要风险或权衡：身份是 additive `_meta`，旧读者会忽略它。teammate 身份只为单发送者批次铸造——混合发送者批次宁可无身份也不张冠李戴。status/idle 队事件刻意不投影（每条都会唤醒 leader 起一个自动 turn）。加入/退出通知是增量流，晚挂载客户端仍需要一个不会唤醒 leader 的 roster 快照/查询，才能声称拿到了权威当前成员表。 - 未验证 / 超出范围：managed-agent 公共契约投影（#13785 M1a/M2/M3）与客户端干预动词（M4）仍是设计面；foreground 嵌套 subagent 今天不投影自身帧（真机验过：parentToolCallId 仅一层、depth 取值仅 1），故 depth ≥ 2 身份暂无 wire 生产者——嵌套树仍是记录投影工作（M1a）；跨 session 的 teammate 投影属 M1b/M3。mailbox 消费与模型可见投递不是事务；进程崩溃或会话销毁后的安全重投递留到后续，可逆 close 时保留队列不构成这一保证。 - 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：身份字段为 additive。审批回收需要本轮配套 CLI/bridge；忽略新增私有通知的旧 bridge 仍保留此前的陈旧审批行为。不添加 daemon REST 路由、public mediator API、依赖或持久化格式。 ## 关联 Issue Refs #13785（不用 closing 关键字引用：公共契约里程碑仍是开放的设计工作）。

prs.title: feat(verify-pr): declare an argument hint for the command prompt
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds `argument-hint` to the `verify-pr` skill's frontmatter. Typing `/verify-pr` in the prompt showed no parameter hint while `/review` did, because the TUI renders that field — `SuggestionsDisplay` and `/help` both print `name + argumentHint` — and this skill declared only `name` and `description`. The hint lists the PR number and every flag the skill accepts: `--publish`, `--watch`, `--repo`, `--assets-repo`, `--assets-branch`.

## Why it's needed

Without the field, `/verify-pr` looks like it takes no arguments, so a maintainer has to read a 1500-line skill to discover the flags. `/review` carries exactly this affordance for exactly this reason, and the two commands sit next to each other in the same prompt.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Type `/verify-pr` in the prompt of a session whose workspace contains this skill: the suggestion block should show the hint under the command name, the way `/review` does. `/help` should also print `/verify-pr <pr-number> [--publish] …`. Deleting the frontmatter line makes both disappear.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the frontmatter carried only `name` and `description`, so the command rendered bare. After: the running daemon reports the field for this workspace —

```
"argumentHint": "<pr-number> [--publish] [--watch] [--repo <owner>/<repo>] [--assets-repo <owner>/<repo>] [--assets-branch <branch>]"
```

read from `GET /workspaces/<id>/runtime/skills`. There is no TUI screenshot: this machine has no `tmux`, so I could not drive the interactive prompt. That field is what the TUI renders.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  N/A   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Linux: the new `declares an argument hint for the command prompt` test passes, and Prettier is clean on both files; the JSON above came from the live daemon. The interactive rendering itself was not observed here (no tmux).

### Environment (optional)

0.26.1 CLI, daemon on `:4170`, workspace `qwen-code-x4`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a hint is a promise, so it can drift when a flag is renamed. The scripts assertion pins every flag the hint lists, so dropping one reddens the test.
- Not validated / out of scope: the TUI rendering itself (no tmux on this machine), and the Web Shell path that consumes the same daemon field.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

给 `verify-pr` skill 的 frontmatter 增加 `argument-hint`。在输入框输入 `/verify-pr` 时没有参数提示，而 `/review` 有——TUI 渲染的正是这个字段（`SuggestionsDisplay` 与 `/help` 都打印 `name + argumentHint`），而本 skill 只声明了 `name` 与 `description`。提示列出 PR 号与 skill 接受的全部参数：`--publish`、`--watch`、`--repo`、`--assets-repo`、`--assets-branch`。

## 为什么需要

没有这个字段，`/verify-pr` 看起来像是不接受参数，维护者只能去读 1500 行的 skill 才知道有哪些参数。`/review` 正是为此保留了这个提示，而两个命令就挨在同一个输入框里。

## Reviewer Test Plan

在工作区包含该 skill 的会话里输入 `/verify-pr`：建议区应在命令名下方显示提示，与 `/review` 一致；`/help` 也应打印 `/verify-pr <pr-number> [--publish] …`。删掉 frontmatter 里那一行，两处都会消失。

### Evidence

改动前 frontmatter 只有 `name` 与 `description`，命令裸显示。改动后，运行中的 daemon 为该工作区报告了该字段（`GET /workspaces/<id>/runtime/skills`）：


没有 TUI 截图：本机没有 `tmux`，无法驱动交互输入框；TUI 渲染的就是上面这个字段。

### Tested on

- 主要风险：提示是一种承诺，参数改名会让它漂移。scripts 断言钉住了提示里列出的每个参数，删掉任一个都会变红。
- 未验证/超出范围：TUI 的渲染本身（本机无 tmux），以及消费同一 daemon 字段的 Web Shell 路径。
- 破坏性变更：无。

prs.title: fix(ci): retry transient npm publishes in the release step
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The release publish step now retries a failed recursive npm publish instead of failing the whole release on the first transient registry response. It makes up to four attempts with 30 s, 60 s, and 90 s backoff, and revalidates cached registry metadata on each retry so packages already published by the previous attempt are skipped rather than republished.

## Why it's needed

The nightly release for `v0.26.1-nightly.20261024.f4f602d606` failed in the publish job after publishing only `@qwen-code/channel-base`. The registry committed that package about 52 seconds after the step ended, which is consistent with the registry still processing the first upload when the next one was attempted. A single transient response should not abandon a nightly release after one of its packages has already shipped; the retry gives the registry time to finish and resumes at the package that failed. If every attempt fails, the step still exits with the original status, so real failures are not masked.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the focused release-workflow suite and confirm the retry, the four-attempt bound, and the metadata revalidation all pass. To see the behavior directly, temporarily point the step at a mock `corepack` that fails once before succeeding; the step should make two publish calls, add `--prefer-online` to the second, and still publish the generated CLI afterwards.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-visible output. Before: one failed `pnpm -r publish` call failed the step. After: transient failures are retried; persistent failures still exit with pnpm's status after four attempts.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux sandbox, Node.js 22, pnpm 11.24.0 via corepack; focused Vitest suite with mocked `corepack`/`npm`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a deterministic publish failure now takes up to three minutes longer before failing, because the step retries three times first.
- Not validated / out of scope: the exact registry error from the original run is not readable without repository-admin credentials; the fix addresses the partial-publish timing shown by the registry state, not one specific error string.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15484

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的作用

发布流程的 publish 步骤现在会重试失败的递归 npm 发布，而不是在 registry 第一次返回瞬时响应时就中止整个发布。最多尝试四次，退避间隔为 30 秒、60 秒和 90 秒；每次重试都会重新校验缓存的 registry 元数据，从而跳过上一次尝试已经发布的包，而不是重复发布。

## 为什么需要

`v0.26.1-nightly.20261024.f4f602d606` 的 nightly 发布在 publish 作业中失败，当时只发布了 `@qwen-code/channel-base`。registry 在该步骤结束后约 52 秒才记录这个包，这与下一次上传发起时 registry 仍在处理第一次上传的情况相符。一个瞬时响应不应该在某个包已经发布后放弃整次 nightly 发布；重试给 registry 留出完成处理的时间，并从失败的包继续。如果所有尝试都失败，步骤仍以原始状态退出，因此真实失败不会被掩盖。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

运行聚焦的 release-workflow 测试套件，确认重试、四次尝试上限和元数据重新校验都能通过。要直接观察行为，可以临时让该步骤使用一个第一次失败、第二次成功的模拟 `corepack`；步骤应该发起两次发布调用，第二次带上 `--prefer-online`，并且之后仍然发布生成的 CLI。

### 证据（修改前与修改后）

N/A——没有用户可见输出。修改前：一次 `pnpm -r publish` 失败就会让步骤失败。修改后：瞬时失败会重试；持续失败在四次尝试后仍以 pnpm 的状态退出。

### 测试环境

|    操作系统     | 状态 |
| :-------------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS       |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows      |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux       |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

Linux 沙箱，Node.js 22，通过 corepack 使用 pnpm 11.24.0；使用模拟的 `corepack`/`npm` 运行聚焦的 Vitest 套件。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：确定性的发布失败现在会多花最多三分钟才失败，因为步骤会先重试三次。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：没有仓库管理员凭据，无法读取原始运行的确切 registry 错误；本次修复针对 registry 状态所显示的部分发布时序问题，而不是某一条具体错误文本。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #15484

</details>

prs.title: feat(ci): bound autofix takeover with a round budget
prs.body:
## What this PR does

`@qwen-code /takeover` gains a bounded form. A maintainer can now write `@qwen-code /takeover for N` (N = 1–99), which engages takeover exactly like the bare command and additionally records a window-scoped round budget on the acknowledge comment. The loop runs at most N rounds for that engagement; once the budget is spent, a human-authored PR is released — one bilingual note, the takeover label removed, no `autofix/needs-human` and no "reached its round cap" pause. A bot-authored PR keeps the existing paused outcome instead, because it is managed without the label and releasing it would hand the PR back to standard ten-round management. Failed, timed-out and crashed rounds consume budget, so N means N attempts rather than N successes.

The form sits beside the existing `stop` and `from N`; the two parameterized forms do not combine, `for 0` is rejected because that is what `stop` already means, and every other body still fails closed with no label and no receipt.

## Why it's needed

Takeover is deliberately persistent: it applies a label, raises the round cap from 10 to 100, and a ten-minute scan keeps managing the PR. Maintainers routinely want something narrower — look at this feedback, fix it, leave the PR alone — and today both workarounds are poor. Spending the cap with `from 99` makes that single round Critical-only and ends in a "reached its round cap" pause with the escalation label, which reads like a failure rather than a finished engagement. Stopping by hand gives a full-scope round but requires watching the run and remembering to release it; forgetting costs up to 100 rounds.

`for N` states the intent directly and bounds it in the same act. It also makes the failure policy explicit: a round that errors still consumes its turn, so a PR that keeps failing stops instead of being retried until a breaker fires.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the replay tests that pin this behaviour: `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts qwen-autofix-workflow -t "budget|round seed"` (the suite spawns `jq`, so it needs jq on PATH). Expect the parser cases to accept `for 1`, `for 02`, `for 99` and reject `for 0`, `for 100`, `for 3 please`, `stop for 3`, `from 3 for 2` and the command-substitution payloads; expect the ack cases to find `<!-- autofix-round-budget N -->` on both the fresh-engage and re-arm paths; expect the cap-read cases to lower the effective cap to N on the current window and ignore a previous window's budget; and expect the release case to post one "budget spent" note, delete the label, and never write the escalation label — while an unreadable label snapshot, a skip label, an already-released PR, a mismatched token identity and a dry run all write nothing.

After merge, on a scratch PR: comment `@qwen-code /takeover for 1`. The ack should carry the budget sentence, one round should run at full scope, and the next scan should post the "budget spent" note and remove the label without adding `autofix/needs-human`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — this changes a comment command in a workflow, not a UI, so there is nothing to screenshot; the evidence is the replay output in the verification comment.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — the test suite replays the workflow's shell blocks verbatim from the file; no live workflow run was possible locally.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the release writes live in the scan's existing cap funnel, so they inherit its consent re-read, token-identity check and per-window dedup; a failed label removal is retried by the next scan while the note stays deduplicated. The budget rides on the acknowledge comment, so an ack that never lands degrades the engagement to unbounded takeover — the same exposure the round-seed marker already has.
- Not validated / out of scope: the live trigger path (it only runs in this repository with the bot token), and the macOS/Windows runners. The feature does not touch the round caps, the breakers, Critical-only, the growth budgets, or the fleet shepherd.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Existing commands are unchanged; a budgeted window opens at round 0 like any re-arm.
- Design docs: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/autofix-takeover-round-budget/docs/design/2026-10-24-autofix-takeover-round-budget.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/autofix-takeover-round-budget/docs/design/2026-10-24-autofix-takeover-round-budget.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

None — this came out of a maintainer question about making takeover a one-off engagement.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

`@qwen-code /takeover` 多了一个有界形式。维护者现在可以写 `@qwen-code /takeover for N`（N = 1–99），它的接管语义与裸命令完全一致，只是在 ack 评论上额外记录一个窗口级轮次预算。该窗口最多跑 N 轮；预算耗尽时，人工提交的 PR 会被释放 —— 发一条中英双语通知、移除 takeover 标签，不打 `autofix/needs-human`，也不发"到达轮次上限"的暂停通知。bot 提交的 PR 则保留原有的暂停结果，因为它没有标签也受管，释放等于把 PR 交回标准十轮管理。失败、超时、崩溃的轮次同样消耗预算，所以 N 是"尝试次数"而不是"成功次数"。

这种形式与既有的 `stop`、`from N` 并列；两种参数化形式不能组合，`for 0` 被拒绝（那正是 `stop` 的语义），其它任何评论体依旧失败关闭：不打标签，也没有任何回执。

## 为什么需要

接管刻意是常驻的：打标签、把轮次上限从 10 抬到 100，然后每十分钟一次的扫描持续管理。维护者经常要的其实更窄 —— 看一遍这批反馈、修掉、别再动这个 PR —— 而如今两条绕法都不好。用 `from 99` 把上限一次花掉，那一轮会变成 Critical-only，并以"到达轮次上限"的暂停加升级标签收场，读起来像故障而不是一次结束的托管。手动 stop 能得到完整范围的一轮，但要人盯着运行并记得释放；忘了就要付最多 100 轮。

`for N` 直接把意图说出来，并在同一个动作里把它限住。它同时把失败策略写明：报错的轮次也消耗额度，所以一直失败的 PR 会停下，而不是被一路重试到熔断器触发。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

跑钉住该行为的回放测试：`npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts qwen-autofix-workflow -t "budget|round seed"`（测试会 spawn `jq`，需要 PATH 里有 jq）。预期：解析用例接受 `for 1`、`for 02`、`for 99`，拒绝 `for 0`、`for 100`、`for 3 please`、`stop for 3`、`from 3 for 2` 以及命令替换型载荷；ack 用例在全新 engage 与 re-arm 两条路径上都能找到 `<!-- autofix-round-budget N -->`；上限读取用例把当前窗口的有效上限压到 N、并忽略上一个窗口的预算；释放用例只发一条"预算已用完"通知、删除标签、从不写升级标签 —— 而标签快照不可读、存在 skip 标签、PR 已被释放、token 身份不符、dry-run 五种情况都不写任何东西。

合并后，在一个试验 PR 上评论 `@qwen-code /takeover for 1`：ack 应带预算说明，跑一轮完整范围，随后下一次扫描发布"预算已用完"通知并移除标签，且不添加 `autofix/needs-human`。

### 证据（改动前后）

不适用 —— 本改动是 workflow 里的评论命令，不是 UI，没有可截图的对象；证据见验证评论里的回放输出。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

不适用 —— 测试套件逐字回放 workflow 里的 shell 片段，本地无法跑真实 workflow。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险与取舍：释放写入复用扫描既有的 cap 漏斗，因此继承它的同意重读、token 身份校验与按窗口去重；标签删除失败由下一次扫描重试，通知保持去重。预算寄存在 ack 评论上，ack 发不出去会让托管退化为无上限 —— 这是轮次种子标记本来就有的暴露。
- 未验证 / 不在范围：真实触发路径（只在本仓库带 bot token 时运行），以及 macOS/Windows runner。本功能不改轮次上限、熔断器、Critical-only、增长预算或 fleet shepherd。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。既有命令不变；有预算的窗口与任何 re-arm 一样从第 0 轮起算。
- 设计文档：[英文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/autofix-takeover-round-budget/docs/design/2026-10-24-autofix-takeover-round-budget.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/autofix-takeover-round-budget/docs/design/2026-10-24-autofix-takeover-round-budget.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 issue

无 —— 源自维护者关于"让接管变成一次性"的提问。

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): show tool arguments and result in expanded cards
prs.body:
## What this PR does Expanding a tool card in the Web Shell transcript now shows the call itself — its arguments and its result — for every tool that has no built-in detail view, instead of repeating the same one-line result summary that the collapsed row already shows. A JSON object or array is pretty-printed and syntax-highlighted; anything else is shown as recorded. Long payloads keep a visible truncation marker and a Show more action that raises the inline cap from 4,000 to 40,000 characters, matching the trajectory inspector. The call description stays in the collapsed row, so arguments are not shown twice, and plain-text results keep their clickable session links. ## Why it's needed The chevron on these rows promised details the expanded state never delivered: MCP calls, the `tool_call` bridge, `list_directory`, `grep`, `web_fetch` and the rest expanded to the same 80-character summary. The full payload was already available in the per-turn "Tool calls" panel and the trajectory inspector, but not in the conversation, so users had to leave the transcript to read what a tool actually returned. This closes #15280 with the first-PR shape the triage comment proposed: reuse the existing detail primitive, keep the allowlist untouched, and leave configurable caps and managed-session details to follow-ups. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify 1. Build and serve this branch locally: `npm run build && npm run bundle`, then `node dist/cli.js serve --hostname 127.0.0.1 --workspace --port --no-open`, and open the printed URL. 2. In a session, trigger a tool outside the built-in detail renderers: ask for a directory listing, a `grep_search`, or an MCP tool such as `mcp__github__pull_request_read` (use `tool_search` first if it is deferred). 3. Expand the row. Expect two labelled blocks, Arguments and Result. A compact JSON payload should render as an indented, highlighted code block; a plain-text payload should stay preformatted. 4. Collapse the row: the one-line summary should be unchanged, and the expanded header should not repeat the call description. 5. For a payload above 4,000 characters, expect a truncation marker and Show more; clicking it should reveal up to 40,000 characters. 6. Confirm read, edit/write, shell, skill, advisor, ask_user_question, workflow, sub-agent and MCP App cards render exactly as before. ### Evidence (Before & After) Captured on Windows in the locally served Web Shell. Each pair shows the expanded card before the change on the left — still the same one-line summary — and the expanded card after the change on the right, with Arguments and Result; the same card renders in the desktop client and in a browser-attached Web Shell. #### MCP tool | Before | After | | :----: | :---: | | | | #### Grep tool | Before | After | | :----: | :---: | | | | #### ToolSearch | Before | After | | :----: | :---: | | | | Unit tests: 232 in `ToolGroup` / `toolFormatting` / `SubAgentPanel`, 109 in `TurnCallsPanel` / `TrajectoryDetail`; typecheck, ESLint, Prettier and the web-shell build pass. ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ | | 🪟 Windows | ✅ | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ | ### Environment (optional) `npm run build && npm run bundle`, then `node dist/cli.js serve --hostname 127.0.0.1 --workspace --port 64617 --no-open`; Web Shell opened in the browser. Unit tests run per package with vitest. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: every tool outside the built-in allowlist now renders its full payload inline when expanded. Formatting a payload costs a one-time parse and re-serialization on expansion — measured at about 0.5 ms for 100 KB, 2 ms for 500 KB and 6.7 ms for 2 MB on the author's machine; the display itself stays capped at 4,000/40,000 characters. - Not validated / out of scope: managed (hosted) sessions lazy-load details only for read and shell, so MCP details there remain unavailable; MCP App cards keep their dedicated interactive renderer; a configurable cap is a maintainer decision. - Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Collapsed rows, the Tool Calls panel, the trajectory inspector and the CLI TUI are unchanged. ### Follow-up: the `tool_search` envelope `tool_search` results still render as the model-facing `…` envelope, which is why the ToolSearch screenshot shows formatted arguments but a plain-text result. The wrapper is produced only by `tool_search`, and each `` payload is valid JSON once the tag-character escapes are decoded, so a dedicated renderer can list the matched tools with their names, descriptions and pretty-printed schemas while keeping the trailing "Not found" and code-mode notes as text. This is deliberately outside this PR: the envelope is a model-facing contract that core parses for tool reveals and goal provenance, so changing it here would widen the blast radius for no display gain. It will be tracked as a separate follow-up. ## Linked Issues Fixes #15280
中文说明 ## 本 PR 做了什么 在 Web Shell 的会话记录中，展开工具卡片时现在会显示该调用本身——参数和结果——适用于所有没有内置详情视图的工具，而不是重复折叠行里已经出现的一行结果摘要。JSON 对象或数组会被格式化并做语法高亮；其他内容按原样显示。长内容保留截断提示和「Show more」按钮，点击后把内联上限从 4,000 字符提高到 40,000 字符，与轨迹检查器一致。调用描述只保留在折叠行中，避免参数重复出现；纯文本结果中的会话链接仍然可点击。 ## 为什么需要 这些行的展开箭头承诺了展开后并不存在的细节：MCP 调用、`tool_call` 桥、`list_directory`、`grep`、`web_fetch` 等展开后仍然只是同一条 80 字符摘要。完整 payload 早已存在于每轮的「Tool calls」面板和轨迹检查器中，但对话里看不到，用户必须离开会话记录才能读到工具实际返回的内容。本 PR 按 triage 评论建议的首版形态关闭 #15280：复用已有的详情组件，不改白名单，可配置上限与 managed 会话详情留作后续。 ## 审查测试计划 ### 如何验证 1. 在本地构建并启动本分支：`npm run build && npm run bundle`，然后 `node dist/cli.js serve --hostname 127.0.0.1 --workspace --port <空闲端口> --no-open`，打开输出的 URL。 2. 在会话中触发一个不在内置详情渲染器里的工具：目录列表、`grep_search`，或 MCP 工具（如 `mcp__github__pull_request_read`；若被延迟，先用 `tool_search`）。 3. 展开该行。应看到两个带标题的区块：Arguments 与 Result。紧凑 JSON 应渲染为缩进并高亮的代码块；纯文本 payload 保持预格式文本。 4. 折叠该行：一行摘要保持不变，展开后的头部不重复调用描述。 5. 对于超过 4,000 字符的 payload，应出现截断提示和 Show more；点击后最多显示 40,000 字符。 6. 确认 read、edit/write、shell、skill、advisor、ask_user_question、workflow、子代理和 MCP App 卡片与之前完全一致。 ### 证据（前后对比） 在 Windows 上于本地启动的 Web Shell 中截取。每组左侧为改动前的展开卡片（仍然只有一行摘要），右侧为改动后的展开卡片（Arguments 与 Result）；desktop 客户端与浏览器接入的 Web Shell 渲染结果一致。 #### MCP 工具 | 之前 | 之后 | | :--: | :--: | | | | #### Grep 工具 | 之前 | 之后 | | :--: | :--: | | | | #### ToolSearch | 之前 | 之后 | | :--: | :--: | | | | 单元测试：`ToolGroup` / `toolFormatting` / `SubAgentPanel` 共 232 个，`TurnCallsPanel` / `TrajectoryDetail` 共 109 个；typecheck、ESLint、Prettier 和 web-shell 构建均通过。 ### 测试平台 | 操作系统 | 状态 | | :------: | :--: | | 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ | | 🪟 Windows | ✅ | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ | ### 环境（可选） `npm run build && npm run bundle`，然后 `node dist/cli.js serve --hostname 127.0.0.1 --workspace --port 64617 --no-open`；在浏览器中打开 Web Shell。单元测试按包用 vitest 运行。 ## 风险与范围 - 主要风险/取舍：所有不在内置白名单里的工具展开后都会内联渲染完整 payload。展开时格式化需要一次解析和重新序列化——在作者机器上实测约 0.5 ms（100 KB）、2 ms（500 KB）、6.7 ms（2 MB）；显示本身仍限制在 4,000/40,000 字符。 - 未验证/不在范围内：managed（托管）会话只对 read 和 shell 懒加载详情，因此其中的 MCP 详情仍不可用；MCP App 卡片保留专用的交互式渲染器；可配置上限由 maintainer 决定。 - 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。折叠行、Tool Calls 面板、轨迹检查器和 CLI TUI 均未改变。 ### 后续工作：`tool_search` 外层包装 `tool_search` 的结果仍然以模型可读的 `…` 外层形式渲染，因此上图中参数已格式化，而结果仍是纯文本。该外层只由 `tool_search` 产生；每个 `` payload 在解码标签转义后都是合法 JSON，因此可以做一个专用渲染器，列出匹配的工具名、描述和格式化后的 schema，同时把结尾的 "Not found" 与 code-mode 提示保留为文本。这被有意排除在本 PR 之外：该外层是模型侧契约，core 会解析它（工具 reveal 与 goal provenance），在这里改动会扩大影响面却没有显示收益。将作为独立的后续工作跟踪。 ## 关联 Issue Fixes #15280

prs.title: fix(ci): run the sdk-java suite before taking the host lock
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The self-hosted SDK Java test job no longer holds the per-host Maven lock while it runs the SDK and Managed Agent suites. It seeds a job-local Maven repository from the host cache, runs every Maven command from that job-local copy without the lock, and takes the ticketed host lock only for the cache write-back. The write-back is the only remaining host-shared mutation; it is bounded at 300 seconds, and its children close the lock fd so a cancelled job's survivor cannot retain the lock.

The workflow pins, the fair-lock design document in English and Chinese, and the recorded workflow size move with the mechanism.

## Why it's needed

Run 39755183699's full-tier Java 11 leg waited its entire 5,400-second lock budget as queue ticket 249 and failed before running a test: "sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes". The queue was working — the ticket was promoted to the fast class after 20 minutes — but the hold in front of it outlasted the budget. The MariaDB lane was already scoped to its cache write-back by #15128; the test job was the remaining site that held the host lock across a long Maven suite, so one suite could serialize every other Java lane on the same host. Moving the suite to a job-local repository removes that last long hold and makes the 90-minute wait far larger than any hold it protects.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run `npx vitest run scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/sdk-java-lock.test.js scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js`. Confirm the workflow meta-tests pass, including the assertion that every Maven command in the test job runs before the lock acquisition and that the suite leaves the host lock free. Inspect the `Run Java SDK tests (self-hosted)` step: the seed, the suite, and the `sdk_java_lock_acquire 5400 "${TIER}"` call should appear in that order, and the write-back should close fd 9. A full CI run on Linux then exercises the real Java lanes.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (CI workflow change, not user-visible). Before: the Java 11 leg timed out with the lock annotation after exactly 90 minutes. After: the static and runtime meta-tests show the suite runs before the lock and the lock is free when the suite finishes.

### Tested on

|     OS     |          Status           |
| :--------: | :-----------------------: |
|  🍏 macOS  |       ⚠️ not tested       |
| 🪟 Windows |       ⚠️ not tested       |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested (meta-tests, build, typecheck, lint) |

### Environment (optional)

Local checkout with Node 22; no JDK or Maven in this environment, so the Java suite itself is left to CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Maven suites on the same host can now run concurrently instead of serializing. They resolve from separate job-local repositories seeded with read-only hardlinks, and the only host-shared mutation (the cache write-back) still takes the lock; this is the same model #15128 established for the MariaDB lane.
- Not validated / out of scope: the Java and Maven lanes were not executed locally because this environment has no JDK or Maven. The full Linux Java lanes in CI are the final verification. The 90-minute budget and the job ceilings are unchanged.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The release-tag fallback to the bare lock is preserved.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15264

## 本 PR 做了什么

工作流的 pin、英文和中文的公平锁设计文档，以及记录的工作流大小都随机制一起更新。

## 为什么需要

运行 39755183699 的 full 档 Java 11 通道以队列 ticket 249 的身份等满了 5,400 秒锁预算，在运行任何测试之前就失败了："sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes"。队列本身工作正常——该 ticket 在 20 分钟后被提升到 fast 类——但排在它前面的持锁时间超过了预算。MariaDB 通道已由 #15128 限定为只在缓存写回时取锁；test job 是最后一个仍在长时间 Maven 套件期间持有宿主机锁的站点，因此一个套件就能把同一宿主机上的其他 Java 通道串行化。把套件移到 job 本地仓库消除了最后一个长持锁，使 90 分钟的等待远大于它所保护的任何一次持锁。

### 如何验证

不适用（CI 工作流改动，非用户可见）。修改前：Java 11 通道在整整 90 分钟后带着锁注解超时。修改后：静态和运行时元测试表明套件在取锁之前运行，且套件结束时锁是空闲的。

- 主要风险或取舍：同一宿主机上的 Maven 套件现在可以并发运行，而不是串行化。它们从各自独立的 job 本地仓库解析，这些仓库用只读硬链接播种；唯一的宿主机共享变更（缓存写回）仍然取锁；这与 #15128 为 MariaDB 通道建立的模型相同。

auto_merge.commit_message:
* fix(ci): run the sdk-java suite before taking the host lock (#15264)

The Managed Agent gate run 39755183699 failed on the full-tier Java 11
leg: `Run Java SDK tests (self-hosted)` waited the entire 5400 s budget
as queue ticket 249 and failed with "sdk-java host lock not acquired
within 90 minutes" after a sibling hold outlasted it. The test job held
the host lock across the SDK and Managed Agent Maven suites, so one
long suite serialized every other Java lane on the host; the MariaDB
lane was already scoped to its cache write-back by #15128.

Seed the test job's Maven repository from the host cache, run its suite
from that job-local copy, and take the ticketed host lock only for the
cache write-back. The write-back children close fd 9 so a cancelled
job's survivor cannot retain the lock. The workflow pins and the
fair-lock design docs move with the new order, and `.size-baseline`
records the workflow's new size.

prs.title: feat: add persistent session Workflow mode (DW-04A)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds an explicit, persistent Workflow preference for the current session (DW-04A). Users can enable it with `--workflow-mode on`, `/workflows mode on`, the native TypeScript SDK, or ACP/daemon session controls. Ink and OpenTUI show the saved mode. The model receives guidance on eligible fresh submissions while continuing to decide whether a Workflow is useful.

The preference is committed to the session before a change is acknowledged. Resume, fork, rewind, clear and failed session switches preserve their defined session semantics. The first eligible model dispatch receives guidance, followed by sparse reminders on submissions 11 and 21; retries and tool continuations do not advance the fresh-submission count. Native readiness and daemon owner/lease checks protect controls during initialization and session changes. A focused Ink repair also preserves full pasted text when recalling and editing history, a pre-existing defect found by the required regression test.

## Why it's needed

The existing one-turn Workflow keyword hint cannot express a durable session preference, especially for ordinary SDK and headless submissions without human-origin metadata. This gives those clients the same explicit control while keeping keyword provenance, reasoning effort, permissions, trust and execution budgets independent. It does not force a workflow to run or change user defaults.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. In a local session with Workflow tools available, confirm the default is off. Enable the mode, submit ordinary text without a keyword, and confirm the persistent footer appears while the user message remains unchanged. Repeat in Ink and OpenTUI.
2. Change the mode during streaming. The current response should finish normally; the next eligible submission should receive the new state. Repeating the same saved choice should not create duplicate records or pushes.
3. Resume in a new process, then resume with an explicit off override. Confirm the saved choice is restored and the override remains off on the next cold resume. Clear should start off; historical fork and rewind should respect their documented checkpoint/current-choice behavior.
4. Exercise native SDK initialization and get/set, direct ACP, REST daemon controls and the SDK's HTTP ACP transport. Confirm a secondary workspace session changes independently, all attached clients receive complete options, and an unattached/retired owner is rejected.
5. Paste a large body with distinct markers, submit, recall it with Up, edit and resubmit. The current model request must retain the full body without promoting recalled text to human keyword provenance. Confirm permission denial still prevents a tool from executing with the mode on.
6. Repeat headless and native SDK checks with `experimental.unifiedAgentLoop` false and true. Fresh inputs should receive the same mode guidance; tool continuations, retries, slash expansions and Goal turns must not consume a fresh-mode tick. ACP and both TUIs currently retain their separate loops.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Final head: `22451f3b72b0d94b42b0ab10bf3676ea0770a6ee`, integrated base: `f4f602d606665951b5382d40d72326331757c6b3`. CLI SHA-256: `b8b7734faa8a0fd38d0dc09dbc399f5e9544b584dc29c454b3669ce7ee4bcdee`.

| Observed before | Observed after |
| --- | --- |
| Isolated installed CLI 0.25.1 rejects `--workflow-mode` before any model request. | The candidate persists on/off, restores it in a new process, and supports explicit false overrides. |
| Before the focused Ink repair, recall resubmitted only `[Pasted Content 4392 chars]` plus the edit marker. | Actual Ink and Bun OpenTUI PTYs preserve the full current-turn body and both nonces after recall/edit, with zero recalled keyword activation. |
| A mode-only terminal turn has no persistent control on the baseline. | `/workflows mode on` shows `Workflow mode: on`; model-only guidance stays out of the visible user message; `/clear` reports off. |

After the main sync, 6,225 focused unit/component tests passed with one existing skip; no-AK selector checks passed 14 cases with four platform skips. All 30 committed integration executions passed with retry 0: upstream shared-loop parity, legacy/shared CLI and native SDK mode cases, ACP/daemon, Ink and strict Bun OpenTUI. Full build, typecheck, lint and formatting passed. These checks ran on `5db70d4d6`; the final head adds only two upstream design-document corrections, with identical production/test/build inputs. The final head was compiled and bundled again, passed serve closure checks, and has a frozen 1,453-file CLI/SDK manifest. Independent public-process E2E passed all 13 groups (71 cases, 162 controlled model requests) once on the final artifact with zero harness retries. V8 execution evidence confirms the shared loop and real default scheduler are exercised; legacy/default and environment overrides were checked separately. The 1/11/21 cadence survives real tools and an injected HTTP500 retry in both loop modes. All 1,453 artifacts and four settings layers remained unchanged, and all 69 owned processes exited through public cleanup without fallback force-kill. See the [E2E report](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15422#issuecomment-6381747492) for evidence and preserved earlier oracle failures. Hosted CI and formal review remain separate gates.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Local build, targeted tests and controlled public E2E |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not run locally; hosted CI reported separately |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not run locally; hosted CI reported separately |

### Environment (optional)

Node 24.14.1, a strictly selected Bun OpenTUI renderer, isolated temporary user/runtime/workspace settings, and an owned loopback OpenAI-compatible provider. CLI, SDK, daemon parent and private children use the frozen candidate build. The separate E2E comment records exact head, artifact hashes, commands, results and evidence boundaries.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: this feature crosses Core, terminal and protocol boundaries (96 changed files, including tests/docs). Maintainer review should focus on durable-write ordering, model-dispatch counting, session owner changes and speculation cleanup. The mode and undelivered transitions pause speculative responses that lack the required context.
- Not validated / out of scope: external model behavior, Java Managed or SSH deployment, and DW-04B Web/IDE controls. Unsupported owners do not advertise the capability. Deterministic component fault/race tests are distinguished from public-process E2E.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: default behavior stays off; no settings migration is needed. An explicitly requested mode fails clearly when recording/tools/owner support is unavailable. Existing one-turn keyword behavior remains separate. Product documentation is available in [English](https://github.com/qqqys/qwen-code/blob/22451f3b72b0d94b42b0ab10bf3676ea0770a6ee/docs/users/workflow-mode.md) and [Chinese](https://github.com/qqqys/qwen-code/blob/22451f3b72b0d94b42b0ab10bf3676ea0770a6ee/docs/users/workflow-mode.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Follows DW-03 in #14876. No automatic issue closure.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

增加当前会话的显式、持久 Workflow 偏好（DW-04A）。用户可通过 `--workflow-mode on`、`/workflows mode on`、原生 TypeScript SDK 或 ACP/daemon 会话控制开启。Ink 与 OpenTUI 展示保存的模式。符合条件的新输入会收到模型指导，是否使用 Workflow 仍由模型判断。

偏好先提交到会话，再确认变更成功。Resume、fork、rewind、clear 和失败的会话切换遵守各自定义的会话语义。第一次符合条件的模型派发收到指导，第 11、21 次收到稀疏提醒；重试和工具续轮不推进新输入计数。初始化就绪屏障及 daemon owner/lease 检查保护初始化与会话切换期间的控制操作。本 PR 还小范围修复了必要回归测试发现的既有 Ink 问题：历史召回和编辑保留完整粘贴正文。

## 为什么需要

现有单轮 Workflow 关键词提示无法表达持续的会话偏好，尤其是没有人工来源元数据的普通 SDK 和 headless 输入。此功能为这些客户端提供相同的显式控制，同时让关键词来源、推理 effort、权限、信任与执行预算保持独立。它不会强制启动工作流或修改用户默认设置。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 在 Workflow 工具可用的本地会话中确认默认关闭。开启模式，提交不含关键词的普通文本，确认持续状态显示且用户消息原文不变。在 Ink 和 OpenTUI 分别执行。
2. 在流式回复期间修改模式。当前回复应正常结束；下一个符合条件的输入使用新状态。重复设置已保存的相同选择不应产生重复记录或推送。
3. 用新进程恢复会话，再显式覆盖为 off 后恢复。确认保存值被恢复，显式关闭后再次冷恢复仍为关闭。Clear 应回到关闭；历史 fork 与 rewind 遵守文档中的检查点/当前选择语义。
4. 验证原生 SDK 初始化与 get/set、direct ACP、REST daemon 控制及 SDK HTTP ACP transport。确认次级工作区会话独立修改，各附件客户端收到完整选项，未附着或已退出的 owner 请求被拒绝。
5. 粘贴带不同标记的大正文，提交、按 Up 召回、编辑并重新提交。当前模型请求必须保留完整正文，召回内容不能变成人工关键词来源。确认模式开启时权限拒绝仍阻止工具执行。
6. 分别设置 `experimental.unifiedAgentLoop` 为 false 和 true，复验 headless 与原生 SDK。新输入应得到相同模式指导；工具续轮、重试、slash 展开与 Goal 回合不得消费新的模式计数。ACP 与两个 TUI 目前仍使用各自循环。

### 前后对照证据

最终 head：`22451f3b72b0d94b42b0ab10bf3676ea0770a6ee`，已集成基线：`f4f602d606665951b5382d40d72326331757c6b3`。CLI SHA-256：`b8b7734faa8a0fd38d0dc09dbc399f5e9544b584dc29c454b3669ce7ee4bcdee`。

| 修改前的实际观察 | 修改后的实际观察 |
| --- | --- |
| 隔离的已安装 CLI 0.25.1 在任何模型请求前拒绝 `--workflow-mode`。 | 候选版本持久化 on/off，新进程可恢复，并支持显式 false 覆盖。 |
| Ink 小范围修复前，召回只重提 `[Pasted Content 4392 chars]` 和编辑标记。 | 真实 Ink 与 Bun OpenTUI PTY 在召回编辑后保留当前输入的完整正文和两个 nonce，召回关键词激活为 0。 |
| 基线没有持续模式的终端控制。 | `/workflows mode on` 显示 `Workflow mode: on`；模型指导不出现在可见用户消息中；`/clear` 后状态为 off。 |

同步 main 后，相关单元/组件测试 6,225 项通过、1 项既有跳过；no-AK 选择器检查 14 项通过、4 项平台跳过。已提交的 30 次集成测试执行以 retry=0 全部通过：上游 shared-loop parity、legacy/shared 两组 CLI 与原生 SDK 模式用例、ACP/daemon、Ink 和严格 Bun OpenTUI。完整 build、typecheck、lint 与格式检查通过。上述检查在 `5db70d4d6` 执行；最终 head 仅增加两份上游设计文档示例修正，生产/测试/构建输入完全一致。最终 head 已重新编译和打包，serve 闭包检查通过，并冻结 1,453 个 CLI/SDK 文件。最终产物上的独立公开进程 E2E 共 13 组（71 项断言场景、162 次受控模型请求）单次执行通过，harness retry=0。V8 执行证据确认实际经过 shared loop 和默认调度器，legacy/default 路径及环境变量覆盖分别核验。两种循环中的真实工具续轮与注入 HTTP500 重试均保持 1/11/21 提醒节奏。1,453 个产物及四层设置未变，69 个自有进程正常清理退出，未触发兜底强杀。[E2E 报告](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15422#issuecomment-6381747492)提供原始证据说明并保留早期 oracle 失败记录。远端 CI 和正式 review 单独核对。

### 测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 本地构建、定向测试与受控公开 E2E |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地运行；远端 CI 单独报告 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地运行；远端 CI 单独报告 |

### 环境

Node 24.14.1，严格指定的 Bun OpenTUI renderer，隔离的临时用户/runtime/workspace 设置，以及自有 loopback OpenAI 兼容 provider。CLI、SDK、daemon 父进程和 private child 使用冻结的候选构建。独立 E2E 评论提供精确 head、产物 hash、命令、结果与证据边界。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：此功能横跨 Core、终端与协议边界（含测试/文档共 96 个变更文件）。需要维护者重点检查持久写入顺序、模型派发计数、会话 owner 变更与 speculation 清理。模式或未交付的切换会暂停缺少相应上下文的推测回复。

prs.title: fix(ci): file main CI failures whose successor has not settled
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The main-CI failure reporter no longer drops a report just because the newer run at main's tip has not finished yet. It files the issue and leads the body with a provisional note saying that run may already cover the failure.

## Why it's needed

The guard added in #15272 treats a `queued` or `in_progress` successor as owning the result and skips the report. A successor that later ends `cancelled`, `timed_out` or `skipped` never re-enters the workflow, because its gate admits only `failure` conclusions — so nothing reports the failure at all, ever.

That is what happened on 2026-10-24: ten main-push failures between 14:00Z and 17:30Z (four `Qwen Code CI`, six `Managed Agent gate`) produced no issue ([#15470](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/15470)), and the last issue from this route predates them. The deferral is not hypothetical either — 65 of the last 100 `Qwen Code CI` push runs on main ended `cancelled`, so the run the guard defers to is much more likely to die than to report.

Waiting for the successor is not an option here. The reporter runs on `ubuntu-latest`, and in the same window that pool queued it for 20-100 minutes (one run sat from 14:47 to 16:27 before it could even make this decision), so the tip's run is usually still young when the report is prepared.

Reporting is affordable now in a way it was not when the guard was written: the per-signature route files new issues with `type/bug` and `status/needs-triage` for a human and never routes them to autofix (#15405). A stale provisional report therefore costs a close, while a dropped one costs the regression.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the focused workflow suites and confirm 406 tests pass with 1 skipped. To observe the behavior directly, execute the `live` step's shell with `EVENT_NAME=push`, `HEAD_BRANCH=main`, `HEAD_SHA=<old>`, using a `gh` stub whose `commits/main` returns a different sha and whose newer-run lookup returns `in_progress`: the step prints `superseded=false` and `provisional=true`, and the issue step then leads the body with the caveat. Return `completed success` from the lookup instead and the step still prints `superseded=true` and files nothing.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — CI workflow change with no user-visible surface.

### Tested on

| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 22 with the scripts suite (`vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts`).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a provisional report can be stale — main may have moved on and the newer run may pass. That is deliberate: a closable issue instead of silence, and the per-signature route keeps those issues out of autofix.
- Not validated / out of scope: no live dispatch. Provisional issues are not auto-closed when the covering run later passes; that would need a listener on the successor's completion and is left as follow-up work.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The workflow-size ratchet is updated for the added lines.

Design record, both languages: [English](docs/design/2026-10-16-managed-agent-gate.md), [中文](docs/design/2026-10-16-managed-agent-gate.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Refs #15470 — this closes the silent-drop half. The reporter's queue latency and the bulk cancellation of queued reports are separate.

#15272 加的那道守卫把 `queued` 或 `in_progress` 的后继当成"拥有结果"，于是跳过上报。而后继如果最后以 `cancelled`、`timed_out` 或 `skipped` 结束，就永远不会重新进入本 workflow——它的门槛只接受 `failure`——于是这次失败彻底没人上报。

2026-10-24 就是这样：14:00Z 到 17:30Z 之间有十次主干 push 失败（`Qwen Code CI` 四次、`Managed Agent gate` 六次），一个 issue 都没建（[#15470](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/15470)），这条路上最后一条 issue 还早于它们。延迟上报并不是理论问题：main 上最近 100 次 `Qwen Code CI` push 运行里有 65 次以 `cancelled` 结束，所以守卫让位的那个运行，死掉的概率远高于完成上报。

在这里等后继也不可行。上报器跑在 `ubuntu-latest` 上，而同一时间窗里那个池子把它排了 20-100 分钟（有一次运行 14:47 入队，直到 16:27 才开始做这个判断），所以准备报告时 tip 上的运行通常刚开始不久。

不适用——这是 CI workflow 改动，没有用户可见界面。

Node.js 22，运行 scripts 套件（`vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts`）。
