prs.title: feat(managed-agent): pool the automation scanner's rows and lease from the claim time
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The managed automation scanner works each tick's candidate definitions on a bounded pool instead of the scheduler's only thread. Each row claims itself inside its own task, the tick joins every task before returning so `fixedDelay` still never overlaps ticks, and the row lease now runs from the claim time rather than the tick's start — a pooled task can start halfway through a lease's lifetime, and a tick-start lease would be born part-expired and immediately stealable by another node. The pool is a dedicated executor bean sized by a new `automation.scanner-threads` setting (default 4), deliberately separate from the one-thread `managedAutomationScheduler` the tick parks on while joining. Shutdown lets an in-flight row finish instead of interrupting it, since a lost answer is durable and re-driven by a later tick.

Design: [English](docs/design/2026-10-24-automation-scanner-row-pool.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-24-automation-scanner-row-pool.zh-CN.md).

## Why it's needed

A gated `fire_run` blocks the scanner thread until the Harness answers, and the answer waits for the gate probe — up to 20 s of probe inside the relay's 30 s, plus up to 120 s of Session load before the relay starts. On a serial scanner one slow definition delays every definition on the node. The issue reporter measured 10–13 s gate runs on real PR-watch probes, which caps one node at roughly four one-minute PR watches; past that, ticks overrun and due slots of every definition are recorded `missed`. The gate design named two ways out (bounded pool or asynchronous fire answer); this PR takes the bounded pool and keeps the asynchronous answer as a documented follow-up, since it needs a wire change the funnel does not carry today. The lease-from-claim-time fix lands in the same change because pooling without it would hand out born-expired leases that a second node can take over mid-fire.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The behavior change is internal to the managed-agent-server control plane; there is no CLI, TUI, Web UI, or Web Shell surface to click through. What a reviewer should confirm: (1) the tick's row fan-out claims inside each task and joins before returning, so pooling cannot hand out queued tasks holding expiring leases and ticks still never overlap; (2) the lease anchor moved from tick start to claim time in the single lease writer; (3) the executor bean is separate from the one-thread scheduler and finishes in-flight work at shutdown without interrupting it. The new tests pin each of these: three slow fires due together only settle when three run at once (a serial or undersized pool deadlocks the latch and fails the test), a slow first fire yields leases anchored 30 s apart, a stale holder that lost its lease mid-fire cannot settle while the new owner re-drives the same run id exactly once, and under real InnoDB row locks two racing scanners settle one run per occurrence.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI change. Local verification output: unit suite for the touched classes 100/100 green (`AutomationScannerTest`, `ManagedAgentPropertiesTest`, `ManagedArtifactConfigurationTest`), Checkstyle 0 violations, SpotBugs clean, and the new `AutomationScannerConcurrencyMySqlIT` 3/3 green on a local MySQL 8.4.11 (`mysql-integration` profile).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested (arm64, JDK 21, MySQL 8.4.11) |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A — Java module, CI covers |
|  🐧 Linux  | N/A — Java module, CI covers |

### Environment (optional)

Local MySQL 8.4.11 (Homebrew), OpenJDK 21, Maven 3.10.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: concurrency inside one node is new. Rows were already leased individually under one atomic claim guard with fence-checked ledger writes, so working different rows concurrently is safe by construction; the Harness's per-Session serial queue remains a separate, unchanged ceiling.
- Not validated / out of scope: the asynchronous gate answer (the design's second route) stays a follow-up; this PR's CI selected the fast tier, which skips the `mysql-integration` and Hosted profile legs (and SpotBugs), so the InnoDB invariants rest on the local MySQL 8.4.11 run reported above rather than on this board; those profiles stay CI-owned for lanes that select them; one fire can still out-live a 60 s lease on a cold Session load — the fence rejects the stale holder's writes and a later tick re-drives idempotently, unchanged semantics.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. New opt-in-sized setting with a default; existing deployments keep working unchanged.

## Linked Issues

Resolves #15418

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

Managed 自动化扫描器把每个 tick 的候选定义放到有界线程池上处理，不再占用调度器唯一的线程。每一行在自己的任务内完成认领，tick 在返回前 join 所有任务，因此 `fixedDelay` 语义保持不变、tick 永不自重叠；行的租约改为按认领时刻起算，而不是 tick 起始时刻——池化后的任务可能在租约生命周期过半时才开始运行，按 tick 起算发出的租约一生成就已部分过期，会立即被其他节点抢走。线程池是一个独立的执行器 Bean，由新增的 `automation.scanner-threads` 设置（默认 4）决定大小，刻意与 tick 在 join 期间占住的单线程 `managedAutomationScheduler` 分开。关闭时让进行中的行收尾而不是中断它，因为丢失的应答是落库的、会由后续 tick 重新驱动。

设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-10-24-automation-scanner-row-pool.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-24-automation-scanner-row-pool.zh-CN.md)。

## 为什么需要

带闸门的 `fire_run` 会阻塞扫描器线程直到 Harness 作答，而作答要等闸门探针——中继 30 秒内探针最长 20 秒，中继开始前 Session 加载最长还要 120 秒。串行扫描器上一个慢定义会拖慢节点上的所有定义。issue 报告者在真实 PR 监视探针上实测一次闸门运行 10–13 秒，单节点上限约为四个每分钟一次的 PR 监视；超出后 tick 超时，所有定义的到期时间槽都会被记为 `missed`。闸门设计给出了两条出路（有界线程池或异步作答），本 PR 采用有界线程池，异步作答保留为记录在案的后续方向——因为它需要 funnel 目前不具备的协议变更。租约按认领时刻起算的修复必须随同一改动落地，否则池化后会发出「出生即部分过期」的租约，第二个节点可以在 fire 进行中接管该行。

## 评审者验证计划

### 如何验证

行为变化完全在 managed-agent-server 控制面内部，没有可供点击的 CLI、TUI、Web UI 或 Web Shell 界面。评审者应确认：(1) tick 的行分发在每个任务内认领并在返回前 join，池化不会产生握着即将过期租约的排队任务，tick 也仍然不自重叠；(2) 租约锚点在唯一的租约写入方中从 tick 起始时刻改为认领时刻；(3) 执行器 Bean 与单线程调度器分离，关闭时让进行中的工作收尾而不中断。新增测试逐一钉住这些点：同一分钟到期的三个慢 fire 只有三个并发运行才能结算（串行或线程不足的池会让闩锁死并使测试失败）、第一个慢 fire 会产生相隔 30 秒的租约锚点、丢失租约的旧持有者在 fire 进行中无法结算、新所有者按同一 run id 恰好重新驱动一次；在真实 InnoDB 行锁下，两个竞争的扫描器对每个 occurrence 只结算一次。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A —— 非 UI 改动。本地验证输出：涉及类的单测 100/100 通过（`AutomationScannerTest`、`ManagedAgentPropertiesTest`、`ManagedArtifactConfigurationTest`），Checkstyle 0 违规，SpotBugs 干净，新增 `AutomationScannerConcurrencyMySqlIT` 在本机 MySQL 8.4.11（`mysql-integration` profile）3/3 通过。

### 测试平台

macOS（arm64、JDK 21、MySQL 8.4.11）✅ 已测；Windows / Linux：N/A——Java 模块，由 CI 覆盖。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：单节点内新增了并发。各行原本就在一条原子认领守卫下逐行上租约、账本写入全部带 fence 校验，因此并发处理不同行在结构上就是安全的；Harness 每个 Session 的串行队列仍是独立的上限，未变。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：异步闸门作答（设计的第二条路线）留作后续；本 PR 的 CI 选了 fast 层级，跳过了 `mysql-integration` 和 Hosted profile 段（以及 SpotBugs），因此 InnoDB 不变量依据的是上文报告的本地 MySQL 8.4.11 运行而非本次看板；这些 profile 仍是选择了它们的 lane 的 CI 关卡；冷 Session 加载时一次 fire 仍可能超过 60 秒租约——fence 会拒绝旧持有者的写入，后续 tick 幂等重驱动，语义未变。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。新增设置带默认值，现有部署无需改动。

</details>

prs.title: test(integration): pin removeScratchDir retry budget with a mutation witness
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds one test case to `integration-tests/scratch-dir.test.ts` that pins `removeScratchDir()`'s retry budget (`maxRetries: 5` / `retryDelay: 200`) with a mutation witness. The case builds a scratch tree, starts a self-limiting "straggler" writer that keeps refilling it while `removeScratchDir()` is walking it, then asserts the tree is actually gone and that no cleanup warning was logged. No production code changes.

## Why it's needed

`rm(recursive)` only retries on `EBUSY`, `EMFILE`, `ENFILE` and `ENOTEMPTY`. Those retries are exactly what absorbs a CLI child that outlives its test and keeps writing under its scratch dir — the scenario the comment in `scratch-dir.ts` already describes. Until now nothing pinned that budget: mutating `maxRetries` to `0` kept the whole suite green, so a regression that removed retrying entirely would have shipped silently.

The existing `warns and resolves when the dir cannot be removed` case structurally cannot catch this, and it is worth being explicit about why: `ENOTDIR` is outside `rm`'s retryable set, so it reaches the `catch` on the first attempt whatever the budget is. Asserting only `resolves.toBeUndefined()` would be equally vacuous — `removeScratchDir` swallows every rejection, so a resolved promise is just as green at `maxRetries: 0`. `existsSync(root) === false` is the load-bearing assertion; the two cases are complementary rather than redundant.

Refs #11310 — finding `rc:3953916454-scratch-dir-retry-budget`. That issue is an `autofix-deferred` umbrella from PR #11286 whose other items are still open, so this PR deliberately uses no closing keyword and does not claim to resolve it.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the whole file (the project has no package.json script naming it):

```
npx vitest run --root ./integration-tests scratch-dir.test.ts
```

Expected at the shipped values: `Test Files 1 passed (1)` / `Tests 2 passed (2)`.

Then reproduce the red witness — in `integration-tests/scratch-dir.ts` change `maxRetries: 5,` to `maxRetries: 0,` and re-run the same command. Expected: the new case fails with `AssertionError: expected true to be false // Object.is equality` (the tree survived) while `warns and resolves when the dir cannot be removed` still passes. Restore the line afterwards; `git diff` should be empty for that file.

Two details a reviewer may want to check, because both were traps while writing this:

- The refill writer is capped twice over (a file ceiling and a wall-clock cutoff) and goes quiet well inside the shipped budget, so the shipped run converges instead of exhausting the retries. A longer writer lifetime than the budget produces a false red at the shipped values.
- `integration-tests/vitest.config.ts` sets `retry: 2`, which can mask a timing-luck witness. The red witness above was run twice and failed identically both times, so it is deterministic rather than luck-dependent.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before (at `main`, `maxRetries: 0` mutation applied) — the budget was unpinned, every case stayed green:

```
 ✓ scratch-dir.test.ts (1 test)
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  1 passed (1)
```

After (this PR, `maxRetries: 0` mutation applied) — the same mutation is now caught:

```
 ✓ removeScratchDir > warns and resolves when the dir cannot be removed 8ms
 × removeScratchDir > removes a dir a straggler writer keeps refilling 1657ms (retry x2)
   AssertionError: expected true to be false // Object.is equality
 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  1 failed | 1 passed (2)
```

Second mutated run, identical (determinism check):

```
 ✓ removeScratchDir > warns and resolves when the dir cannot be removed 8ms
 × removeScratchDir > removes a dir a straggler writer keeps refilling 1631ms (retry x2)
   AssertionError: expected true to be false // Object.is equality
 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  1 failed | 1 passed (2)
```

At the shipped values, and again after restoring `scratch-dir.ts`:

```
 ✓ scratch-dir.test.ts (2 tests) 582ms
   ✓ removeScratchDir > removes a dir a straggler writer keeps refilling  572ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  2 passed (2)
 Duration  6.95s
```

Restoration proof — `integration-tests/scratch-dir.ts` is byte-identical to `main` (the mutation was applied by a script with a `try/finally` and was never committed):

```
md5 3cdb5f2f504ea6cc7663e2708ae133f4  1493 bytes   (== git show origin/main:integration-tests/scratch-dir.ts)
```

Lint and formatting on the changed file:

```
npx prettier --check integration-tests/scratch-dir.test.ts   -> rc=0  "All matched files use Prettier code style!"
npx eslint integration-tests/scratch-dir.test.ts             -> rc=0  no findings
```

UI / wire verification is N/A: this is a test-only change to a filesystem-cleanup helper's test, with no network, daemon, browser, TUI or credential surface, so there is nothing to screenshot or capture.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️ not tested   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️ not tested   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅ tested   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — local vitest run only, no dev server, container or sandbox.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the case is timing-shaped by nature (it has to overlap a refill with the removal walk). It seeds enough directory entries that the walk spans several refill ticks, and the mutated run failed on 2/2 attempts including vitest's own `retry: 2`, so the overlap is not marginal. Worst case under unusual CI load is a slow case, not a wrong verdict — the writer is hard-capped so it cannot outlive the test, and the `finally` clears both timers and removes the tree, so no straggler is left in the host tmpdir. The tree is created under the existing `qwen-scratch-dir-test-` prefix, deliberately not `qwen-e2e-home-*`, so `globalSetup`'s real sweeper cannot race it.
- Not validated / out of scope: no production behaviour is changed or asserted beyond what the helper already does. The other deferred findings in #11310 are untouched, including the `json-output.test.ts` entry in the root package.json no-AK allowlist. `integration-tests/globalSetup.test.ts` is deliberately not modified here because open PR #13606 has live hunks in that file.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Refs #11310

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

在 `integration-tests/scratch-dir.test.ts` 中新增一个测试用例，用一个「变异见证」（mutation witness）钉住 `removeScratchDir()` 的重试预算（`maxRetries: 5` / `retryDelay: 200`）。该用例先构造一棵 scratch 目录树，再启动一个会自我终止的「掉队写入者」，在 `removeScratchDir()` 遍历目录期间持续往里补文件，最后断言目录树确实被删除、且没有打印任何清理告警。不改动任何生产代码。

## 为什么需要

`rm(recursive)` 只对 `EBUSY`、`EMFILE`、`ENFILE`、`ENOTEMPTY` 重试。这些重试正是用来吸收「CLI 子进程活得比测试久、还在往自己的 scratch 目录里写」这种情况的——也就是 `scratch-dir.ts` 注释里已经描述的场景。此前没有任何测试钉住这个预算：把 `maxRetries` 改成 `0`，整个测试套件依然全绿，所以一个「彻底去掉重试」的回归会被静默发布。

已有的 `warns and resolves when the dir cannot be removed` 用例在结构上抓不到这个问题，值得说清原因：`ENOTDIR` 不在 `rm` 的可重试错误码集合里，所以无论预算是多少，它都会在第一次尝试就走到 `catch`。只断言 `resolves.toBeUndefined()` 同样是空洞的——`removeScratchDir` 吞掉所有异常，因此在 `maxRetries: 0` 下 promise 一样是 resolved。真正承重的断言是 `existsSync(root) === false`；两个用例是互补而非重复。

Refs #11310 —— 对应 finding `rc:3953916454-scratch-dir-retry-budget`。该 issue 是 PR #11286 遗留的 `autofix-deferred` 汇总单，其中其他条目仍未关闭，因此本 PR 刻意不使用任何自动关闭关键字，也不声称解决该 issue。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

运行整个文件（根 package.json 没有指名这些文件的 script）：

```
npx vitest run --root ./integration-tests scratch-dir.test.ts
```

在出厂取值下预期：`Test Files 1 passed (1)` / `Tests 2 passed (2)`。

然后复现红色见证——在 `integration-tests/scratch-dir.ts` 里把 `maxRetries: 5,` 改成 `maxRetries: 0,`，重跑同一条命令。预期：新用例以 `AssertionError: expected true to be false // Object.is equality` 失败（目录树残留），而 `warns and resolves when the dir cannot be removed` 仍然通过。之后还原该行，该文件的 `git diff` 应为空。

有两个细节评审可能想确认，因为写这个用例时它们都是坑：

- 补写者被双重封顶（文件数上限 + 墙上时间上限），会在出厂预算耗尽之前安静下来，因此出厂运行是收敛的而不是把重试耗尽。写入者寿命超过预算会在出厂取值下造成假红。
- `integration-tests/vitest.config.ts` 设了 `retry: 2`，这可能掩盖「靠运气才成立」的见证。上面的红色见证跑了两次、两次失败完全一致，所以它是确定性的，不依赖运气。

### 证据（前后对照）

改动前（在 `main` 上施加 `maxRetries: 0` 变异）——预算未被钉住，所有用例仍然全绿：

```
 ✓ scratch-dir.test.ts (1 test)
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  1 passed (1)
```

改动后（本 PR，施加同样的 `maxRetries: 0` 变异）——同一个变异现在被抓到了：

```
 ✓ removeScratchDir > warns and resolves when the dir cannot be removed 8ms
 × removeScratchDir > removes a dir a straggler writer keeps refilling 1657ms (retry x2)
   AssertionError: expected true to be false // Object.is equality
 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  1 failed | 1 passed (2)
```

第二次变异运行，结果一致（确定性验证）：

```
 ✓ removeScratchDir > warns and resolves when the dir cannot be removed 8ms
 × removeScratchDir > removes a dir a straggler writer keeps refilling 1631ms (retry x2)
   AssertionError: expected true to be false // Object.is equality
 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  1 failed | 1 passed (2)
```

出厂取值下、以及还原 `scratch-dir.ts` 之后：

```
 ✓ scratch-dir.test.ts (2 tests) 582ms
   ✓ removeScratchDir > removes a dir a straggler writer keeps refilling  572ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  2 passed (2)
 Duration  6.95s
```

还原证明——`integration-tests/scratch-dir.ts` 与 `main` 逐字节一致（变异由带 `try/finally` 的脚本施加，从未被提交）：

```
md5 3cdb5f2f504ea6cc7663e2708ae133f4  1493 bytes   (== git show origin/main:integration-tests/scratch-dir.ts)
```

改动文件的 lint 与格式检查：

```
npx prettier --check integration-tests/scratch-dir.test.ts   -> rc=0  "All matched files use Prettier code style!"
npx eslint integration-tests/scratch-dir.test.ts             -> rc=0  no findings
```

UI / 链路验证不适用：这是一个纯测试改动，针对文件系统清理辅助函数的测试，不涉及网络、daemon、浏览器、TUI 或凭据面，因此没有可截图或可录制的内容。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️ 未测试   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️ 未测试   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅ 已测试   |

### 环境（可选）

不适用——仅本地 vitest 运行，没有 dev server、容器或沙箱。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：该用例本质上依赖时序（必须让一次补写与删除遍历重叠）。用例预先写入了足够多的目录项，使遍历跨越多个补写 tick；且变异运行在 2/2 次尝试中都失败（含 vitest 自身的 `retry: 2`），说明这个重叠不是勉强成立。在异常的 CI 负载下最坏情况是用例变慢，而不是给出错误结论——写入者被硬性封顶，不可能活过测试；`finally` 会清掉两个定时器并删除目录树，因此不会在宿主 tmpdir 留下掉队进程。目录树建在既有的 `qwen-scratch-dir-test-` 前缀下，刻意不用 `qwen-e2e-home-*`，因此 `globalSetup` 的真实清扫器不会与它竞争。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：除该辅助函数已有的行为外，没有改动或断言任何生产行为。#11310 中其他遗留 finding 未触碰，包括根 package.json 的 no-AK 白名单里缺少 `json-output.test.ts` 这一条。此处刻意不修改 `integration-tests/globalSetup.test.ts`，因为未合并的 PR #13606 在该文件里有活跃 hunk。

prs.title: feat(core): skip re-injecting an unchanged UserPromptSubmit hook context block
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A `UserPromptSubmit` hook that returns `additionalContext` has that text appended to the user's message, wrapped in a reserved tag, on every turn. When the payload the hook returns is byte-identical to one already appended earlier in the same session, the change detects the earlier copy in the shallow conversation history and does not append it again; the turn also stops recording the hook context as coming from this turn, so the stored transcript matches what the model actually received. A payload that differs in any byte — different results, a different order, a changed similarity score — still appends, so there is no state that can expire or go stale. Identical bytes alone are not treated as proof: the injector stamps the block it appends with an in-process receipt, and a stored transcript, an IDE-supplied prompt block, or model output cannot reproduce that stamp, so tagged text that merely appears elsewhere — in a model turn, as a whole user message, or as a caller-authored copy of the injection shape — does not suppress a fresh delivery. Because a stamp cannot survive serialization, a resumed session re-derives it from the per-turn hook provenance the injector recorded alongside the message; where no such provenance exists, as for a block delivered to an IDE session, the block is injected again rather than trusted.

## Why it's needed

The appended block becomes a permanent part of session history, so a hook whose payload repeats is paid for again on every subsequent request: the resent tokens grow on the order of T² over a session. The bundled retrieval extensions make this easy to hit, because their auto-recall hooks render a bounded, newest-first window — with a stable upstream result set the rendered bytes are identical turn after turn. The earlier copy is still in the conversation, so the information is not lost; what is removed is the duplicate.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Point a `UserPromptSubmit` hook at a command that prints a constant `additionalContext` (for example a one-line Node script that writes the same hook JSON every time), then send three prompts in the same session, continuing that session between sends. Read the session transcript for the run and, for each recorded user message, note whether the reserved tagged block and the recorded hook-context provenance are present. Expected: the first user message carries both; later user messages carry neither. Then ask the model to repeat the extra context block it was given — it should still return it verbatim, which shows the deduplication removed a repeat rather than the content.

Count only user records, and only as a presence check. Unrelated records in the same file (telemetry, the auto-memory extractor) can quote the payload back, so a raw substring count over the whole file is not a usable metric.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before, on the released CLI (v0.25.0), a constant-payload hook over three turns in one session: all three user records carried both the tagged block and the hook-context provenance.

After, running from source on this branch, a constant-payload hook over three turns in one session where the second and third turns were separate processes continuing the same session: only the first user record carried the block and the provenance; the second and third carried neither, even though each of those turns rebuilt its history from the stored transcript — the path where the receipt has to be re-derived rather than carried in memory. On the previous revision, a fourth turn asked the model to output the extra context block from its history and it returned the block verbatim, confirming that what is dropped is the duplicate and not the content.

Independent [local verification at `7102b967`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14129#issuecomment-6305250452) reports 2,430 passing unit tests (hooks 24, session API history 48, core client 517, llm-chat 579, ACP session 1,262), plus wire/transcript checks of three-turn interactive and resumed sessions. The model-bound requests retain one hook block on every turn; the base accumulates one, two, then three. The hooks tests cover receipt validation and forged-text rejection. Resume re-stamping at the history-rebuild call site is demonstrated by the differential wire test, but is not pinned by the committed session-history suite; Turn-level option forwarding is also a remaining non-blocking test gap. The subsequent `8adb7e8e` revision changes tests only, adding a non-compacting-send control and requiring exactly one wrapped rescue block; it leaves the production behavior exercised by that report unchanged.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

The before run used the globally installed `qwen` (v0.25.0); the after run used `node scripts/dev.js` from this branch, which executes the TypeScript sources directly with `DEV=true`, in a scratch directory containing only the test hook and its settings.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a hook that deliberately repeats a fixed block on every turn — a standing or pinned instruction — now appears only on the first turn of a session, and the hook output schema has no field to opt out of that. Any change to the payload re-injects it on the next turn, and suppressing a repeat never removes the text from the conversation.
- Not validated / out of scope: the headline scenario from the linked issue — an external memory recall hook whose items restate content that core already injected from local memory files — is **not** fixed by this change. Core holds no identifier that matches an external recall item against a local memory block, so that comparison cannot be expressed at delivery time; this PR only removes the byte-identical repeat. The cross-source case stays open in the issue, as does putting a size bound on hook context.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No configuration, protocol field, or package API is added, and hooks whose payload varies per turn behave exactly as before.
- Design documents: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/14089-hook-context-dedup/docs/design/user-prompt-submit-context-dedup.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/14089-hook-context-dedup/docs/design/user-prompt-submit-context-dedup.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Related to #14089. This does not close it: the issue's headline case, where recalled external memory duplicates content core already injected from local memory files, needs an identity that core owns on both sides and is left open.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

返回 `additionalContext` 的 `UserPromptSubmit` hook，其文本会在每一轮被追加到用户消息后面，并用保留标签包裹。当 hook 返回的载荷与同一会话中此前已追加过的某一份逐字节相同时，本次改动会在浅拷贝的会话历史中识别出此前那一份，不再重复追加；同时本轮也不再记录该 hook 上下文来源于本轮，使落盘的会话记录与模型实际收到的内容一致。只要载荷有任何字节不同——结果不同、顺序不同、相似度分数变化——仍会照常追加，因此不存在会过期或失效的状态。仅字节相同并不被当作证据：注入点会给自己追加的块盖上一个进程内的凭据，而落盘的会话记录、IDE 传入的提示块或模型输出都无法复制这个凭据，因此仅仅出现在别处的带标签文本——模型回合里、作为整条用户消息、或调用方自己拼出的注入形状——都不会抑制一次新的投递。凭据无法经由序列化保留，所以恢复会话时会依据注入点随消息一并记录的逐轮 hook 来源信息重新盖上；在没有这类来源信息时（例如投递给 IDE 会话的块），会照旧注入而不是信任它。

## 为什么需要

被追加的块会成为会话历史的永久组成部分，因此载荷重复的 hook 会在之后每一次请求中再付一次代价：重发的 token 量随会话轮数呈平方级增长。本仓库自带的检索扩展很容易触发这一点，因为它们的自动召回 hook 渲染的是一个有界、最新优先的窗口——只要上游结果集稳定，渲染出的字节就逐轮完全相同。此前那一份仍留在对话里，信息并没有丢失，去掉的是重复。

## 评审验证方案

### 如何验证

让 `UserPromptSubmit` hook 指向一个每次都打印相同 `additionalContext` 的命令（例如一行 Node 脚本，每轮输出同一份 hook JSON），然后在同一会话中发送三次提示，每次之间延续该会话。打开该次运行的会话记录，逐条用户消息查看保留标签包裹的块与本轮记录的 hook 上下文来源信息是否存在。预期：第一条用户消息两者都有，之后的用户消息两者都没有。随后让模型复述它拿到的额外上下文块，它应当仍能原样给出，这说明去重去掉的是重复而非内容。

只统计用户记录，且只做有无判断。同一份文件里不相关的记录（遥测、自动记忆抽取器）会把载荷原样引用回来，因此对整个文件做子串计数不能作为指标。

### 证据（修复前后）

修复前，在已发布的 CLI（v0.25.0）上，载荷恒定的 hook 在同一会话中跑三轮：三条用户记录都同时带有标签块和 hook 上下文来源信息。

修复后，从源码运行同一场景，三轮同一会话，其中第二、三轮是延续该会话的两个独立进程：只有第一条用户记录同时带有标签块和来源信息，第二、三条都没有——尽管这两轮都在从落盘的会话记录重建历史，也就是必须重新推导凭据的那条路径。此前一版还额外让第四轮要求模型输出它历史中的额外上下文块，它原样返回，证明去掉的是重复而非内容。

独立的[本地验证报告（`7102b967`）](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14129#issuecomment-6305250452)记录了 2,430 项单测通过（hooks 24、session API history 48、core client 517、llm-chat 579、ACP session 1,262），并验证了三轮交互式会话及跨进程恢复会话的请求体和记录。候选每轮请求都保留一份 hook 块，基线则累积为一、二、三份。hooks 单测覆盖凭据校验与伪造文本拒绝；恢复会话时历史重建调用点的重新盖凭据由线级差分验证证明，但提交的会话记录单测尚未钉住它，Turn 层参数转发同样仍有非阻塞测试缺口。后续 `8adb7e8e` 仅修改测试，增加不触发压缩时的对照，并要求救援块有完整包装且恰好一份；上述报告实测的生产行为未变。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 运行环境（可选）

修复前为全局安装的 `qwen`（v0.25.0）；修复后为在本分支上运行 `node scripts/dev.js`，它以 `DEV=true` 直接执行 TypeScript 源码，工作目录是一个只包含测试 hook 及其配置的临时目录。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：有意每轮重复某个固定块的 hook——例如常驻或钉住的指令——现在只会在会话第一轮出现，而 hook 输出 schema 没有可供退出该行为的字段。载荷一旦变化，下一轮就会重新注入；抑制重复也从不把文本从对话中移除。
- 未验证／超出范围：关联 issue 的核心场景——外部记忆召回项与 core 已从本地记忆文件注入的内容重复——**并未**被本次改动修复。core 不持有能把外部召回项与本地记忆块对应起来的标识，因此在投递时刻无法表达这种比较；本 PR 只消除了逐字节重复。跨来源去重仍留在该 issue 中，给 hook 上下文加长度上限同样如此。
- 破坏性变更／迁移说明：无。没有新增配置、协议字段或包 API，载荷逐轮变化的 hook 行为与之前完全一致。
- 设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/14089-hook-context-dedup/docs/design/user-prompt-submit-context-dedup.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/14089-hook-context-dedup/docs/design/user-prompt-submit-context-dedup.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 issue

关联 #14089，但不关闭它：该 issue 的核心场景（召回的外部记忆与 core 已从本地记忆文件注入的内容重复）需要 core 在两侧都持有的标识，因此保持开启。

</details>

prs.title: feat(skills): add repository knowledge lifecycle
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR adds a project-level knowledge lifecycle skill that routes repository knowledge to the artifact matching its lifecycle, keeps one canonical source per fact, and distinguishes analyze-only behavior from authorized writes. It also adds a bounded knowledge-closeout step to the existing feature and bug-fix workflows, plus a short design record for the accepted v1 decisions and scope.

## Why it's needed

Qwen Code already has instructions, current documentation, design records, GitHub state, executable constraints, and temporary work artifacts, but its development workflows do not share a decision process for choosing which source should own newly learned information. The new skill reduces duplicated facts, stale handoffs, and temporary status leaking into durable documentation without introducing a new store or index.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Run `npm run preflight` in the full source tree.
2. Start Qwen Code `0.22.0` with local Ollama `qwen3:8b`, then test both plan mode and explicit `/knowledge-lifecycle` invocation against the four-file fixture.
3. Compare fixture hashes before and after each run.

### Results

- **Preflight: not fully green.** `format`, `lint`, `build`, and `typecheck` passed. CLI tests finished with 24 files passed and 1 failed: `AuthDialog.test.tsx` has a stable MiniMax navigation assertion failure unrelated to this documentation-only diff. Core tests initially had 10 failures because the source tree lacked `.git`; after restoring Git metadata, the targeted `gitUtils.test.ts` rerun passed 12/12.
- **Plan mode / read-only boundary: passed.** `skill` and `read_file` were registered; write tools were not registered; fixture hashes did not change.
- **Automatic Skill routing: not passed.** The model read 3/4 fixture files, did not invoke `knowledge-lifecycle`, and the session ended before the fourth file. This is not claimed as a successful end-to-end routing verification.
- **Explicit invocation / write boundary: passed.** With `/knowledge-lifecycle` plus auto-edit, the first edit was rejected because the file had not yet been read. After reading, Qwen Code changed only `current-behavior.md` (`--dry-run` → `--preview`), reread it successfully, and all other fixture hashes remained unchanged.
- Fixture files were restored after the test; the local `qwen3:8b` model was removed.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — project workflow documentation only; no user-facing UI or runtime behavior changes.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS, Qwen Code `0.22.0`, and a temporary local Ollama `qwen3:8b` model. The model was deleted after verification.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Agents could over-persist task-specific information; the skill mitigates this with analyze-only default behavior, one canonical source per fact, explicit retirement rules, and an allowed no-persistence result.
- Not fully validated / out of scope: Automatic Skill routing remains unverified in the tested local-model session; migration of existing design documents and plans, generated indexes, storage systems, automatic journaling, and automatic GitHub writes remain out of scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None. This changes project development guidance only.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #9781

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

本 PR 新增一个项目级知识生命周期 Skill，根据信息生命周期将仓库知识路由到正确工件，确保一条事实只有一个权威来源，并区分只读分析与已授权写入。同时，它在现有 Feature 与 Bug 修复流程中加入一个有边界的知识收尾步骤，并用一份简短设计记录保存第一版已接受的决策和范围。

## 为什么需要它

Qwen Code 已有工作指令、当前文档、设计记录、GitHub 状态、可执行约束和临时工作工件，但开发流程之间缺少一套共同的判断机制，用于决定新获得的信息应该由哪个来源负责。新 Skill 在不引入新存储或新索引的前提下，减少重复事实、过期交接以及临时状态进入长期文档的问题。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

1. 在完整源码树中运行 `npm run preflight`。
2. 使用 Qwen Code `0.22.0` 与本地 Ollama `qwen3:8b`，针对四文件 fixture 分别测试 plan 模式和显式 `/knowledge-lifecycle` 调用。
3. 对比每次运行前后的 fixture 哈希。

### 结果

- **Preflight：未全绿。** `format`、`lint`、`build`、`typecheck` 通过。CLI 测试为 24 个文件通过、1 个失败：`AuthDialog.test.tsx` 存在稳定的 MiniMax 导航断言失败，与本次纯文档 diff 无关。Core 测试最初因源码树缺少 `.git` 出现 10 个失败；恢复 Git 元数据后，定向复跑 `gitUtils.test.ts` 为 12/12 通过。
- **Plan 模式／只读边界：通过。** 已注册 `skill` 与 `read_file`，未注册写工具；fixture 哈希未变化。
- **自动 Skill 路由：未通过。** 模型读取了 3/4 个 fixture 文件，没有调用 `knowledge-lifecycle`，并在读取第 4 个文件前结束。本 PR 不把它表述为端到端路由验证成功。
- **显式调用／写入边界：通过。** 使用 `/knowledge-lifecycle` 加 auto-edit 时，首次编辑因尚未读取文件被拒绝；读取后，Qwen Code 只修改了 `current-behavior.md`（`--dry-run` → `--preview`），复读成功，其他 fixture 哈希均未变化。
- 测试后已恢复 fixture 文件，并删除本地 `qwen3:8b` 模型。

prs.title: test: capture expected disk-full logs
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Captures and asserts the expected error output from unit tests that deliberately inject `new Error("disk full")`. The production logging paths remain unchanged, while the test fixtures no longer emit unqualified disk-full messages into shared CI logs.

## Why it is needed

Expected-failure tests currently print production-looking disk-full errors. Those lines can make unrelated CI failures look like runner ENOSPC incidents. Capturing the output in the tests preserves coverage of the logging behavior and makes real disk-full failures easier to distinguish.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the focused suites:

- `cd packages/acp-bridge && npx vitest run src/sessionArtifacts.test.ts src/bridge.test.ts`
- `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/run-qwen-serve.test.ts`
- `cd packages/vscode-ide-companion && npx vitest run src/webview/utils/imageHandler.test.ts`
- `cd packages/channels/qqbot && npx vitest run src/persistence.test.ts`

Confirm that all suites pass and that their output contains no unqualified `disk full` lines. The affected tests now also assert that the expected logger or stderr call occurred.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the passing suites printed messages such as `[ImageHandler] Failed to save image: Error: disk full`, `flushQQState write failed: disk full`, and artifact persistence failures containing `disk full`.

After: the same error paths remain covered and their log payloads are asserted, but the focused suite output contains zero `disk full` occurrences.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | N/A |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Ubuntu 26.04, Node.js v22.22.2, npm 10.9.7.

Additional checks passed: Prettier, ESLint on all changed files, ACP Bridge and CLI typechecks, VS Code companion typecheck, QQBot build, and the repository build run by `npm ci`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Test-local stderr/logger spies must be restored; each new spy is scoped to its test and restored after use.
- Not validated / out of scope: Other intentional warning output unrelated to the injected disk-full fixtures.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None. Production code is unchanged.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #8532

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 为什么需要

预期失败测试目前会打印看起来像生产故障的磁盘已满错误，容易让无关的 CI 失败被误判为 runner 的 ENOSPC 问题。由测试捕获并断言这些输出，既保留日志行为覆盖，也让真实磁盘故障更容易识别。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

### Before 与 After 证据

prs.title: fix(acp): persist embedded text resources for transcript replay
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Persists bounded, original ACP embedded text `resource` blocks with their owning user prompt and replays them as typed user chunks. The daemon UI SDK now exposes these blocks separately from `resource_link` and native attachments, including offline transcript projection. Native attachment expansions are identified by their input positions, so a separate direct resource remains replayable even when it shares the same URI.

## Why it's needed

Qwen Code already accepts embedded resources as model context, but refresh or restart previously restored only the prompt text. Clients therefore lost the original context selection while the assistant reply remained visible. This closes the persistence/replay gap tracked in #12538; it is separate from the `resource_link` fix in #12088.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Send an ACP prompt with text and a text resource, then a resource-only prompt and a later text-only prompt. Inspect the saved user records and load the transcript: each resource should appear as a typed user chunk on its original prompt with its URI, MIME type, text, metadata, prompt ID, and source-record identity; it must not migrate to the later turn or be fetched by URI. Also check rewind/active-branch replay, native attachments over 256 KiB, a direct resource sharing a native attachment URI, and rejection of an oversized direct text resource before the daemon peer echo. Focused bridge, CLI, persistence, and SDK tests cover these cases.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the new recording/replay regressions failed against the pre-fix source because typed resources were absent after replay. After: the focused tests pass, including resource-only, same-URI coexistence, and daemon pre-echo rejection. No running-daemon or browser recording is claimed here.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ build, bundle, typecheck, targeted lint and tests |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.23.1; package-level test scripts and bundled `dist/cli.js` sanity check. A live ACP daemon session was not run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: directly supplied embedded text resources add bounded user content to durable transcripts; the aggregate serialized replay budget is 256 KiB per prompt. Oversized direct text resources are rejected before live echo. Native attachments use their existing separate storage path; current daemon requests exclude them by provenance. Legacy metadata without positions excludes only unambiguous URI matches; ambiguous blocks are retained and may hit the inline limit.
- Not validated / out of scope: running-daemon JSONL and `session/load` readback after restart, browser refresh acceptance, persistence of inline blob resources, and recovery of resources absent from historical records. Downstream clients must render the new typed SDK field to display a card.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no record migration is required; old records remain readable. A direct ACP prompt above the new text-resource replay limit now returns invalid parameters.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/issue-12538-embedded-resource-replay/docs/design/daemon-embedded-resource-replay.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/issue-12538-embedded-resource-replay/docs/design/daemon-embedded-resource-replay.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Fixes #12538.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

将有大小上限的原始 ACP 嵌入式文本 `resource` 块与所属用户 Prompt 一同持久化，并在回放时恢复为带类型的用户消息块。Daemon UI SDK 将其与 `resource_link`、原生附件区分，并支持离线 transcript 投影。原生附件展开结果按输入位置识别，因此即使另一个直接资源与它使用相同 URI，也仍可独立回放。

## 为什么需要

Qwen Code 已能把嵌入式资源用作模型上下文，但刷新或重启后此前只恢复 Prompt 文字。客户端因此丢失原始上下文引用，尽管助手回复仍可见。本 PR 修复 #12538 的持久化与回放缺口；它不同于 #12088 的 `resource_link` 修复。

## 审查验证计划

### 如何验证

依次发送包含文字和文本资源的 ACP Prompt、纯资源 Prompt、以及后续纯文字 Prompt。检查保存的用户记录与加载后的 transcript：每个资源都应作为带类型的用户消息块保留在原轮次，包含 URI、MIME 类型、文本、元数据、Prompt ID 和来源记录身份；不得迁移到后续轮次，也不得根据 URI 抓取内容。另需检查 rewind/有效分支回放、超过 256 KiB 的原生附件、与原生附件同 URI 的直接资源，以及超限直接文本资源在 Daemon 向其他客户端回显前被拒绝。定向桥接、CLI、持久化和 SDK 测试覆盖这些场景。

### 前后证据

修复前：新增的录制与回放回归测试在旧源码上失败，类型化资源在回放后缺失。修复后：定向测试通过，包括纯资源、同 URI 并存和 Daemon 回显前拒绝。本 PR 未声称完成运行中 Daemon 或浏览器录屏。

### 已测试系统

|     系统     | 状态 |
| :----------: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 构建、打包、类型检查、定向 lint 与测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境（可选）

Node 22.23.1；包级测试脚本与打包后的 `dist/cli.js` 基础检查。未运行真实 ACP Daemon 会话。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：直接提供的嵌入式文本资源会作为有界的用户内容进入持久 transcript；每个 Prompt 的序列化资源回放预算为 256 KiB。超限直接文本资源在实时回显前被拒绝。原生附件沿用独立存储路径；新 Daemon 请求按来源排除。缺少位置字段的旧元数据只排除 URI 唯一对应的块；歧义块会保留，也可能触及内联限额。
- 未验证／范围外：运行中 Daemon 的 JSONL 与重启后 `session/load` 回读、浏览器刷新验收、内联 blob 资源持久化，以及从未保存资源的旧记录恢复。下游客户端需要渲染新的类型化 SDK 字段才能显示卡片。
- 破坏性变更／迁移：无需记录迁移，旧记录继续可读。超过新文本资源回放上限的直接 ACP Prompt 现在返回参数错误。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/issue-12538-embedded-resource-replay/docs/design/daemon-embedded-resource-replay.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/issue-12538-embedded-resource-replay/docs/design/daemon-embedded-resource-replay.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #12538。

</details>

prs.title: feat(generated-ui): continue analysis with reviewed parameters
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds **Continue analysis with current parameters** to the trusted Generated UI outer frame. After applying changes, the user can review a complete frozen parameter message and explicitly send it to the original session through the existing host admission flow. Editing controls alone never sends a prompt, and generated content gains no messaging API.

The message preserves supported controls, snapshot revisions and queue rejection counts, escapes control/format characters, and enforces both 16 KiB limits without truncation. Pending requests cannot be duplicated; unconfirmed acceptance requires checking the session before another explicit review. Stop ends the card's wait without claiming to withdraw an already dispatched session request. This also closes the host busy-check gap while shell commands are draining.

## Why it's needed

Interactive Generated UI cards can calculate locally, but users currently have to copy parameters manually to continue model analysis. This connects applied parameters to an explicit host review while preserving session ownership, normal preparation and approval behavior. It builds on the existing default-off experimental feature and parameter snapshots.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Enable `experimental.generatedUi`, recreate the owning CLI/daemon session, and open an interactive parameter card in Web Shell. Change an input: continuation must stay disabled until the view applies the update.
2. Choose **Continue analysis with current parameters**. Verify the target session and complete parameter JSON in the host review. Hidden, disabled, empty and unchecked controls remain represented; initial summary, source and derived results are absent. No prompt is sent before confirmation.
3. Edit the card while the review is open. The reviewed message must stay frozen. Confirm once: exactly one request enters the original session, composer draft text is preserved, and the status distinguishes acceptance from analysis completion.
4. Cancel an unsent review or stop its card: no session prompt should be dispatched. For uncertain acceptance, verify there is no automatic retry. Stopping after admission must not cancel the accepted session analysis.
5. Verify a busy session, including an executing shell-command batch, rejects the App prompt. Two identical cards should have independent activations. At 375px width, the action and status/help remain reachable by native scrolling and keyboard.
6. Disable the built-in feature and recreate the session: restored built-in history falls back to text. A separately installed manual extension should still use its legacy resource and the normal review flow.

Local verification passed: 669 targeted unit/integration tests, 8 distinct Chromium cases across runs, and 8/8 real CLI/daemon product scenarios with a deterministic loopback model. Build, typecheck, bundle, changed-file lint/format and whitespace checks passed. Full-diff self-review and an independent review found no evidence-supported blocking P1/P2 issue. Hosted CI remains separate.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Local deterministic fixtures on macOS, captured 2026-10-23. Before uses global Qwen Code 0.26.0; after uses this PR's built CLI/daemon. The fixture controls differ, so these demonstrate behavior rather than a pixel comparison. Screenshots are stored in a separate evidence branch and are not included in the product diff.

| Before: local interactions only | After: full frozen parameters reviewed before sending |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before, global 0.26.0 fixture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/fc4f114d96a5a31f1fc560f4eb5b0da2eff6e6c7/before-global-0.26.0.png) | ![After, real host review fixture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/fc4f114d96a5a31f1fc560f4eb5b0da2eff6e6c7/after-review.png) |

[Same-session acceptance receipt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/fc4f114d96a5a31f1fc560f4eb5b0da2eff6e6c7/after-accepted.png) · [375px scrollable feedback, mock-daemon browser fixture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/fc4f114d96a5a31f1fc560f4eb5b0da2eff6e6c7/after-feedback-375px.png)

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Node 24.14.1, pinned pnpm 11.24.0, Chromium 149.0.7827.55. Product tests use isolated configuration/runtime/workspace, ordinary approval mode, real CLI/daemon/MCP/App/Worker and a loopback deterministic model. Browser tests use the real App/Worker/sandbox/host with mock daemon HTTP/SSE. Timeout tests use the real SDK with a virtual clock and a held HTTP response; they do not intercept receipts or claim real packet-loss testing.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a dispatched request can have unknown acceptance, so explicit re-review can duplicate it unless the user first checks the session. Applied parameters may include hidden, disabled or script-written values; they remain data, not verified calculations or declared human-authored input.
- Not validated / out of scope: real model answer quality, all network-failure variants, Windows/Linux runtime E2E, Firefox/WebKit, hosted CI, CDN publication, state restoration and broader agent/workflow UI.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The existing experimental switch remains default-off. No dependency, resource URI, snapshot schema, daemon route or guest-runtime API changes.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #15004. No issue is closed by this PR.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

### 本 PR 的改动

在 Generated UI 的可信外层新增 **Continue analysis with current parameters**。用户应用参数后，可以审阅完整且冻结的参数正文，明确确认后通过已有宿主准入流程发送到原会话。仅编辑控件不会发送 prompt，生成内容没有新增发消息 API。

正文保留受支持控件、快照版本及队列拒绝计数，显式转义控制/格式字符，同时遵守字符和 UTF-8 的 16 KiB 上限，超限不截断。等待期间禁止重复请求；无法确认接收时，先检查原会话，再明确重新审阅。Stop 结束卡片的等待，不声称撤回已经发出的会话请求。同时补齐 shell 命令批次执行期间的宿主忙碌检查。

### 为什么需要

当前交互卡片只能在本地计算，用户继续让模型分析时需要手工复制参数。本次把已应用参数接入明确的宿主审阅，同时保留会话归属、常规准备及审批行为，沿用默认关闭的实验功能和已有参数快照。

### 评审验证步骤

1. 开启 `experimental.generatedUi`，重建所属 CLI/daemon 会话，在 Web Shell 打开交互参数卡片。修改输入后，续分析应保持禁用，直到视图应用更新。
2. 点击续分析，核对宿主审阅中的目标会话和完整参数 JSON。隐藏、禁用、空值和未勾选控件都应保留；初始摘要、源码和派生结果不进入正文。确认前没有 prompt 发出。
3. 审阅期间编辑卡片，正文必须保持冻结。确认一次后，只有一个请求进入原会话，输入框草稿保留，反馈区分已接收与分析完成。
4. 取消未发送的审阅或 Stop 卡片，不应派发会话 prompt；接收状态未知时，不应自动重试。已接收后 Stop 不应取消原分析。
5. 忙碌会话，包括 shell 命令批次执行中，应拒绝 App prompt。同内容的两张卡片具有独立激活状态。375px 下，操作、帮助和状态可通过原生滚动及键盘访问。
6. 关闭内置开关并重建会话，恢复的内置历史退化为文本；独立安装的手动扩展继续使用 legacy 资源及常规审阅链路。

本地验证通过：669 项定向单元/集成测试，分次执行的 8 个不同 Chromium 用例，以及使用确定性 loopback 模型的 8/8 真实 CLI/daemon 产品场景。构建、类型检查、打包、改动文件 lint/format 和空白检查均通过。完整差异自审及独立审查均未发现有证据支持的 P1/P2 阻塞问题。远程 CI 单独确认。

### 前后证据与环境

上方截图为 2026-10-23 在 macOS 采集的本地确定性 fixture。实施前为全局 Qwen Code 0.26.0，实施后为本 PR 构建的 CLI/daemon。两组控件不同，仅用于行为对照，不作像素级比较。截图放在独立证据分支，不进入产品差异；另附原会话接收回执及 375px 滚动反馈截图，后者属于 mock daemon 浏览器 fixture。

macOS 已验证；Windows 和 Linux 未验证。环境为 Node 24.14.1、锁定的 pnpm 11.24.0 与 Chromium 149.0.7827.55。产品测试隔离配置、runtime 和工作区，使用普通审批模式、真实 CLI/daemon/MCP/App/Worker 及 loopback 确定性模型。浏览器测试使用真实 App/Worker/sandbox/宿主与 mock daemon HTTP/SSE。超时测试使用真实 SDK、虚拟时钟和挂起的 HTTP 响应，不拦截回执，也不声称验证了真实网络丢包。

### 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：已派发请求可能无法确认接收，用户未核对原会话就重新审阅发送可能产生重复。参数可能包含隐藏、禁用或脚本写入值；它们是数据，不是经过验证的计算结果或声明为用户亲笔输入的内容。
- 未验证或范围外：真实模型答案质量、全部网络故障变体、Windows/Linux runtime E2E、Firefox/WebKit、远程 CI、CDN 发布、状态恢复及更广泛的 agent/workflow UI。
- 破坏性变更或迁移：无。既有实验开关仍默认关闭；没有依赖、资源 URI、快照 schema、daemon 路由或 guest runtime API 变化。

### 关联事项

prs.title: feat(web-shell): move no-workspace sessions beside workspaces
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Moves **No-workspace sessions / 无工作区会话** out of Workspaces into its own peer group, after the workspace list and before Archived. Collapsing Workspaces no longer hides the group. Its collapse preference now survives reload independently; active and archived no-workspace groups use separate preferences.

**Naming decision:** after discussion, the requester confirmed that the name remains **No-workspace sessions / 无工作区会话**. “Standalone sessions / 独立会话” is not being adopted. This resolves the naming decision raised in #15309 while preserving the existing English and Chinese labels.

## Why it's needed

Sessions without a registered workspace association were nested under the Workspaces collapse boundary. Users could mistake the disappearing group for missing sessions, even though expanding Workspaces restored it. Independent placement makes the organizational relationship clearer and keeps the group reachable when workspace entries are collapsed.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Connect Web Shell to a daemon supporting no-workspace sessions. With at least one such session, collapse Workspaces (currently labeled Project on main). The no-workspace group and its rows should remain visible after reload.
2. Collapse the no-workspace group, expand Workspaces, and reload. Workspaces should remain expanded and the no-workspace group collapsed. Expand the group and confirm its sessions return.
3. With the group collapsed, search for a session title. The matching row should appear without changing the saved collapse preference. Open it and confirm it uses the standalone session context.
4. Confirm existing creation, rename, export, archive, unarchive, and delete actions retain their behavior. A locked workspace or a daemon without standalone-session support must not expose the group. Archived no-workspace sessions remain under Archived.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Chromium screenshots of the actual Web Shell with Workspaces collapsed and simulated daemon responses:

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![Group hidden](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deggs7/qwen-code/codex/standalone-session-placement/docs/design/images/no-workspace-sessions-before.png) | ![Peer group visible](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deggs7/qwen-code/codex/standalone-session-placement/docs/design/images/no-workspace-sessions-after.png) |

The added browser regression failed on the unchanged implementation because the group became hidden after collapsing Workspaces. The fixed implementation passes visibility, independent reload persistence, search, and exact session-route assertions. Independent browser verification reproduced the baseline with globally installed Qwen 0.25.3 and verified the final locally built CLI serving its bundled Web Shell assets.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Chromium and automated checks |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS, Node.js 24.14.1, Chromium, and simulated daemon APIs. Full repository build, typecheck, bundle, and lint passed. The two related component files passed 180 tests; the standalone-session browser suite passed all seven cases, and the final stricter exact-URL regression also passed. Formatting and whitespace checks passed. Independent static review found no actionable defects. Full repository preflight/test suites were not run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the no-workspace group changes position and gains independent persisted expansion preferences. It retains the existing header, session rows, search, pagination, and actions.
- Not validated / out of scope: real model-provider traffic, Windows/Linux browsers, and native embedding runtime were not exercised. Existing capability, host ownership, locked-workspace, section-view, and Live restrictions remain in place. #14904 handles Recent, #15311 handles creation refresh, and #14988 handles general terminology separately.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; no backend, SDK, session storage, workspace association, or filesystem permission changes.

Design: [English](https://github.com/deggs7/qwen-code/blob/codex/standalone-session-placement/docs/design/no-workspace-session-placement.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/deggs7/qwen-code/blob/codex/standalone-session-placement/docs/design/no-workspace-session-placement.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Closes #15309.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

将**无工作区会话 / No-workspace sessions**移出工作区，放到工作区列表之后、已归档之前，成为独立的同级分组。折叠工作区不再隐藏该分组。分组自身的折叠偏好独立跨刷新保留，活动与已归档的无工作区分组分别保存偏好。

**命名决定：**经讨论，请求者已确认名称保留为**无工作区会话 / No-workspace sessions**，不采用“独立会话 / Standalone sessions”。这明确了 #15309 提出的命名决定，保留现有中英文名称。

## 修改原因

未关联已注册工作区的会话此前位于工作区折叠边界内部。分组消失可能让用户误以为会话丢失，虽然展开工作区即可恢复。同级放置让组织关系更清晰，也让工作区条目折叠时该分组仍然可访问。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 验证方法

1. 将 Web Shell 连接到支持无工作区会话的 daemon，准备至少一个此类会话并折叠工作区（当前 main 文案为 Project）。无工作区分组及会话行应在刷新后仍然可见。
2. 折叠无工作区分组，展开工作区并刷新。工作区应保持展开，无工作区分组保持折叠。展开分组后应恢复显示其会话。
3. 分组折叠时按会话标题搜索。匹配会话行应显示，且不改变已保存的折叠偏好。打开后确认进入独立会话上下文。
4. 确认现有创建、重命名、导出、归档、取消归档和删除操作行为保持一致。锁定工作区或不支持独立会话的 daemon 不应暴露该分组。已归档的无工作区会话仍位于已归档区域。

### 修改前后证据

上表为工作区折叠时真实 Web Shell 的 Chromium 截图，使用模拟 daemon 响应。左侧为修改前分组隐藏，右侧为修改后同级分组可见。

新增浏览器回归测试在未修改实现上因折叠工作区后分组隐藏而失败。修改后通过可见性、独立刷新持久化、搜索及精确会话路由断言。独立浏览器验证使用全局安装的 Qwen 0.25.3 复现基线，并验证最终本地 CLI 构建提供的 Web Shell 产物。

### 本地测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Chromium 及自动检查 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未测试 |

### 环境

macOS、Node.js 24.14.1、Chromium 和模拟 daemon API。完整仓库构建、类型检查、打包及 lint 通过。两个相关组件文件共 180 项测试通过；独立会话浏览器套件全部七项通过，最终更严格的精确 URL 回归测试也通过。格式与空白检查通过。独立静态审查未发现可操作缺陷。未运行完整仓库 preflight 或全量测试套件。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：无工作区分组改变位置并新增独立展开偏好持久化，保留现有标题、会话行、搜索、分页及操作。
- 未验证或范围外：未验证真实模型服务流量、Windows/Linux 浏览器和原生嵌入运行环境。保留现有能力、主机归属、锁定工作区、分区视图和 Live 限制。#14904 的最近列表、#15311 的创建刷新和 #14988 的通用术语分别处理。
- 不兼容改动或迁移说明：无；不修改后端、SDK、会话存储、工作区关联或文件系统权限。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/deggs7/qwen-code/blob/codex/standalone-session-placement/docs/design/no-workspace-session-placement.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/deggs7/qwen-code/blob/codex/standalone-session-placement/docs/design/no-workspace-session-placement.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

关闭 #15309。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): preserve checkpoint restore ownership and cold continuation
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Restores an existing Ink checkpoint through the real tool scheduler, pairs the actual replay result with the original logical call, and publishes the restored active journal branch for follow-up and cold resume. It preserves Read permissions, rejects stale owners and completions, and keeps subsequent ordinary rewind aligned with the restored prompt ancestry.

Current head `78e5d2fd` incorporates the actual merged main `b44e0333` containing #15384. The complete 28-file batch is now based on main and prepared for maintainer review. Complete OpenTUI checkpoint creation and capture/writer integration remain in dependent #15389.

## Why it's needed

Loading checkpoint history clears prior-read authority, while a new physical execution can leave the original logical call unpaired. Retaining discarded journal answers or stale prompt indexes then makes a cold resume or subsequent rewind reconstruct the wrong context. The change preserves normal permission and cancellation boundaries and persists the actual new result without fabricating successful siblings or atomic rollback.

The complete transaction, real consumer, permissions and regression evidence stay together: **28 files, +5,482/−119, 5,601 changed lines** relative to main. This comprises 1,237 production lines, 4,251 test/fixture lines, 90 bilingual design lines and 23 workflow lines. It exceeds the advisory 2–3k target to retain the complete behavior and tests together, and stays below the requested 6,000-line ceiling.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Create a real model Read/Edit checkpoint, retain backup A, restore and approve one local replay. The next explicit request must pair the actual NEW replay result with the original logical call, preserving the original model arguments even when authorized execution arguments differ.
- Quit naturally and resume the same session. Active context must retain the NEW result and exclude the discarded OLD result and answer; physical raw records remain available for audit.
- After restore, submit a new prompt and rewind it normally. The retained original prompt, restored tool result and successor ancestry must survive; discarded prompt identities must no longer resolve.
- Reject missing, ambiguous, paired, wrong-session or wrong-prompt bindings before history/filesystem effects. Permission denial, cancellation, replaced owners and stale Reads must not authorize an edit or publish into a successor.
- Hold the real completion finalizer, cancel, then release it. Neither durable publication nor API append should occur; healthy immediate completion must still work. Multi-call siblings and partial strict writes must remain truthful.

### Evidence (Before & After)

A real-disk service reproduction failed before the prompt-index repair: restoring a tool branch retained a discarded prompt index, and an ordinary subsequent rewind lost retained ancestry on cold load. The same unchanged reproduction passes after rebuilding prompt identities and parent boundaries from the same retained records. A permanent real-disk regression covers restore → new prompt → ordinary rewind → close/cold load. The original failed run is retained.

The fixed source completed build, full typecheck, full lint and bundle; four complete core test files passed **1,061 tests with 10 platform-specific skips**, seven complete CLI files passed **734 tests without skips**, and the script wiring suite passed **14 tests with four platform skips**. Two complete root diff audits and an independent complete source review found no further confirmed defects.

Actual permanent hot/cold checkpoint execution passed once on Node 24.19 + Ink and Bun 1.4.4 + Ink: **two cases total, zero failures/skips**, ten closed HTTP requests and four natural successful process exits. Real PostToolUse markers distinguish initial OLD1 from replay NEW2; same-session cold wire and persisted ancestry retain NEW2 and exclude the discarded answer. These runs belong to the fixed precommit `da8d8d61` + `4f006cc9` merge workspace, not a fresh committed-head product rerun.

Historical `4f42aeb5` preserved that exact own-feature patch; the only other tracked-source difference from the tested workspace is the parent's one-line provenance assertion. After committing and integrating that parent, a fresh current-head bundle and three entire native consumer test files passed **201 tests, zero failures/skips/retries**, with unchanged source/artifact guards and no residue. Earlier WIP product receipts keep their original identity. Those 201 consumer tests remain historical4f evidence. The dependency is now merged; the current78 head has fresh combined validation below, with its own official CI now passed.

Current candidate `78e5d2fd6aa67eba23b329234c72d36f17da57dc` integrates actual main without conflicts. All 28 own-feature file blobs and the complete binary patch remain byte-identical to the previously audited batch (SHA256 `82c2b4b691ab0dbd28cfa67aeb41b1c25b94972235d39e13aaa3bd2644230c49`); prior two complete clean audits retain that exact patch scope rather than being labelled new audits. Fresh combined build, workspace/integration typecheck, full lint and bundle passed. Four whole core files passed **1,061/0F/10skip**; seven whole CLI files passed **734/0F/0skip**, retry0. Complete source/reference/process guards passed; unit/lint full artifacts unchanged. Typecheck changed only the browser-use build-info artifact.

The original complete checkpoint product file ran once per profile again against the fresh **HEAD4f42/MERGEb44 WIP** source bundle: Node24.19/Ink **1P** and Bun1.4.4/Ink **1P**, 10 ended-and-closed HTTP transports and four natural exit-0 processes, no retry/filtering/observer error/forced cleanup/residue. All 12,922 source rows and 19,271 artifacts across34 declared roots remained unchanged, with real OLD1/NEW2 hook results, original logical call pairing and same-UUID cold context retained. Commit78 is source-byte-identical to that WIP; a separate clean committed bundle passed and verified the78 compiled stamp. This is Darwin arm64 source-bundle evidence, not a newly executed78-stamped product run or installed/platform/final-stack acceptance. Retargeting main preceded the verified nonforce head update so ordinary CI is actually triggered; current hosted validation CI has completed successfully.

Current exact78 hosted validation is now complete: Ubuntu Node22 unit, Lint & Static, no-AK integration, WebShell smoke, TUI parity and OpenTUI no-flicker all passed. The no-flicker job also successfully built the product and executed the added Shared restore recovery Node+Ink/Bun+Ink step plus evidence upload. Its raw log records **one checkpoint case passed per leg**, using actual **Bun1.3.14+0d9b296af**. This current Linux CI evidence is distinct from the earlier Darwin WIP source-bundle Bun1.4.4 execution; neither is installed-platform or final-stack acceptance. The review-bot workflow remains queued separately from validation CI.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | Current combined normal gates and WIP two-profile product PASS; source-identical78 committed bundle verified; old201 tests retain4f scope |
| 🪟 Windows | Not locally tested on this candidate |
| 🐧 Linux | Current78 hosted validation and two Ink checkpoint legs passed; Bun1.3.14 CI scope retained |

### Environment (optional)

Isolated source worktree with its own pinned dependency tree; Node 24.19 and Bun 1.4.4. No installed npm, standalone, cross-platform or default-renderer acceptance is claimed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: shared history/recorder and Read-authority changes require maintainer review of downstream owners, cold reconstruction and partial strict-write failures.
- Not validated / out of scope: complete OpenTUI checkpoint creation belongs to #15389. The older Retry-attempt snapshot identity boundary remains unproven by a real before/after control; this batch does not claim to repair it. Final installed-distribution and platform acceptance remain separate.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no new public schema, runtime pin, framework, automatic model request, release or default-renderer switch. Existing scheduler, journal and confirmation APIs are reused.

Design: [English](docs/design/2026-10-24-shared-checkpoint-restore.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-24-shared-checkpoint-restore.zh-CN.md), with synchronized decisions and acceptance boundaries.

## Linked Issues

Related #8662 and the [original restore ownership review](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15283#discussion_r4354801704). #15384 is merged; followed by #15389. No whole-migration issue closure is claimed.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

通过真实工具 scheduler 恢复既有 Ink checkpoint，将实际重放结果配对原逻辑调用，并发布恢复后的 active journal 分支供后续对话与冷恢复使用。保留 Read 权限，拒绝过期 owner 与完成回调，并使后续普通回退的提示身份与恢复后的祖先链一致。

当前 head 为 `78e5d2fd`，已整合实际合并 #15384 的 main `b44e0333`；完整28文件批次以main为基座，准备维护者审查。完整 OpenTUI checkpoint 创建及 capture/writer 接线仍属于后继 #15389。

## 为什么需要

加载 checkpoint history 会清除 prior-read 权限，新物理执行还可能使原逻辑调用失去配对。保留废弃 journal 回答或过期提示索引，会使冷恢复或后续普通回退重建错误上下文。本改动保留正常权限和取消边界，持久化实际新结果，不伪造成功兄弟或原子回滚。

完整事务、真实 consumer、权限及回归证据放在同批：相对 main，**28 文件，新增 5,482／删除 119，共 5,601 行**。其中生产 1,237、测试/fixture 4,251、双语设计 90、workflow 23 行。为保留完整行为与测试，超过建议 2–3k 目标，但低于要求的 6,000 行上限。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

- 通过真实模型 Read/Edit 创建 checkpoint，保留 backup A，恢复并批准一次本地重放。下一次明确请求应将实际 NEW 结果配对原逻辑调用；合法执行参数发生变化时仍保留原模型参数。
- 自然退出并恢复同一会话。活动上下文应保留 NEW 结果，排除废弃 OLD 结果和回答；物理 raw 记录仍可审计。
- 恢复后提交新提示，再普通回退该提示。原提示、已恢复工具结果和后继祖先链应保留；废弃提示身份不得再解析。
- 缺失、歧义、已配对、错误 session 或 prompt binding 必须在历史/文件副作用前拒绝。权限拒绝、取消、owner 替换与过期 Read 不得授权 edit 或向后继发布结果。
- 挂起真实 completion finalizer，取消后再释放，不得持久发布或追加 API history；健康立即完成仍应正常。多调用兄弟和 strict write 部分失败必须保持真实状态。

### 前后证据

修复提示索引前，真实磁盘 service 复现失败：工具分支恢复后保留废弃提示索引，后续普通回退使冷加载丢失已保留祖先链。从同批保留记录重建提示身份与父边界后，同一未改动复现通过。永久真实磁盘回归覆盖恢复 → 新提示 → 普通回退 → 关闭/冷加载。原始失败保留。

修复源码完成 build、完整 typecheck、完整 lint 和 bundle；四个 core 完整测试文件 **1,061 通过，另 10 项平台专属跳过**，七个 CLI 完整文件 **734 通过且无跳过**，脚本接线 suite **14 通过，另四项平台跳过**。两轮 root 完整差异审计及一轮独立完整源码审查未发现进一步确认缺陷。

永久 checkpoint 冷热产品用例在 Node 24.19 + Ink 和 Bun 1.4.4 + Ink 各通过一次：**合计两案，零失败/跳过**、十次 HTTP 闭合、四次自然成功退出。真实 PostToolUse marker 区分初次 OLD1 与重放 NEW2；同会话 cold wire 和持久祖先链保留 NEW2，排除废弃回答。这些实测归属修复后的提交前 `da8d8d61` + `4f006cc9` 合并工作区，不改称当前已提交 head 产品重跑。

历史 `4f42aeb5` head 保留完全相同的本功能 patch；与已测工作区相比，其他 tracked 源码差异仅为父 PR 的一行 provenance 断言。提交并同步父依赖后，新生成当前 head bundle，三个完整 native consumer 测试文件 **201 通过、零失败/跳过/重试**，源码/产物守卫相同且无残留。此前 WIP 产品收据保留原身份。该201项consumer测试保留4f历史范围。父依赖现已合并；当前78提交新增组合验证如下，官方验证CI现已全部通过。

当前78e5候选无冲突整合真实mainb44；28个本功能文件blob及完整binary patch与先前已审批次逐字节相同（SHA256 `82c2b4b691ab0dbd28cfa67aeb41b1c25b94972235d39e13aaa3bd2644230c49`），两轮既有完整干净审计保持该精确patch范围，不改称本轮重新逐行审计。组合源码完整build、workspace/integration typecheck、lint、bundle通过；core四完整文件1,061P/0F/10skip、CLI七完整文件734P/0F/0skip，retry0。源码/引用/进程守卫通过；单测与lint完整产物不变，typecheck仅改变browser-use构建信息产物。

原完整checkpoint产品文件对新HEAD4f42/MERGEb44 WIP bundle在Node24.19/Ink与Bun1.4.4/Ink各实跑1P，共2P、0失败/跳过、10条HTTP正常结束/闭合、4次自然退出0，无重试/过滤/观察错误/强制清理/残留；12922源行、34声明根的19271产物全部保持不变。真实OLD1/NEW2 hook结果、原逻辑调用配对、同UUID冷恢复上下文得到验证。提交78与该WIP源码逐字节相同，另行clean committed bundle通过且核验78编译戳；不能改称新78戳产品重跑或安装包/跨平台/最终stack验收。先retarget main再nonforce更新已验证head以触发普通CI；当前官方验证CI现已全部通过。

当前精确78官方验证CI已完成：Ubuntu Node22单测、Lint、no-AK、WebShell、TUI parity、防闪烁均通过。防闪烁job中的产品bundle、Shared restore recovery Node+Ink/Bun+Ink及证据上传均实际成功；raw日志每腿checkpoint1案通过，真实Bun为1.3.14+0d9b296af。该Linux当前head执行与此前Darwin WIP Bun1.4.4执行分开记录，均不冒称安装分发/最终stack验收；另有review-bot任务仍排队。

### 已测试平台

| 平台 | 状态 |
| :--: | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | 当前组合normal门禁、WIP两腿产品通过；源码等价78提交bundle另验；旧201项保留4f范围 |
| 🪟 Windows | 当前候选未本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | 当前78官方验证及两腿Ink checkpoint通过；保留Bun1.3.14 CI范围 |

### 环境

隔离源码工作树及其自有固定依赖树；Node 24.19、Bun 1.4.4。不据此宣称 npm 安装包、standalone、跨平台或默认 renderer 验收通过。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：共享 history/recorder 与 Read 权限变更，需维护者审查下游 owner、冷重建和 strict write 部分失败。
- 未验证或范围外：完整 OpenTUI checkpoint 创建属于 #15389。较早的 Retry-attempt snapshot 身份边界仍缺真实前后对照，本批不宣称修复；最终安装分发与平台验收独立进行。
- 兼容性：不引入公共 schema、runtime pin、框架、自动模型请求、release 或默认 renderer 切换；复用既有 scheduler、journal 与 confirmation API。

设计：[English](docs/design/2026-10-24-shared-checkpoint-restore.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-24-shared-checkpoint-restore.zh-CN.md)，决策与验收边界同步。

## 关联事项

关联 #8662 及[原 restore 所有权意见](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15283#discussion_r4354801704)。#15384 已合并，后继为 #15389。不宣称整个迁移 issue 已解决。

</details>

prs.title: feat(runtime-broker): add HTTP-backed external scratch workers
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds an opt-in `external-scratch` Runtime provider that delegates Session worker placement to an operator-run HTTP service. The Broker persists a deterministic request handle before provisioning, retains attestation and ownership checks, and retries the original resource after a lost provision response or transient confirmation failure. Infrastructure SDKs remain outside this repository.

This experimental increment implements allocation, attestation and recovery. Source inspection shows that, in the Spring server, a Session without a Workspace binding has no Hosted tool profile: Session creation does not warm a worker, while ordinary Turn dispatch warms one asynchronously without establishing a Hosted tool consumer. That Spring path has not been observed in a running integration. Hosted Workspace integration and production remote-tool use remain follow-up work.

## Why it's needed

The intended deployment keeps Managed Agent Server and Hosted Harness central while allocating tool workers on an existing sandbox or container platform. The HTTP boundary lets an operator own allocation without adding vendor SDKs to the Broker. This increment establishes that placement boundary; it does not complete the remote-tool workflow.

The protocol has provision and read-only observe endpoints. There is no release-to-kill mapping because release can be invoked by an operation that has lost ownership. The provider must persist the mapping from each logical request handle to its original physical resource.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Configuration remains opt-in, requires session isolation, accepts a worker-local cwd without requiring that directory on the Java host, and rejects managed Workspace features.
- Losing the first provision response after allocation must retain the request identity and logical handle; retry must not allocate a replacement worker.
- Temporary observation uncertainty must preserve the original READY binding for confirmation. A later positive observation must independently re-attest the same worker; endpoint or identity drift must be rejected.
- Recreating Broker and provisioner instances must observe the original handle without allocating a replacement. The new integration scenario reuses in-memory repositories; it does not establish whole-process or database crash durability.
- Real file write, edit and read operations should reach the CLI worker. Retrying the original write must not overwrite a later edit. These Broker-level operations do not establish a Spring Hosted tool consumer.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The original failure at `6ae13e2e` was fixed by `48de7795`, which re-acquires the Session after Broker recreation before issuing new executions. The test retains the binding, lease, single-allocation, duplicate-write and file-read assertions.

Completed evidence is commit-specific:
- `48de7795`: [full Java run 39938851567](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39938851567) completed successfully. [Hosted fault-gate job 120365028331](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39938851567/job/120365028331) reports `ExternalRuntimeWorkerFaultGateTest`: 1 test, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skipped.
- `fcd18bdb`: [Hosted fault-gate job 120425385493](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39954747157/job/120425385493) also executed that test successfully. That workflow had an EventTransport multi-node failure; its rerun is separate and is not counted as a full-workflow pass. The cause of that failure is not yet established.

These historical passes do not certify later commits. The latest review response below links the full-tier run for the documentation update's exact head; its result remains pending. No current-head pass or merge approval is claimed.

The scenario uses actual Broker/HTTP client/CLI worker code and a loopback operator fixture, with shared in-memory repositories across instance recreation. It does not prove vendor sandbox interoperability, whole-process/database crash durability, or Spring Hosted tool execution. Earlier local reports with incomplete sibling-SDK provenance remain historical only.

The bilingual design now documents the re-acquire requirement and the source-inspected caller boundary: Spring scratch Turn dispatch warms a worker but does not establish a Hosted tool consumer. Workspace caller acquisition paths do not prove external-scratch restart integration.

## Notes

- UNKNOWN outcomes retain retry eligibility; GONE does not authorize a replacement or stopped-writer cleanup.
- Closing a Session does not stop its worker. Physical resource lifetime remains the provider's TTL or operator responsibility.
- Each Broker retains at most 1024 placement seeds. Closing Sessions and provider TTL expiry do not evict those entries. Exhaustion rejects a new seed with retryable HTTP 503 `runtime_external_capacity`; closing the Broker clears its cache but does not stop remote workers.
- Vendor resource allocation, remote image/entrypoint/lifetime validation, Workspace storage registration, boot-v2, public Hosted tools, shell capture/publication and automatic stopped-writer recovery remain outside this increment.
- Opt-in only, with no database migration and no change to existing provider defaults. Protocol v1 uses a logical `{requestId: provisionRequestId}` handle which the provider must bind durably to the original resource.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/external-runtime-provisioner/docs/design/2026-10-23-external-runtime-provider.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/external-runtime-provisioner/docs/design/2026-10-23-external-runtime-provider.zh-CN.md).

## Related Issues

Related to #15247. This does not close the broader Hosted Workspace objective.

<details>
<summary>简体中文</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

新增可选的 `external-scratch` Runtime provider，将 Session worker 的分配交给运营方提供的 HTTP 服务。Broker 在分配前持久化确定性的请求 handle，保留认证和所有权检查，并在分配响应丢失或暂时无法确认时重试原资源。厂商 SDK 留在仓库外部。

本实验性增量实现分配、认证和恢复。源码显示，Spring 服务中没有 Workspace 绑定的 Session 不带 Hosted 工具 profile：创建 Session 不预热 worker，普通 Turn 会异步预热，但不会因此建立 Hosted 工具消费者。这条 Spring 路径尚未经过实际运行验证。Hosted Workspace 集成及生产远程工具使用留待后续。

## 为什么需要

目标部署将 Managed Agent Server 与 Hosted Harness 保持在中心服务，通过既有沙箱或容器平台分配工具 worker。HTTP 边界让运营方负责资源分配，无需向 Broker 引入厂商 SDK。本增量建立分配边界，尚未完成整个远程工具流程。

协议提供 provision 和只读 observe。release 不映射为销毁资源，因为失去所有权的操作也可能调用 release。provider 必须持久保存逻辑请求 handle 与原物理资源的对应关系。

## 评审验证计划

- 配置保持可选启用，要求 Session 隔离；worker-local cwd 不要求在 Java 主机存在，且拒绝受管 Workspace 功能。
- 首次分配后丢失响应，重试应保持请求身份和逻辑 handle，不重复创建 worker。
- 暂时无法观测时保留原 READY 绑定；恢复观测后对同一 worker 重新认证，并拒绝 endpoint 或身份漂移。
- 重建 Broker 和 provisioner 实例时只观测原 handle，不重新分配。新集成场景复用内存仓库，不证明完整进程或数据库崩溃恢复。
- 真实文件写入、编辑和读取应到达 CLI worker；重试旧写入不能覆盖后续编辑。这些 Broker 级操作不证明 Spring Hosted 工具消费者已接通。

## 验证证据

`6ae13e2e` 上的原始失败已由 `48de7795` 修复：Broker 实例重建后，测试先重新 acquire Session，再创建新执行，保留 binding、lease、单次分配、重复写保护和文件读取断言。

已完成的证据按提交区分：
- `48de7795`：[完整 Java run 39938851567](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39938851567) 成功；[Hosted fault-gate job 120365028331](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39938851567/job/120365028331) 中 `ExternalRuntimeWorkerFaultGateTest` 实际执行，1 项、0 失败、0 错误、0 跳过。
- `fcd18bdb`：[Hosted fault-gate job 120425385493](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39954747157/job/120425385493) 也实际执行并通过该测试。该工作流另有 EventTransport 多节点失败，其重跑单独处理，不计作完整工作流通过；该失败根因尚未确定。

历史通过不代表后续提交通过。下方最新评审回复提供本次文档更新对应 head 的 full-tier run 链接，结果仍待完成，不宣称当前 head 已通过或可以合并。

测试使用真实 Broker、HTTP client 和 CLI worker，以及 loopback 运营方 fixture；实例重建间共享内存仓库。它不证明厂商沙箱互通、完整进程或数据库崩溃持久性，也不证明 Spring Hosted 工具执行。此前未完整确定 sibling SDK 来源的本地报告仅作历史参考。

双语设计文档已补充重新 acquire 的要求及源码核实的调用方边界：Spring scratch Turn 分发会预热 worker，但没有建立 Hosted 工具消费者；Workspace 调用方已有的 acquire 流程不能证明 external-scratch 重启集成。

## 注意事项

- UNKNOWN 保持可重试；GONE 不授权重新分配或清理 stopped writer。
- 关闭 Session 不停止 worker，物理资源寿命由 provider TTL 或运营方管理。
- 每个 Broker 最多保留 1024 个 placement seed。Session 关闭或 provider TTL 到期不会释放缓存槽位。容量耗尽时，新 seed 返回可重试 HTTP 503 `runtime_external_capacity`；关闭 Broker 清空缓存，但不停止远程 worker。
- 厂商分配、远程镜像/入口/进程寿命、Workspace 存储注册、boot-v2、公开 Hosted 工具、shell capture/publication 及自动 stopped-writer 恢复不在本增量范围。
- 可选启用，无数据库迁移，现有 provider 默认值不变。协议 v1 使用 `{requestId: provisionRequestId}` 逻辑 handle，要求 provider 持久绑定原资源。

设计：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/external-runtime-provisioner/docs/design/2026-10-23-external-runtime-provider.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/external-runtime-provisioner/docs/design/2026-10-23-external-runtime-provider.zh-CN.md)。

关联 #15247；本 PR 不关闭更完整的 Hosted Workspace 目标。

</details>
